在 NTAG 424 DNA 芯片中，一共内置了5个独立的 AES-128密钥，分别被命名为 Key O、Key 1、Key 2、Key 3和 Key 4。
其中 Key O（也叫 Configuration Key / Master Key）是整个芯片的最高控制权秘钥（相当于超级管理员密码）。
（工程_XieTie） 2909
谢轶。
s Key O的核心作用
1. 芯片的物理与逻辑最高权限
• Key 0 控制着芯片内部绝大多数安全设置的修改权限。
• 想要修改芯片的读取/写入权限、改变其他密钥（Key 1~4）、或者开启/关闭SDM（动态消息）功能，都必须先用 Key 0进行身份认证
(Authenticate) .
2. 控制 SDM功能的开关与配置
•你之前提到小卡上可以关闭SDM 功能，这个操作必须通过 Key O授权。
• 只有掌握 Key O，才能配置哪些数据字段需要加密、哪些需要计算CMAC校验码，以及是否开启计数器。
3. 防篡改与"锁死卡片（Freeze/Lock）"
• 在生产或部署的最后一步，管理员可以使用 Key O 将芯片的配置永久锁死 （Set Lock Byte）。
• 一旦锁定，即使未来有人获得了 Key O，也无法再更改芯片的配置或关闭 SDM，确保产品出厂后安全机制不可被逆转。
Key 0 与其他密钥（Key 1~4）的分工差异为了实现”权限分离"，NTAG 424 DNA 将管理权和使用权分开了：
2909
2909
• Key 0（管理员密钥）：只负责芯片配置与权限管理。通常留在工厂或发卡机构的服务器硬件安全模块（HSM）中，绝对不暴露给最终用户。
•Key 1 （SDM 动态加密密钥）：专用于生成动态 URL中的 CMAC密文或加密 UID/Counter 数据。这是防伪验证最常被调用的密钥。
•Key 2~ Key 4（应用/读写密钥）：可以分配给特定的读写权限（例如 Key 2用来读取敏感 NDEF 内存，Key 3 用来写入受保护的数据区等）。
默认状态与安全风险
• 出厂默认值：芯片刚出厂时，Key O到 Key 4 默认都是ox00000000000000000000000000000000（16个全零字节）。
•必须改密：如果在初始化卡片时没有修改Key O，任何懂NFC的攻击者都可以直接连接卡片，用默认的全零密钥获取最高权限，进而关闭SDM、篡改配置或锁死卡片。因此，配置 NTAG 424 DNA 的第一步永远是修改 Key O。 聚焦于Ntag 424的加密，APP侧是否可以利用这个实现 卡的防复制检测

      # FM1208/FMCOS 业务数据个性化研究
      
      ## 结论
      
      当前卡不是可直接写入的 NDEF 标签，而是只能选中 MF 的 FMCOS 卡。`SELECT 3F00` 返回的 `88 01 01` 只声明 DIR 的短文件标识符为 1；随后 `READ RECORD` 返回 `6A82` 表明 DIR EF 实际不存在。手册也明确 DIR 不是强制建立的文件。[FMCOS 手册，§4.1.1–4.1.2，PDF pp.40–41；§7.4，pp.54–55]
      
      因此，当前的失败不是 `UPDATE` 参数错误，而是没有可写的目标 EF。配置前必须先建立业务 DF/EF；但现有两份官方资料不足以安全生成建文件 APDU。
      
      ## 手册能够确认的内容
      
      - FM1208 是支持 ISO 14443-A 的非接触 CPU 卡芯片，提供 8 KB EEPROM 和 DES/3DES 能力。该芯片手册没有列出 NDEF、NFC Forum Type 4 或 NDEF AID。[FM1208 手册，§1.1–1.2，PDF p.4]
      - FMCOS 以唯一 MF、DF 和 EF 组成文件树。EF 可为二进制 `28`、定长记录 `2A`、变长记录 `2C`、循环 `2E`、钱包 `2F` 或 KEY `3F`；MF/DF 类型为 `38`。[FMCOS 手册，§4.1、§4.4，PDF pp.40–43]
      - KEY EF 必须是每个 MF/DF 下第一个建立的文件，每个目录最多一个。刚进入一个既无 KEY 也无其他文件的目录时可不受权限限制地建文件；离开后再进入就按已建文件的访问权限执行。[FMCOS 手册，§4.1.3、§4.3，PDF pp.41–42]
      - 访问权限在建文件时设定。`F0` 表示当前目录状态 0–F 都可操作；例如 `F1` 要求状态至少为 1。复位或切换目录会将状态重置为 0，可通过 PIN 或外部认证改变状态。[FMCOS 手册，§5.1–5.3，PDF p.45]
      - `CREATE` 是专有命令 `CLA=80, INS=E0`，但手册只在命令表列出它，没有 P1/P2/Lc/Data 或文件控制数据的编码定义。`WRITE KEY (80/84 D4)` 和 `ERASE DF (80 0E)` 同样仅被列为专有命令。[FMCOS 手册，§1.4，PDF pp.9–10]
      
      ## 已有 EF 的写入规则
      
      `UPDATE BINARY` 为 `CLA=00/04, INS=D6/D0`。选中当前二进制 EF 后，P1/P2 可表示偏移；也可用 P1 的低 5 位选择 1–31 范围的短 FID。普通写入使用明文 Data，线路保护还需 4-byte MAC，加密保护需密文加 MAC。`6982` 表示写条件不满足，`6A82` 表示文件不存在。[FMCOS 手册，§7.7，PDF pp.60–61]
      
      `UPDATE RECORD` 为 `CLA=00/04, INS=DC`，P1 是记录号，P2 同时表示短 FID 和定位方式。变长记录的 Data 必须是 TLV，且修改已有记录时新旧整条长度必须相同。`APPEND RECORD` 可用于可追加的记录 EF。[FMCOS 手册，§7.8–7.9，PDF pp.61–64]
      
      ## 建议的安全个性化方案
      
      对于“APP 自用读写 URL 和 Android 包名”，不需要冒充标准 NDEF 应用。建议由复旦微电子或制卡供应商用完整个性化规范/工具预建：
      
      1. 一个业务自有 ADF，分配不与标准 NDEF AID 冲突的 DF 名和唯一 FID。
      2. 一个容量充足的二进制 EF，分配唯一 FID；如需短 FID 访问，FID 应位于 1–31。
      3. 在业务层保存 `[2-byte big-endian length][NDEF message bytes]`。这是本项目的应用数据设计，便于复用现有 URI 和 `android.com:pkg` 解析；它不会使 FMCOS EF 自动成为 Android NDEF 标签。
      4. 如果卡需要可重复写，设计“公开读、认证写”：读权限可为 `F0`，写权限需认证后状态。KEY EF 必须先建，密钥由发卡方生成、注入和管理，不应内置在 APP 或 Git 中。
      5. APP 直接唤起依赖 `TECH_DISCOVERED + IsoDep` 的 manifest 匹配，而不依赖 FMCOS EF 中的包名。FMCOS 中的包名仅是 APP 自定义数据。
      
      个性化参数必须先形成一份发卡 profile：DF 名/AID、DF FID、EF 类型、EF FID/SFI、容量、数据编码、读/写/追加权限、是否启用线路保护，以及 KEY 类型、标识、后续状态、错误次数与密钥分发方式。在拿到 `CREATE 80 E0` 完整字段定义和制卡流程前，APP 不应开放 FMCOS 写入。
      
      ## NDEF 个性化与不可确定项
      
      两份手册全文都没有 NDEF、NFC Forum Type 4、Capability Container、CC EF `E103`、NDEF EF 或 AID `D2760000850101` 的配置说明。实卡对该 AID 返回 `6A82`，只能证明当前卡没有 NDEF 应用，不能单凭芯片型号推断它能或不能被个性化为 Type 4 Tag。如必须让 Android 系统把卡识别为 NDEF，需供应商明确提供 NFC Forum Type 4 NDEF 个性化方案，不能用当前 FMCOS 通用手册猜测。
      
      手册也没有定义任何“默认密钥”或“默认 PIN”。外部认证章节中的 `01 02 03 04 05 06 07 08` 明确是示例；认证失败会减少重试次数，并可导致密钥锁死。[FMCOS 手册，§7.1–7.2，PDF pp.49–50]
      
      ## 禁止的试探操作
      
      - 不猜测 `CREATE 80 E0` 的 Data，因为资料没有其专有编码。
      - 不使用手册示例密钥尝试认证，不暴力枚举 PIN/密钥。
      - 不发送 `ERASE DF`、`INITIAL EEPROM`、`WRITE EEPROM` 或生产测试命令。手册将后两者标为生产测试命令。[FMCOS 手册，§1.4，PDF pp.9–10]
      
      ## 供应商必须补充的资料
      
      1. 与这批卡内 FMCOS 版本匹配的 `CREATE (80 E0)` 命令完整字段表和状态码。
      2. KEY EF 和 `WRITE KEY (80/84 D4)` 的 TLV 结构、密钥类型编码、初始发卡流程及制卡工具。
      3. 卡片是否已锁定 MF、是否允许继续个性化，以及已存在的密钥/权限 profile。
      4. 如要求系统级 NDEF，提供该 FMCOS 版本支持的 Type 4 Tag 个性化文档或预个性化卡片。
      
      ## nfcproxy-master 参考评估
      
      ### 结论
      
      该库是 EMV APDU 中继、录制、回放和 HCE 工具，不是 FM1208/FMCOS 个性化工具。README 明确说明它是 NFCProxy fork，并以 MITM 方式截取非接触 IC 卡交互。[源码：<code>/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcproxy-master/README.md:1</code>、<code>:4</code>、<code>:9</code>]
      
      静态全库检索未发现 FM1208、FMCOS、<code>CREATE 80 E0</code>、<code>UPDATE BINARY</code>、<code>WRITE KEY</code>、FMCOS 卡密钥认证、Type 4 NDEF AID <code>D2760000850101</code> 或 MF <code>3F00</code> 的实现。因此它不能补齐当前缺少的 CREATE Data 结构、KEY EF、安全属性和认证流程，没有可直接复用的 FMCOS 写入代码。
      
      ### IsoDep、APDU、FMCOS 与 NDEF 的层次
      
      - <code>IsoDep</code> 只是 Android 提供的 ISO-DEP 字节传输通道；该库连接卡片后，把网络收到的任意 APDU 交给 <code>transceive()</code>。[源码：<code>/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcproxy-master/app/src/main/java/org/eleetas/nfc/nfcproxy/NFCRelayActivity.java:489</code>、<code>:503</code>、<code>:512</code>]
      - APDU 是通道中传输的命令/响应格式。该库只负责透明转发，并不理解 FMCOS 的 MF/DF/EF、状态字、访问权限或写入状态机。
      - FMCOS 是卡片 OS 及文件/安全模型，需要专有 CREATE、KEY EF 和认证规范；拥有 IsoDep/APDU 通道不等于知道如何安全个性化 FMCOS。
      - NDEF 是更上层的数据格式和标签协议。该库仅通过 Android <code>Ndef</code> API 读取已有消息；注释中的 IsoDep 示例也只是 SELECT 自定义 AID，不含 Type 4 CC/NDEF EF 流程。[源码：<code>/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcproxy-master/app/src/main/java/org/eleetas/nfc/nfcproxy/NfcCardReader.java:53</code>、<code>:110</code>、<code>:152</code>]
      
      ### 可借鉴部分
      
      - APP 内主动扫描的 Reader Mode 生命周期可参考：使用 <code>enableReaderMode()</code> 注册回调，在暂停时 <code>disableReaderMode()</code>。[源码：<code>/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcproxy-master/app/src/main/java/org/eleetas/nfc/nfcproxy/NFCRelayActivity.java:85</code>、<code>:94</code>]
      - APDU 录制、保存和展示可用于在合法测试环境中采集厂商官方个性化工具的交互，再人工分析。[源码：<code>/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcproxy-master/app/src/main/java/org/eleetas/nfc/nfcproxy/DBHelper.java:45</code>、<code>/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcproxy-master/app/src/main/java/org/eleetas/nfc/nfcproxy/NFCProxyActivity.java:1126</code>]
      - EMV BER-TLV 解码器可有限用于改善 <code>6F/84/A5</code> FCI 日志展示，但不是 FMCOS CREATE 参数解析器。[源码：<code>/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcproxy-master/app/src/main/java/org/eleetas/nfc/nfcproxy/utils/EmvBerTlvHelper.java:14</code>]
      
      Reader Mode 示例设置了 <code>FLAG_READER_SKIP_NDEF_CHECK</code>。[源码：<code>/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcproxy-master/app/src/main/java/org/eleetas/nfc/nfcproxy/NFCRelayActivity.java:70</code>] 该标志会跳过 Android NDEF 检测，适合只走原始 IsoDep 的场景，但不应直接用于本项目“自动兼容 NDEF + FMCOS”的统一扫描路径，否则 NDEF 卡不会按预期暴露 <code>Ndef</code> tech。当前实现应继续让系统执行 NDEF 检测，再根据 tech 分派到 NDEF 或 FMCOS 客户端。
      
      ### 无关或危险部分
      
      - HCE 配置出现 <code>1PAY.SYS.DDF01</code> 和 <code>2PAY.SYS.DDF01</code>，只是让手机模拟卡时接收 SELECT AID，并不是向 FM1208 创建 DF。[源码：<code>/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcproxy-master/app/src/main/res/xml/apduservice.xml:7</code>、<code>:9</code>]
      - 内置事务是 SELECT <code>2PAY.SYS.DDF01</code>、SELECT 支付 AID、GPO、READ RECORD 等查询序列，没有建文件或写卡命令。[源码：<code>/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcproxy-master/app/src/main/java/org/eleetas/nfc/nfcproxy/DBHelper.java:29</code>、<code>:32</code>]
      - PBKDF2/AES 用于两台设备间的中继网络加密，不是 FMCOS 外部认证或卡片 MAC。[源码：<code>/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcproxy-master/app/src/main/java/org/eleetas/nfc/nfcproxy/MyHostApduService.java:192</code>、<code>:198</code>]
      - tech filter 将 IsoDep、MifareClassic、MifareUltralight 和 Ndef 放在同一个 <code>tech-list</code> 中。[源码：<code>/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcproxy-master/app/src/main/res/xml/nfc_tech_filter.xml:5</code>] 同一列表要求全部 tech 同时匹配，不适合当前 FM1208 的 <code>IsoDep + NfcA</code> 或独立 NDEF 分支。
      - 中继和回放把未知字节直接发送给真实卡，没有 APDU 白名单、只读限制或认证重试保护。[源码：<code>/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcproxy-master/app/src/main/java/org/eleetas/nfc/nfcproxy/NFCRelayActivity.java:503</code>、<code>:512</code>；<code>/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcproxy-master/app/src/main/java/org/eleetas/nfc/nfcproxy/NFCProxyActivity.java:609</code>、<code>:617</code>] 未知序列可能包含 CREATE、ERASE 或 WRITE KEY，禁止直接回放到业务卡。
      
      可行动建议是：仅借鉴 Reader Mode 生命周期和 APDU 采集思路；若能取得厂商工具的合法抓取记录，应逐条审核并形成明确的 FMCOS 发卡 profile，再将允许的命令实现为受约束的业务状态机，不引入透明网络转发或任意回放能力。
      
      ## nfc-clone-main 参考评估
      
      ### 结论
      
      该库不能解决当前 FMCOS 写入配置问题。静态全库检索未发现 FM1208、FMCOS、`CREATE 80 E0`、DF/EF 创建、`UPDATE RECORD`、FMCOS KEY EF/外部认证、标准 NDEF AID `D2760000850101`、CC EF `E103` 或 NDEF EF `E104` 的实现，也没有 relay、replay、proxy 或真实卡片克隆逻辑。项目名称中的 “Clone” 实际指手机端 HCE 示例；其 HCE 只对 SELECT、READ BINARY、UPDATE BINARY 返回演示响应。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfc-clone-main/app/src/main/kotlin/com/example/nfcclone/nfc/HostCardEmulationService.kt:29`、`:34`、`:39`]
      
      当前 FM1208 **确实是 ISO-DEP 卡，且当前交互是 APDU**：实卡 tech 包含 `IsoDep`，本项目通过 `IsoDep.get(tag)` 取得连接并用 `IsoDep.transceive()` 发送 ISO/IEC 7816-4/FMCOS APDU。[本项目源码：`app/src/main/java/com/vdian/android/lib/testforgradle/nfc/Fm1208FmcosClient.kt:70`、`:85`] `IsoDep` 是传输层，APDU 是命令格式，FMCOS 是卡 OS/文件与安全模型，NDEF 又是其上的数据/标签协议；支持前两层不等于卡已配置 NDEF，也不等于已知 FMCOS 专有 CREATE Data。
      
      ### 可直接复用、仅可借鉴与无关部分
      
      - **可直接复用：无。** 本项目已经有更完整的 NDEF/FMCOS 分派、状态字校验和 APDU 日志。该库写 NDEF 仅调用 Android `Ndef.writeNdefMessage()`。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfc-clone-main/app/src/main/kotlin/com/example/nfcclone/nfc/NfcManager.kt:110`]
      - **仅可借鉴：** `NdefRecord.createTextRecord()` 和 `createUri()` 是标准 Android NDEF 消息构造入口。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfc-clone-main/app/src/main/kotlin/com/example/nfcclone/nfc/NfcManager.kt:100`、`:105`] 但当前项目已经采用同类 API，并额外需要 `android.com:pkg` record。
      - **仅可借鉴：** manifest 中 `TECH_DISCOVERED` 与 tech-filter 的连接方式是正确概念。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfc-clone-main/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:34`、`:42`] 但其 filter 把 `IsoDep/NfcA/NfcB/NfcF/NfcV/Ndef` 放在同一个 `tech-list`，Android 将同一列表按 AND 匹配，现实卡片几乎不可能同时拥有这些 tech，不能复制。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfc-clone-main/app/src/main/res/xml/nfc_tech_filter.xml:4`]
      - **无关：** `HostApduService` 是让**手机模拟卡**并响应外部读卡器，不会把 DF/EF 写进实体 FM1208，也不会使实体卡获得 NDEF 能力。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfc-clone-main/app/src/main/kotlin/com/example/nfcclone/nfc/HostCardEmulationService.kt:11`]
      
      ### 协议与实现风险
      
      - 该库虽然导入 `IsoDep`，实际对实体卡发送数据时使用的是 `NfcA.transceive()`，且所谓 SELECT MF 是 `00 A4 00 00 00`，既没有 `3F00` 数据也没有本卡验证过的 `Lc=02`；不能替换当前 `IsoDep + 00A40000023F00` 流程。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfc-clone-main/app/src/main/kotlin/com/example/nfcclone/nfc/NfcManager.kt:9`、`:80`、`:84`]
      - NDEF URI 解码把 URI Identifier Code 一并转成字符串；Text 解码只跳过状态字而未跳过语言码，解析结果不符合 NDEF RTD Text/URI 格式。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfc-clone-main/app/src/main/kotlin/com/example/nfcclone/nfc/NfcManager.kt:45`、`:50`、`:59`]
      - `Ndef.get(tag)` 为 `null` 时，写入函数因安全调用仍返回 `true`；代码也不支持 `NdefFormatable`，不检查容量、可写状态或只读状态。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfc-clone-main/app/src/main/kotlin/com/example/nfcclone/nfc/NfcManager.kt:110`、`:112`、`:116`]
      - HCE 的 SELECT 不校验 AID，READ BINARY 忽略 offset/Le，UPDATE BINARY 不保存 Data 却直接返回 `9000`，不能作为 Type 4 NDEF 或 FMCOS 行为参考。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfc-clone-main/app/src/main/kotlin/com/example/nfcclone/nfc/HostCardEmulationService.kt:48`、`:58`、`:64`]
      - HCE 声明互相矛盾：服务继承 ISO-DEP 使用的 `HostApduService`，但注释、XML 根节点及 system code 是 NFC-F；manifest 又把该 NFC-F XML 挂到 `host_apdu_service` metadata，不能视为可工作的 HCE 配置。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfc-clone-main/app/src/main/kotlin/com/example/nfcclone/nfc/HostCardEmulationService.kt:8`、`:11`；`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfc-clone-main/app/src/main/res/xml/nfc_applet_config.xml:2`；`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfc-clone-main/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:58`、`:61`]
      - 文档中的 PIN “认证”只是 HCE 端明文字符串比较，不是 FMCOS challenge-response、DES/3DES、MAC 或密钥状态管理；绝不能移植到实体卡认证。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfc-clone-main/EXAMPLES.md:33`、`:37`、`:41`]
      
      该库没有向实体卡发送 `CREATE/ERASE/WRITE KEY` 的代码，因此本次只读分析本身没有发现会立即改卡的路径；危险来自把其伪成功 HCE handler 或错误 SELECT 当作制卡依据。继续保持当前保护：没有厂商 CREATE 字段表、密钥 profile 和权限定义时，不开放 FMCOS 个性化写入。

      ## nfcspy-master 参考评估
      
      ### 结论与协议层次
      
      当前实卡**是 ISO-DEP/APDU 卡**。Android 已将它暴露为 `IsoDep`；`nfcspy-master` 也仅通过 `TECH_DISCOVERED` 接收 `IsoDep`，连接后用 `transceive()` 原样交换字节。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcspy-master/src/com/sinpo/nfcspy/NfcManager.java:116`、`:139`、`:164`、`:167`]
      
      这与“卡上没有 NDEF 应用”并不矛盾：ISO-DEP 是 ISO 14443-4 传输层，APDU 是命令/响应载体，FMCOS 是其上的卡 OS 和文件/安全模型；NFC Forum Type 4 NDEF 只是 APDU 通道上的一种标准应用与文件布局，并非每张 IsoDep 卡都天然支持。实卡可以正常处理 FMCOS `SELECT MF`，但没有标准 NDEF AID 和业务 EF。
      
      该库定位是两台手机通过 Wi-Fi P2P，把真实读卡器的 APDU 中继到真实卡并记录交互，不是 FM1208 配置 SDK。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcspy-master/README.md:3`、`:11`、`:19`、`:21`；`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcspy-master/src/com/sinpo/nfcspy/ServiceAgent.java:194`、`:199`、`:208`]
      
      ### 可直接复用、仅可借鉴与无关部分
      
      - **可直接复用：无。** 本项目已有 `IsoDep.connect/transceive`、超时和十六进制日志；引入该库不会增加 FMCOS 协议能力，而且其 GPL 许可证不适合在未确认本仓库授权方式时直接复制代码。
      - **仅可借鉴：APDU 观察思路。** 若供应商授权并提供一套成功的发卡流程，可在隔离测试卡上记录命令/响应，结合正式协议逐条还原发卡 profile。其 HCE 服务将读卡器命令发给远端，远端再送真实卡，响应沿原路返回。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcspy-master/src/com/sinpo/nfcspy/ServiceFull.java:54`、`:59`；`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcspy-master/src/com/sinpo/nfcspy/ServiceAgent.java:277`、`:278`]
      - **仅可借鉴：状态字展示。** 字典包含 `6982`、`6A82`、`6A83` 等通用解释，可用于人工核对日志；项目现有状态处理已覆盖本次空 DIR 情况。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcspy-master/res/xml/apdu7816.xml:231`、`:235`、`:246`、`:249`、`:250`]
      - **无关：FMCOS 个性化。** 全库没有 FM1208、FMCOS、`3F00`、`80 E0` 完整 APDU、KEY EF 或 FMCOS 认证实现。XML 只是命令名称字典，解析器仅按 CLA/INS/P1/P2 查名称、按响应末两字节查状态，不定义 Lc/Data/FCP。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcspy-master/src/com/sinpo/nfcspy/ApduParser.java:30`、`:32`、`:36`、`:217`、`:225`]
      - **无关：Type 4 NDEF 实现。** NDEF AID `D2760000850101` 只出现在 HCE 路由列表；代码没有 CC EF、NDEF EF、NLEN 或 NDEF 读写流程，Reader Mode 反而明确使用 `FLAG_READER_SKIP_NDEF_CHECK`。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcspy-master/res/xml/hce_aids.xml:87`；`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcspy-master/src/com/sinpo/nfcspy/NfcManager.java:101`]
      
      APDU 字典中的 `Create File E0` 也不能补齐 FMCOS `80 E0`。该条目位于 bit7 未置位的 CLA 分组，而 CLA `80` 会进入 bit7 置位分组，后者没有 `E0`；即使能显示命令名，也仍没有 FMCOS 专有创建参数。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcspy-master/res/xml/apdu7816.xml:38`、`:88`、`:96`；`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcspy-master/src/com/sinpo/nfcspy/ApduParser.java:161`]
      
      ### 风险、许可证与技术年代
      
      - **禁止盲目中继或回放。** 代码把远端未知 APDU 不加白名单地交给卡片；序列可能包含不可逆的 CREATE、密钥写入或擦除操作，也可能依赖随机挑战、会话密钥、MAC 和计数器，录到的字节不等于可安全重放。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcspy-master/src/com/sinpo/nfcspy/ServiceAgent.java:197`、`:199`]
      - **不要集成 Xposed 路由。** 它 hook `com.android.nfc` 内部类 `HostEmulationManager.findSelectAid`，需要 root/Xposed 或修改系统，强依赖旧 Android 内部实现，与正常 App 内扫描无关。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcspy-master/README.md:27`、`:29`；`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcspy-master/src/com/sinpo/nfcspy/XposedModApduRouting.java:28`、`:30`、`:35`]
      - **许可证为 GPLv3-or-later。** README 和源码头均明确 GPL；直接复制或组合并分发会引入相应开源义务，仓库中的“Additional permission”没有附带可确认的宽松授权文本，因此只借鉴概念，不复制实现。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcspy-master/README.md:33`、`:35`；`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcspy-master/LICENSE:1`、`:2`；`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcspy-master/src/com/sinpo/nfcspy/NfcManager.java:1`、`:14`]
      - **技术基线为 2015 年。** 版本号 `1.0.150710`、target SDK 22，并使用旧式 Ant 工程和 Android 4.4 时代 HCE/Xposed 接口，不宜作为现代 Android NFC 集成模板。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcspy-master/AndroidManifest.xml:5`、`:9`；`/Users/yulun/Downloads/nfcspy-master/project.properties:6`、`:15`]
      
      因此，`nfcspy-master` 能佐证当前卡走的是 IsoDep/APDU，也能提示如何在合法实验环境中观察一套已知成功的发卡流程，但**不能回答如何配置这张空 FMCOS 卡**。配置仍必须依赖该批卡匹配的 `CREATE 80 E0` 数据结构、KEY EF/认证规范和供应商发卡 profile。
      
      ## ohyes-nfc_1.0.5_example 参考评估
      
      ### 结论
      
      该项目对“APP 前台主动扫描”和普通 NDEF 解析有少量参考意义，但不能解决 FM1208/FMCOS 空卡的个性化或业务写入。它是 uni-app 的 Android UTS 读取插件，公开 API 只有启停读取、查询 NFC 状态、打开设置和读取回调。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/ohyes-nfc_1.0.5_example/uni_modules/ohyes-nfc/utssdk/interface.uts:1`、`:7`；`/Users/yulun/Downloads/ohyes-nfc_1.0.5_example/uni_modules/ohyes-nfc/utssdk/app-android/index.uts:13`、`:44`]
      
      全库没有 FM1208、FMCOS、`CREATE 80 E0`、DF/EF/KEY、FMCOS 外部认证、`UPDATE BINARY/RECORD`、Type 4 NDEF AID `D2760000850101`、CC EF `E103` 或 NDEF EF `E104`。也没有 AAR/JAR/SO、厂商 SDK 或隐藏的制卡 API；插件声明无第三方 SDK，依赖列表为空。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/ohyes-nfc_1.0.5_example/uni_modules/ohyes-nfc/readme.md:13`；`/Users/yulun/Downloads/ohyes-nfc_1.0.5_example/uni_modules/ohyes-nfc/package.json:40`]
      
      ### 可借鉴、不可复用与误导点
      
      - **仅可借鉴：前台主动扫描。** 代码通过 `enableReaderMode()` 接收 `Tag`，在页面隐藏时调用 `disableReaderMode()`；这与当前 APP 内主动扫描的生命周期思路一致。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/ohyes-nfc_1.0.5_example/uni_modules/ohyes-nfc/utssdk/app-android/NFCUtil.kt:62`、`:87`、`:111`；`/Users/yulun/Downloads/ohyes-nfc_1.0.5_example/pages/index/index.vue:93`、`:97`] 但它没有 `TECH_DISCOVERED` Activity intent-filter，因此不能作为“未打开 APP 时碰卡唤起”的实现参考。
      - **仅可借鉴：普通 NDEF。** 代码用 Android `Ndef` 读取已有 NDEF，用 `NdefFormatable.format()` 或 `Ndef.writeNdefMessage()` 写入普通标签，并实现 Text/URI/Smart Poster 解析。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/ohyes-nfc_1.0.5_example/uni_modules/ohyes-nfc/utssdk/app-android/NFCUtil.kt:166`、`:250`、`:520`、`:549`] 当前项目已有等价且更符合业务的 NDEF 路径；而该插件的两个写入函数没有从 UTS 接口导出，示例页面也只有读取回调，不能直接用其公开 API 写卡。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/ohyes-nfc_1.0.5_example/uni_modules/ohyes-nfc/utssdk/interface.uts:1`、`:14`；`/Users/yulun/Downloads/ohyes-nfc_1.0.5_example/pages/index/index.vue:104`]
      - **与 FMCOS 无关：IsoDep 只读历史字节。** 非 NDEF 卡分支取得 `IsoDep` 后只返回 `historicalBytes`，完全没有调用 `IsoDep.transceive()`，不会 SELECT MF、读取 DIR 或发送任何 APDU。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/ohyes-nfc_1.0.5_example/uni_modules/ohyes-nfc/utssdk/app-android/NFCUtil.kt:390`、`:409`、`:458`、`:462`] 所以本卡只会显示 `iso_dep` 和历史字节，无法识别为 FMCOS，更无法判断业务 EF、权限或可写性。
      - **结果容易误导。** 非 NDEF FM1208 的 `size/isWritable/freeBytes` 保持初始值 `0/false/0`，这不证明卡片只读或容量为零，只说明插件没有查询 FMCOS 文件系统。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/ohyes-nfc_1.0.5_example/uni_modules/ohyes-nfc/utssdk/app-android/NFCUtil.kt:154`、`:158`、`:161`、`:192`] README 将 ISO-DEP “内容”定义成 Historical Bytes，也明确了这种能力边界。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/ohyes-nfc_1.0.5_example/uni_modules/ohyes-nfc/readme.md:200`、`:202`、`:215`、`:218`]
      - **URI 写入实现不应复制。** `createUriRecord()` 按完整 URI 长度分配 payload，随后却只复制去掉 `https://` 等前缀后的字节，导致 payload 尾部残留多余的零字节。当前项目使用 Android `NdefRecord.createUri()`，应继续保留标准实现。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/ohyes-nfc_1.0.5_example/uni_modules/ohyes-nfc/utssdk/app-android/NFCUtil.kt:489`、`:490`、`:491`、`:514`、`:515`]
      - **认证不可借鉴。** 唯一认证代码是 Mifare Classic 扇区 0 的公开默认 Key A，与 FMCOS 的 KEY EF、DES/3DES challenge-response、安全状态和 MAC 无关。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/ohyes-nfc_1.0.5_example/uni_modules/ohyes-nfc/utssdk/app-android/NFCUtil.kt:420`、`:424`]
      
      ### 集成与许可证判断
      
      本项目是原生 Android Kotlin/Java，而该插件依赖 DCloud UTS 类型和运行时（例如 `io.dcloud.uts.UTSJSONObject`、`UTSAndroid.getUniActivity()`），整体不能直接加入当前 Gradle 模块。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/ohyes-nfc_1.0.5_example/uni_modules/ohyes-nfc/utssdk/app-android/NFCUtil.kt:38`；`/Users/yulun/Downloads/ohyes-nfc_1.0.5_example/uni_modules/ohyes-nfc/utssdk/app-android/index.uts:2`、`:14`] 技术元数据要求 HBuilderX `^4.66`、uni-app `^5.08`，Android 配置文件要求 minSdk 21；`package.json` 却另写 Android minVersion 19，版本信息存在不一致。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/ohyes-nfc_1.0.5_example/uni_modules/ohyes-nfc/package.json:12`、`:64`；`/Users/yulun/Downloads/ohyes-nfc_1.0.5_example/uni_modules/ohyes-nfc/utssdk/app-android/config.json:2`]
      
      目录中没有 LICENSE/COPYING 文件，`package.json` 也没有 `license` 字段且 `repository` 为空；“源码价格 0.00”不等于授予复制、修改或再分发许可。[源码：`/Users/yulun/Downloads/ohyes-nfc_1.0.5_example/uni_modules/ohyes-nfc/package.json:11`、`:17`、`:23`] 因此可以参考 Android 官方 API 的使用思路，但在作者补充明确许可证前，不应复制其源码进入本仓库。
      
      最终判断：保留当前项目的 `TECH_DISCOVERED + IsoDep` 唤起、Reader Mode 主动扫描以及 NDEF/FMCOS 分派；该示例不会补齐 FMCOS 配置。空卡写入仍须取得供应商提供的 `CREATE 80 E0` 完整 Data 结构、KEY EF/认证规范和确定的发卡 profile，不能根据该项目推导或试发命令。
      
      ## FM1216_ps_chs.pdf 资料评估
      
      ### 结论
      
      该 PDF 是《FM1216 系列 CPU 卡芯片产品说明书》（版本 1.4，2013-09），不是 FMCOS 命令、文件系统或发卡个人化手册。全文 13 页，没有 `CREATE 80 E0` 的 P1/P2/Lc/Data、DF/EF/KEY EF 创建参数、`WRITE KEY`、CPU 卡认证/默认密钥、安全属性、`UPDATE BINARY/RECORD`、NFC Forum Type 4 NDEF AID `D2760000850101`、CC EF `E103`、NDEF EF `E104` 或完整发卡流程。因此它不能补齐当前 FM1208 空卡写入所缺的资料，也不能据此安全实现 `writeFmcos()`。
      
      ### 文档实际能够确认的内容
      
      - 第 3 页 1.1、1.2 节说明 FM1216 支持 ISO 14443A 和 ISO 7816、具有 16 KB EEPROM，并称其为 FM1208 非接触 CPU 卡的升级产品；这说明产品定位和底层通信能力，不等于两者采用相同 FMCOS 版本、文件 profile、默认密钥或专有 CREATE 参数。
      - 第 6--7 页第 2 章说明 Type A 选卡后通过是否收到 RATS，在逻辑加密卡流程与 CPU/COS 流程之间切换；第 10 页第 4 章进一步说明 ISO 14443-4 RATS 和 CPU 卡命令由 COS 处理、硬件只负责传输。这能佐证 Android `IsoDep.transceive()` 是正确通道，但没有定义 COS 接受的 APDU。

                      8.1.2 Setting of higher communication speed
                              After receiving an ATS, a PPS request can be sent to the NT4H2421Gx to set up a
                              higher communication speed up to 848 kbit/s according to ISO/IEC 14443-4 [3].
      
                      8.1.3 Half-duplex block transmission protocol
                              NT4H2421Gx uses half-duplex block transmission protocol as specified in ISO/IEC
                              14443-4. It is fully compliant to block format, frame waiting time, frame waiting time
                              extension, protocol operation, and all rules or handling as in [3].
      
                           8.2 User memory
                              The file system in the user memory is according to ISO/IEC 7816-4 and shown in
                              Figure 3. In the DF (application), there are 3 EFs (files) and 5 keys.
      
                                         PICC/MF Level

                      8.2.1 Application and file selection
                              The MF (PICC Level), the DF (application) and the EFs (files) can be selected using the
                              ISOSelectFile command specified in ISO/IEC 7816-4 [4] and described in Section 10.9.1.
                              The PICC level refers to the card itself and has the ISO DF Name D2760000850100h
                              and the File ID 3F00h. The only functionality available on PICC level is an LRP mode
                              authentication using an OriginalityKey and the retrieval of the originality signature using
                              the Read_Sig command, see Section 10.10.1.
      
                      8.2.2 Application Name and ID
                              NT4H2421Gx is pre-configured with one application. The DF name and File ID are as
                              follows:
                              • DF Name: D2760000850101h

                      8.2.3 Files
                            NT4H2421Gx stores user data into EF (files) of specific types. All files are statically
                            created and cannot be deleted. The ChangeFileSettings command can be used to
                            change the access rights configuration.
                            File access rights can be restricted with the keys of the application.

                                                    coding
                            StandardData file       00h                     01h               E103h              32 bytes    CC file
                                                                            02h               E104h              256 bytes   NDEF message, SDM and
                                                                                                                             mirroring supported

                               security
                           • Proprietary-File_Ctrl_TLV
                             – T = 05h, indicates the Proprietary-File_Ctrl_TLV
                             – L = 06h, i.e. 6 bytes
                             – Proprietary-File File Identifier = E105h
                             – Proprietary-File File Size = 0080h, i.e. 128 bytes
                             – Proprietary-File READ Access Condition = 82h, i.e. Limited READ access, granted
                               based on proprietary methods, after authentication with key 2h.
                             – Proprietary-File WRITE Access Condition = 83h, i.e. Limited READWRITE access,
                               granted based on proprietary methods, after authentication with key 3h.
      
                    8.2.3.3 File access rights management
      
                           File data is accessed with 3 different access rights Read, Write and ReadWrite.
                           In addition, an access right called Change is specified per file permitting
                           ChangeFileSettings to change the file access rights.
                           An access right is granted if at least one condition associated to it is satisfied. Such
                           conditions are called access conditions. Access conditions are associated with an access
                           right and evaluated to decide whether the access right is granted or not. There are three
                           kinds of access conditions:
                           • The access condition where a valid authentication with a given AppKey of the targeted
                             application is needed to access related commands listed in Table 9. The access
                             condition is satisfied if the current valid authentication has been performed with the
                             given AppKey and not satisfied in all other cases. The AppKey is specified with its
                             number.
                           • The free access condition meaning the related commands listed in Table 9 can be
                             accessed without an active authentication.
                           • The no access condition meaning no access to related commands listed in Table 9.
                           The access conditions are specified on 4 bits as defined in the following table.
      
                           Table 6. Access condition
                            Condition value                        Description
                            0h..4h                                 key number of a AppKey
                            Eh                                     free access
                            Fh                                     no access or RFU
      
                           The set of access conditions is coded on 2 bytes as shown in the following table. RFU
                           access conditions are expected to be set to Fh (for future extensibility).
      
                           Table 7. Set of Access condition
                            Bit index         Description                                           Value
                            15..12            Read                                                  access condition as in Table 6
                            11..8             Write                                                 access condition as in Table 6
                            7..4              ReadWrite                                             access condition as in Table 6
                            3..0              Change                                                access condition as in Table 6
      
                           The default access conditions for the files in NT4H2421Gx is shown below in .

                    8.2.3.4 SDM related access rights
      
                            A StandardData file can be associated with the following Secure Dynamic Messaging
                            access rights: SDMMetaRead, SDMFileRead and SDMCtrRet. SDMCtrRet is
                            interpreted as the access rights defined according to Table 6 and grants access to the
                            GetFileCounters command. The others have a different interpretation.
                            The SDMMetaRead access does not define access to certain commands, but it defines
                            the mirroring of PICCData, i.e. whether the PICCData will be mirrored in plain, encrypted
                            or not at all, see also Section 9.3.3. This is interpreted according to Table 10.
                            Note that it is still possible to enable plain PICCData mirroring of the UID even if Random
                            ID is enabled. For privacy protection, it is strongly recommended to use only encrypted
                            PICCData mirroring for the UID if Random ID is enabled.

                           The SDMFileRead access right, if related with an AppKey, grants free access to
                           ReadData and ISOReadBinary. The targeted AppKey is used for the Secure Dynamic

                    8.2.3.5 Communication modes
      
                           NT4H2421Gx supports three communication modes as defined in Table 12. As shown
                           in the table, the different communication modes can be represented by two bits. This
                           representation is used at several places in the document.
      
                           Table 12. Supported communication modes
                           Communication                  Bit Representation                            Explanation
                           mode
                           CommMode.Plain                 X0b                                           No protection: message is transmitted in plain
                                                                                                        text
                           CommMode.MAC                   01b                                           MAC protection for integrity and authenticity
                           CommMode.Full                  11b                                           Full protection for integrity, authenticity
                                                                                                        and confidentiality, also referred to as "Full
                                                                                                        Protection" mode
      
                           The communication mode defines the level of security for the communication between
                           PCD and PICC after mutual authentication. At application level, the communication
                           mode is defined by the command itself, as specified in Table 22. The specified
                           communication mode is applied if there is an active authentication regardless of whether
                           this authentication is required by the command or not.
                           At file level, the communication mode is defined by the file. The specified communication
                           mode is applied if there is an active authentication. Note, if the only valid access
                           condition for a certain access right is free access (Eh) under an active authentication,
                           CommMode.Plain has to be applied, see also Section 8.2.3.3.

                      8.2.4 Keys
                           Application keys and PICC keys and their usage are defined in Table 14 and Table 15
                           respectively. They are used to manage the security of the application.
      
                           Table 14. Keys at application level
                            Key Identifier                                 Key number                               Change Key     Can be used for
                                                                                                                                   Authentication
                            Addressable keys:
                            AppMasterKey                                   00h                                      AppMasterKey   yes
                            AppKey                                         00h..04h                                 AppMasterKey   yes
                            SDMMetaReadKey                                 00h..04h                                 AppMasterKey   yes
                            SDMFileReadKey                                 00h..04h                                 AppMasterKey   yes
      
                    8.2.4.1 AppMasterKey
      
                           The AppMasterKey always has the key number 00h. A successful authentication with the
                           AppMasterKey is required to change any application key including the AppMasterKey
                           itself with the ChangeKey command.
      
                    8.2.4.2 AppKey
      
                           The application of the NT4H2421Gx includes 5 AES 128-bit keys with key numbers 0, 1,
                           2, 3, 4. Furthermore, key number "E" (means free) and key number "F" (means never)
                           can be assigned for access rights management.
                           The transport value of these 5 keys is 16 bytes of 00h, and can be changed by
                           authentication with key number 0 in transport configuration.
                           Remark: It is highly recommended to change all 5 keys at personalization, even if not all
                           keys are used in the application.
      
                    8.2.4.3 SDMMetaReadKey
      
                           The SDMMetaReadKey is one of the 5 AppKey. Which key is used is configured via
                           Section 10.7.1 by adjusting the SDMMetaRead access rights, see Section 8.2.3.4.
                           SDMMetaReadKey is used to encrypt PICCData before mirroring.

                    8.2.4.4 SDMFileReadKey
      
                            The SDMFileReadKey is one of the 5 AppKey. Which key is used is configured via
                            Section 10.7.1 by adjusting the SDMFileRead access rights, see Section 8.2.3.4.
                            SDMFileReadKey is used for Secure Dynamic Messaging.
                            As the SDMFileReadKey refers to an AppKey, it is changeable with ChangeKey with an
                            active authentication with the AppMasterKey.
                            As the SDMFileReadKey refers to an AppKey, it is available for authentication.
      
                    8.2.4.5 OriginalityKey
      
                            The authentication procedure for AES keys can be used to authenticate to one of the
                            four OriginalityKey and check whether the PICC is a genuine NXP product. NT4H2421Gx
                            supports targeting the OriginalityKey with the LRP authentication using AES. For details
                            on the authentication command, see Section 9.2. The following variants can be used:
                               Other risk mitigation may be applied for SDM to limit the residual risk, without completely
                               removing it:
                               • Track SDMReadCtr per tag at the verifying side. Reject SDMReadCtr values that have
                                 been seen before or that are played out-of-order. This is a minimum requirement any
                                 verifier should implement.
                               • Limit the time window of an attacker by requiring tags to be presented regularly (e.g. at
                                 least once a day) in combination with the previous mitigation.

                           • Read out the SDM-protected file more than once. This does not protect against

                             responses in the same sequence.
      
                      9.3.1 SDM Read Counter
                           In order to allow replay detection by the party validating the data read, a read counter is
                           associated with the file for which Secure Dynamic Messaging is enabled.
                           SDMReadCtr is a 24-bit unsigned integer. The SDMReadCtr is reset to 000000h when
                           enabling SDM with ChangeFileSettings. In cryptographic calculations and represented
                           with binary encoding on the external interface, the SDMReadCtr is represented LSB first.
                           When represented with ASCII encoding on the contactless interface, it is represented
                           MSB first. Note that this is in line with the NFC counter representation in [14]
                           In not Authenticated state, the SDMReadCtr is incremented by 1 before calculating the
                           response of the first read command, ReadData or ISOReadBinary, if successful. On
                           subsequent read commands targeting the same file, the SDMReadCtr is not increased,
                           and the current value is used. As soon as a different command has been received,
                           the counter is incremented again on a subsequent read command. Also when varying
                           between ReadData and ISOReadBinary, the counter is incremented on each first
                           instance of the read command type. Note that the SDMReadCtr is not incremented when
                           authenticated.
                           If the SDMReadCtr reaches the SDMReadCtrLimit (see Section 9.3.2) or the value
                           FFFFFFh (if SDMReadCtrLimit is not enabled) and a first read command arrives at
                           the PICC, an error is being returned. Command chaining, see Section 8.5, does not
                           additionally affect the counter increase. The chained command is considered as a single
                           command.
                           SDMReadCtr can be retrieved via the mirroring as part of the PICCData, see
                           Section 9.3.3, or it can be retrieved via GetFileCounters.
      
                      9.3.2 SDM Read Counter Limit
                           In order to allow limiting the number of reads that can be done with a single device
                           applying Secure Dynamic Messaging, an optional SDM Read Counter Limit can be
                           configured. There are two main use cases:
                           • limit the number of usages from the card side. Note that typically this can also be
                             controlled from the backend verifying the SDM for Read protected message.
                           • limit the number of traces that can be collected on the symmetric crypto processing.
                             This way potential side channel attacks can be mitigated, see also the Failed
                             Authentication Counter feature for the mutual authentication. In this case, it is
                             recommended to have the configured limit aligned with TotFailCtrLimit.
                           The number of reads that can be executed for an SDM configured file can be limited by
                           setting an SDM Read Counter Limit (SDMReadCtrLimit). This is an unsigned integer of 3
                           bytes, related with SDMReadCtr. On the interface, the SDMReadCtrLimit is represented
                           LSB first. The SDMReadCtrLimit can be enabled by setting a customized value with
                           ChangeFileSettings. It can be retrieved with GetFileSettings.
                           Once the SDMReadCtr equals the SDMReadCtrLimit, no reading of the file with
                           ReadData or ISOReadBinary in not authenticated state can be executed. Note that
                           if authenticated, reading is always possible even if SDMReadCtrLimit is reached,
                           applying the regular secure messaging. If the SDMReadCtrLimit is disabled with
                           ChangeFileSettings, this is also equivalent to putting it to the maximum value: FFFFFFh.

                      9.3.3 PICCData
                           The PICCData holds metadata of the targeted PICC and file, consisting of the UID and/or
                           the SDMReadCtr. Whether PICCData is transmitted in plain or encrypted depends on the
                           configuration of the SDMMetaRead access rights on the file, see Section 8.2.3.4. If the
                           SDMMetaRead access right is configured for free access (Eh), PICCData is plain and is
                           defined according to Table 20.
                           ASCII mirroring is reflected by the function EncodeASCII(), which means that each
                           hexadecimal character of the hexadecimal representation will be ASCII encoded using
                           capitals. For example, the UID 04E141124C2880h becomes: 30h 34h 45h 31h 34h 31h
                           31h 32h 34h 43h 32h 38h 38h 30h.
                           The NT4H2421Gx provides the following command set for File Management functions.

                    10.10 Originality check commands
                           The originality check allows verification of the genuineness of NTAG 424 DNA
                           (NT4H2421Gx). Two ways are offered to check the originality of the PICC: the first
                           is based on a symmetric authentication, the second works on the verification of an
                           asymmetric signature retrieved from the card.
                           The authentication procedure for AES keys can be used to authenticate to one of the
                           four OriginalityKey and check whether the PICC is a genuine NXP product. NT4H2421Gx
                           supports targeting the OriginalityKey with the LRP authentication using AES. For details
                           on the authentication command, see Section 9.2. The following variants can be used:
                           • AuthenticateLRPFirst, see Section 9.2.5
                           • AuthenticateLRPNonFirst, see Section 9.2.6
                           The asymmetric originality signature is based on ECC and only requires a public key for
                           the verification, which is done outside the card. The Read_Sig command can be used
                           in both ISO/IEC 14443-3 and ISO/IEC 14443-4 protocols to retrieve the signature. If
                           the PICC is not configured for Random ID, the command is freely available. There is no
                           authentication required. If the PICC is configured for Random ID, an authentication is
                           required.
      
                   10.10.1 Read_Sig
                           The Read_Sig retrieves the asymmetric originality signature based on an asymmetric
                           cryptographic algorithm Elliptic Curve Cryptography Digital Signature Algorithm
                           (ECDSA), see [13] and can be used in both ISO/IEC 14443-3 and ISO/IEC 14443-4
                           protocol. The purpose of originality check signature is to protect from mass copying of
                           non NXP originated ICs. The purpose of originality check signature is not to completely
                           prevent HW copy or emulation of individual ICs.
                           A public key is required for the verification, which is done outside the card. The
                           NXPOriginalitySignature is computed over the UID and written during manufacturing.
                           If the PICC is not configured for Random ID, the command is freely available. There is
                           no authentication required. If the PICC is configured for Random ID, an authentication
                           with any authentication key is required. If there is an active authentication, the command
                           requires encrypted secure messaging.
                           Remark: The originality function is provided to prove that the IC has been manufactured
                           by NXP Semiconductors.

                      8.2.4 Keys
                           Application keys and PICC keys and their usage are defined in Table 14 and Table 15

                    8.2.4.1 AppMasterKey
      
                           The AppMasterKey always has the key number 00h. A successful authentication with the
                           AppMasterKey is required to change any application key including the AppMasterKey
                           itself with the ChangeKey command.
      
                    8.2.4.2 AppKey
      
                           The application of the NT4H2421Gx includes 5 AES 128-bit keys with key numbers 0, 1,
                           2, 3, 4. Furthermore, key number "E" (means free) and key number "F" (means never)
                           can be assigned for access rights management.
                           The transport value of these 5 keys is 16 bytes of 00h, and can be changed by
                           authentication with key number 0 in transport configuration.
                           Remark: It is highly recommended to change all 5 keys at personalization, even if not all
                           keys are used in the application.
      
                    8.2.4.3 SDMMetaReadKey
      
                           The SDMMetaReadKey is one of the 5 AppKey. Which key is used is configured via
                           Section 10.7.1 by adjusting the SDMMetaRead access rights, see Section 8.2.3.4.
                           SDMMetaReadKey is used to encrypt PICCData before mirroring.

                           configured. There are two main use cases:
                           • limit the number of usages from the card side. Note that typically this can also be
                             controlled from the backend verifying the SDM for Read protected message.
                           • limit the number of traces that can be collected on the symmetric crypto processing.
                             This way potential side channel attacks can be mitigated, see also the Failed
                             Authentication Counter feature for the mutual authentication. In this case, it is
                             recommended to have the configured limit aligned with TotFailCtrLimit.
                           The number of reads that can be executed for an SDM configured file can be limited by
                           setting an SDM Read Counter Limit (SDMReadCtrLimit). This is an unsigned integer of 3
                           bytes, related with SDMReadCtr. On the interface, the SDMReadCtrLimit is represented
                           LSB first. The SDMReadCtrLimit can be enabled by setting a customized value with
                           ChangeFileSettings. It can be retrieved with GetFileSettings.
                           Once the SDMReadCtr equals the SDMReadCtrLimit, no reading of the file with
                           ReadData or ISOReadBinary in not authenticated state can be executed. Note that
                           if authenticated, reading is always possible even if SDMReadCtrLimit is reached,
                           applying the regular secure messaging. If the SDMReadCtrLimit is disabled with
                           ChangeFileSettings, this is also equivalent to putting it to the maximum value: FFFFFFh.

                    9.3.8.2 LRP mode MAC calculation
      
                           The 8-byte SDMMAC is calculated using a CMAC construction on top of the LRP
                           primitive. This is specified in [10].
                           It is identical to the MAC calculation of LRP secure messaging, see Section 9.2.3, also
                           applying the same truncation.
                           Therefore SDMMAC is defined as follows:
                           SDMMAC = MACtLRP (SesSDMFileReadMACKey;
                           DynamicFileData[SDMMACInputOffset ... SDMMACOffset - 1])
                           with DynamicFileData being the file data as how it is put on the contactless interface, i.e.
                           replacing any placeholders by the dynamic data.
      
                      9.3.9 SDM Session Key Generation
                           For Secure Dynamic Messaging for reading, the following session keys are calculated:
                           • SesSDMFileReadMACKey for MACing of file data.
                           • SesSDMFileReadENCKey for encryption of file data
                           The session key generation is according to NIST SP 800-108 [8] in counter mode.
                           The pseudo random function applied during the key generation is the CMAC algorithm
                           described in NIST Special Publication 800-38B [6]. The key derivation key is the
                           SDMFileReadKey as configured with the SDMFileRead access right.
      
                    9.3.9.1 AES mode session key generation for SDM
      
                           The input data is constructed using the following fields as defined by [8]. Note that NIST
                           SP 800-108 allows defining a different order than proposed by the standard as long as it
                           is unambiguously defined.
                           • a 2-byte label, distinguishing the purpose of the key: 3CC3h for MACing and C33Ch for
                             encryption.
                           • a 2-byte counter, fixed to 0001h as only 128-bit keys are generated.
                           • a 2-byte length, fixed to 0080h as only 128-bit keys are generated.
                           • a context, constructed using the UID and/or SDMReadCtr, followed by zero-byte
                             padding if needed.
                           Firstly, the input session vectors SV x are derived as follows:
                           SV1 = C3h || 3Ch || 00h || 01h || 00h || 80h || UID || SDMReadCtr
                           SV2 = 3Ch || C3h || 00h || 01h || 00h || 80h [ || UID] [ || SDMReadCtr] [ || ZeroPadding]
                           Whether or not the UID and/or SDMReadCtr are included in session vector SV2,
                           depends on whether they are mirrored, see Section 9.3.3. Note that in case of encrypting
                           file data, mirroring of both is mandatory.
                           Therefore they are always included in SV1.
                           Padding with zeros is done up to a multiple of 16 bytes. So in case of 7-byte UID and
                           both elements are mirrored, no padding is added. Then, the 16-byte session keys are
                           constructed as follows:
                           SesSDMFileReadENCKey = MAC(SDMFileReadKey; SV1)
                           SesSDMFileReadMACKey = MAC(SDMFileReadKey; SV2)

      3.4 SUN Mirroring
      
      
      3.4.1 PICCData mirror
      PICCData consists of UID and SMDCounter. UID, SDMCounter and CMAC are always co-existing, meaning
      that by enabling/disabling PICCData mirror, all are mirrored or not. Their mirror offsets within NDEF can be
      individually chosen for UID and SDMCounter. CMAC shall be appended to the end of NDEF.
      
      
      Prerequisites:             • n/a
      Offset name:               • UIDOffset,
                                 • SDMReadCtrOffset,
                                 • CMACinputOffset
      Length [bytes]:            • UIDOffsetLength: 14,
                                 • SDMReadCtrOffsetLength: 6,
                                 • CMACOffsetLength: 16
      
      Example SUN mapping:
      https://ntag.nxp.com/424?uid=04C767F2066180&ctr=000001&c=54A45B2C3A558765
      
      How to verify the CMAC of the SUN is described in chapter [Section 3.4.4.2] - different data is used for
      computation.
      
      3.4.2 PICCData Encrypted mirror
      Note: With encryption of PICCData, we encrypt UID and NFCCounter. Therefore verification side does not have
      immediate info on UID, which is usually used as input for key derivation function. In this case, KSDMMetaRead key
      shall not be UID diversified and high attention on secure storage on system level of this key is required.
      
      3.4.2.1 Encryption of PICCData
      
      
      Prerequisites:             SDMMetaReadKey set to App.KeyX (0x0 - 0x4)
      Offset name:               PICCENCDataOffset
      Length [bytes]:            32*n; n=1,2,..., n
      Algorithm:                 PICCENCData = E(KSDMMetaRead; PICCDataTag [ || UID ][ ||SDMReadCtr ] || Random
                                        [1]
                                 Padding )
      
      Example SUN mapping:
      https://ntag.nxp.com/424?e=EF963FF7828658A599F3041510671E88&c=94EED9EE65337086

      Only changing of keys nr. 0x2 and 0x0 are shown in the following step. It is highly recommended to configure all

      6 Special functionalities
      
      6.1 Configuration of NDEF application and PICC attributes
      Special command: SetConfiguration
      Authentication with key AppMasterKey is needed
      CommMode.Full needed
      
      It is possible to configure:
      • Enable RandomID
      • Disable chaining with WriteData
      • Enable LRP mode (irreversible)
      • Failed authentication counter configuration
      • Enable Strong back modulation
      
      6.2 Random ID - RID
      This feature is used to retain end consumer privacy, avoid tracking and to meet latest GDPR regulations. In the
      combination with PICCData encryption, the real NTAG 424's UID cannot be revealed, the PICC responds with
      random ID (4 bytes) during ISO14443-3 anticollision.
      Note:
      • If Random ID feature is enabled, the ATQA value is changed to 0x0304 (default is 0x0344).
      • Enabling Random ID feature is irreversible process - meaning that it cannot be disabled once it is enabled.
      
      Prerequisites:          Active Authentication with the AppMasterKey (AppKey00)
      CommMode:               FULL

      6.5 TagTamper
      NTAG 424 DNA TagTamper offers an NFC Forum-compliant solution to reflect, if the sealing of a product is
      opened. This works without a dedicated app on the NFC reader/writer device. It only requires the capability
      of reading out NFC Forum Type 4 Tag [4]. NTAG 424 DNA TagTamper has four pads. Two pads are used for
      antenna connection and the other two used to connect a detection wire. At start-up, the IC checks that the tag
      tamper wire. If opened, this will be recorded as permanent status in NVM (TTPermStatus). The result can be
      mirrored in the NDEF message.
      Measurement is done automatically during the boot-up of the NTAG 424 NDA. It will be only done during
      processing of the first ISO/IEC 14443-4 command after complete activation, if the current TTPermStatus is still
      set to Close. It does not have any influence on any ISO standard time constraints. If PICC detects open tamper
      loop, TTPermStatus is updated. Measurement on the boot will not be triggered anymore.
      In addition, a specific command (Cmd.GetTTStatus) triggers tamper loop measurement and the Tag returns
      both the permanent (TTPermStatus) and current status (TTCurrStatus) of the tamper loop connection. NTAG
      424 DNA is a passive tag powered by an RF field, therefore it cannot trigger measurement by itself. Physical
      design of a final tag application with counter measures should be used to mitigate fraudulent use - as opening
      and fixing the tamper loop / seal in between measurements.

      6.6 SDMReadCtr Limit
      The SDMReadCtrLimit can be enabled by setting a customized value with Cmd.ChangeFileSettings. It can
      be retrieved with Cmd.GetFileSettings. This way reading of the NDEF file can be limited after SDMReadCtr
      reaches SDMReadCtrLimit. When SDMReadCtrLimit is reached, no reading with Cmd.ReadData or
      Cmd.ISOReadBinary can be executed. This feature can be a potential risk for DoS attacks.
      Main use cases:
      • To limit usage/tap number of a single PICC
      • To limit conditions for Secure Dynamic Messaging side channel attacks
      Feature can be disabled by Cmd.ChangeFileSettings, or by setting the SDMReadCtrLimit value to FFFFFF.

      7 Originality Signature Verification
      
      7.1 Symmetric check
      Four (4) secret originality keys (also named as PICC Keys) are present on each individual NTAG 424 DNA, type
      of AES-128:
      • Are written on the IC at the production in the NXP factory
      • Keys are created in NXP Fabs HSM and never leave secure environment
      • Cannot be changed after the IC leaves the NXP factory
      • Originality Check is done by executing a successful LRP Authentication (not AES!) with one of the Originality
        keys. LRP mode needs to be enabled with command Cmd.SetConfiguration.
      • These keys are shared only towards NXP's licensees
        Sharing procedure of these keys is written in the data sheet [1].

      8 System implementation concepts
      Most common system used with NTAG 424 DNA is pictured below.
      
      
      
      
       Figure 13. NFC and cloud integration
      
      
      8.1 Online system
      This kind of system is possible with NFC device broadband connectivity (data transfer) and robust backend
      system - usually cloud based service. By this approach, no keys need to be stored on NFC device, thus no
      secure element is used on NFC device. It is used only for relaying messages between cloud and the NTAG. It is
      advisable that all the keys (or master key) are securely stored on backend's HSM.

      8.2 Offline system
      Offline systems usually target closed loop, offline authentication applications. Application provides a proof of
      authenticity of the Tag or the product to which the Tag is applied to.
      For optimal secure solution, host side needs to have:
      • AES-128 or LRP crypto algorithm implemented
      • secure key storage (e.g. Secure element)
        NXP's Secure Access Module fully supports all NTAG 424 DNA features and crypto, for more refer to [11].

                           9.3 Secure Dynamic Messaging
                               The Secure Dynamic Messaging (SDM) allows for confidential and integrity protected
                               data exchange, without requiring a preceding authentication. NT4H2421Gx supports
                               SDM for reading from one of the StandardData files on the PICC. Secure Dynamic
                               Messaging allows adding security to the data read, while still being able to access it with
                               standard NDEF readers. The typical use case is an NDEF holding a URI and some meta-
                               data, where SDM allows this meta-data to be communicated confidentiality and integrity
                               protected toward a backend server.
                               When using SDM, residual risks coming with the Secure Dynamic Messaging for
                               Reading have to be taken into account. As SDM allows free reading of the secured
                               message, i.e. without any up-front reader authentication, anybody can read out the
                               message. This means that also a potential attacker is able to read out and store one ore
                               multiple messages, and play them at a later point in time to the verifier.
                               If this residual risk is not acceptable for the system’s use case, the legacy mutual
                               authentication (using challenge response protocol) and subsequent secure messaging
                               should be applied. This would require using an own application and operating outside a
                               standard NDEF read operation.
                               Other risk mitigation may be applied for SDM to limit the residual risk, without completely
                               removing it:
                               • Track SDMReadCtr per tag at the verifying side. Reject SDMReadCtr values that have
                                 been seen before or that are played out-of-order. This is a minimum requirement any
                                 verifier should implement.
                               • Limit the time window of an attacker by requiring tags to be presented regularly (e.g. at
                                 least once a day) in combination with the previous mitigation.

                           • Read out the SDM-protected file more than once. This does not protect against
                             attackers that have read out the valid tag also multiple times and play the received
                             responses in the same sequence.
      
                      9.3.1 SDM Read Counter
                           In order to allow replay detection by the party validating the data read, a read counter is
                           associated with the file for which Secure Dynamic Messaging is enabled.
                           SDMReadCtr is a 24-bit unsigned integer. The SDMReadCtr is reset to 000000h when
                           enabling SDM with ChangeFileSettings. In cryptographic calculations and represented
                           with binary encoding on the external interface, the SDMReadCtr is represented LSB first.
                           When represented with ASCII encoding on the contactless interface, it is represented
                           MSB first. Note that this is in line with the NFC counter representation in [14]
                           In not Authenticated state, the SDMReadCtr is incremented by 1 before calculating the
                           response of the first read command, ReadData or ISOReadBinary, if successful. On
                           subsequent read commands targeting the same file, the SDMReadCtr is not increased,
                           and the current value is used. As soon as a different command has been received,
                           the counter is incremented again on a subsequent read command. Also when varying
                           between ReadData and ISOReadBinary, the counter is incremented on each first
                           instance of the read command type. Note that the SDMReadCtr is not incremented when
                           authenticated.
                           If the SDMReadCtr reaches the SDMReadCtrLimit (see Section 9.3.2) or the value
                           FFFFFFh (if SDMReadCtrLimit is not enabled) and a first read command arrives at
                           the PICC, an error is being returned. Command chaining, see Section 8.5, does not
                           additionally affect the counter increase. The chained command is considered as a single
                           command.
                           SDMReadCtr can be retrieved via the mirroring as part of the PICCData, see
                           Section 9.3.3, or it can be retrieved via GetFileCounters.
                           • the PICC supports ISO/IEC 14443-4 chaining to allow larger command or response
                             frames than the supported buffer size for variants of the following commands:
                             – Native commands wrapped into ISO/IEC 7816-4 APDU: ReadData, WriteData, see
                               Section 10.
                             – Standard ISO/IEC 7816-4 commands: ISOReadBinary, ISOUpdateBinary
                               i.e. every command where larger frame size can occur.
                           • the PICC will automatically split a response in several frames to fit with the FSD frame
                             size supported by the PCD and communicated in the RATS.
                           When a PCD applies ISO/IEC 14443-4 chaining, see [3], it needs to assure the
                           reassembled INF field containing the command header (i.e. ISO/IEC 7816-4 header
                           bytes and/or (Cmd || CmdHeader)) fits within the PICC’s buffer (FSC) communicated in
                           the ATS. If not, the PICC may respond with LENGTH_ERROR.
                           The ISO/IEC 14443-4 chaining does not influence the secure messaging. This means
                           that the secure messaging mechanisms are applied as if the command or response
                           would have been sent in a single large frame. With regards to command execution,
                           commands are handled as if they were received in one large frame, except for write
                           commands where the total frame size can be larger than the supported FSC (WriteData
                           and ISOUpdateBinary). In this case, command execution is started before the complete
                           command is received.
                           Note that this is important for StandardData files, where the file may end up in an
                           undefined state if the command is not completed successfully, see Section 8.6.

                           8.6 Backup management
                               NT4H2421Gx supports hardware based anti-tearing on single frame write operations.
                               This means that blocks up to 128 bytes are either completely written of not changed at
                               all.
      
                           8.7 Product originality
                               NT4H2421Gx supports two types of originality check: one based on an LRP
                               authentication with AES originality keys and another one with a static signature
                               verification with an ECC public key. For detail of the ECC originality check, refer to
                               originality check commands.
                               The AES-based originality verification using AuthenticateLRPFirst or
                               AuthenticateLRPNonFirst is done with one of the OriginalityKey described in
                               Section 8.2.4.

      9        Secure Messaging
                           Prior to data transmission a mutual three-pass authentication can be done between PICC
                           and PCD which results in the generation of session keys used in the secure messaging.
                           There are three secure messaging types available in the NT4H2421Gx including Secure
                           Dynamic Messaging. One is using AES-128 and is referred to as AES mode in this data
                           sheet. The other one is using AES-128 with a Leakage Resilient Primitive (LRP) wrapper,
                           also referred to as LRP mode. The LRP mode can be permanently enabled using the
                           SetConfiguration command. After this switch, it is not possible to revert back to AES
                           mode.
                           Compared to AES mode, the LRP mode has the advantage that it provides strong
                           resistance against side-channel and fault attacks. It serves as a replacement for
                           AES as it only uses standard cryptographic constructions based on AES without any
                           proprietary cryptography. Thus, LRP can be seen as an alternative for AES which is
                           itself based on AES, and is provably as secure as AES, but comes with better properties
                           w.r.t. implementation security, see also [10]. The PCD requires the same LRP mode
                           implementation.
                           To improve the resistance against side-channel attacks and especially card only attacks
                           for the AES mode, NT4H2421Gx provides a limit for unsuccessful authentication
                           attempts. Every unsuccessful authentication is counted in the TotFailCtr. The parameters
                           TotFailCtrLimit TotFailCtrDecr can be configured as described in Section 10.5.1 using the
                           "Failed authentication counter configuration".
                           Each unsuccessful authentication is counted internally in the total failed authentication
                           counter TotFailCtr. After reaching the TotFailCtrLimit, see Section 10.5.1, the related key
                           cannot be used for authentication anymore.
                           In addition, after reaching a limit of consecutive unsuccessful authentication
                           attempts, the NT4H2421Gx starts to slow down the authentication processing in
                           order to hamper attacks. This is done by rejecting any authentication command
                           with a AUTHENTICATION_DELAY response. The response time of a single
                           AUTHENTICATION_DELAY response is depending on the FWT, see Section 8.1.1, and
                           is about 65% of the maximum response time specified by FWT. The error response is
                           sent until the total authentication delay time is reached which is equal to the sum of the
                           frame delay times. The total authentication delay time increases with each unsuccessful
                           authentication attempt up to a maximum value, only a successful authentication restores
                           the full operational speed.
                           Changing a blocked AES key by authenticating with the AppMasterKey and using the
                           ChangeKey command makes the referenced key accessible again. If the AppMasterKey
                           itself is blocked, no recovery is possible.
                           Each successful AES authentication decrements the TotFailCtr by a value of
                           TotFailCtrDecr.
                           The AES and LRP authentications are initiated by commands sharing the same
                           command code (First Authentication and Non-First Authentication variants). These
                           authentication protocols are both AES-based, but differ with regards to the actual
                           protocol applied and the subsequent secure messaging mode they initiate. An overview
                           of the different modes is given in Figure 5.

      # NTAG 424 DNA Key 0 与 APP 防复制研究
      
      ## 结论
      
      Android APP 可以利用 NTAG 424 DNA 做有效的防复制检测，但不能只判断 UID，也不应把长期 AES 密钥直接放进 APK。普通扫码场景推荐使用：
      
      1. 每张卡使用独立（diversified）的应用密钥；
      2. NDEF 开启 SDM，输出加密的 UID/读计数器和 SDMMAC；
      3. APP 只读取并转交 SDM 数据；
      4. 后端/HSM 验证 CMAC、解析卡身份，并原子地检查每张卡的计数器；
      5. 对重复或回退的计数器判为重放，对异常大幅跳变、并发首次提交等情况结合业务规则处置。
      
      这能识别普通内存复制和重复播放旧链接，但不是绝对的“不可复制”。如果业务不能接受 SDM 已采集响应被抢先使用、实时中继或单卡硬件模拟的剩余风险，应由专用 APP 通过 `IsoDep` 执行在线挑战-响应认证和安全消息；长期主密钥仍应留在后端/HSM，APP 只中继认证 APDU 或使用受控的安全硬件。
      
      ## Key 0 到底是什么
      
      NTAG 424 DNA 的应用中有五个可更改的 AES-128 密钥，编号为 `00h` 到 `04h`。`Key 0` 的官方名称是 `AppMasterKey`；“Key O”是把数字零写成了字母 O，不是官方名称。
      
      需要纠正“Key 1 固定负责 SDM、Key 2~4 固定负责读写”的说法：芯片没有固化这种分工。文件的 Read、Write、ReadWrite、Change 权限，以及 SDM 的 `SDMMetaRead`、`SDMFileRead` 权限，都可以引用 AppKey 0~4 中的某一把密钥。因此 Key 1~4 的实际角色由个性化配置决定。
      
      另外，芯片还有四把由 NXP 写入且不可更改的 PICC 级 `OriginalityKey1..4`。它们用于制造商原始性机制，不属于上述五把客户 AppKey，不能混为一谈。
      
      依据：[NTAG 424 DNA 数据手册](https://www.nxp.com/docs/en/data-sheet/NT4H2421Gx.pdf) §8.2.4、表 14（第 14~15 页），§8.2.3.3~8.2.3.4、表 6~11（第 11~13 页），§8.2.4.5、表 15（第 15 页）。
      
      ## Key 0 的权限边界
      
      - `ChangeKey` 要求先用 AppMasterKey（Key 0）认证，并使用 Full 通信模式。Key 0 因而控制五把应用密钥的更新。
      - `SetConfiguration` 同样要求 AppMasterKey 认证和 Full 通信模式。
      - `ChangeFileSettings` 并非永远要求 Key 0，而是要求该文件当前 `Change` 权限指定的密钥。出厂时三个文件的 Change 权限都指向 Key 0，所以初始配置通常确实要用 Key 0。
      - 文件内容的读写权限由各文件访问条件决定，不能简单地把 Key 0 理解为可无条件读写所有内容的“万能超级管理员”。
      
      依据：数据手册 §10.6.1、表 63（第 62~63 页），§10.5.1（第 55~57 页），§10.7.1、表 69/71（第 65~68 页）；[AN12196](https://www.nxp.com/docs/en/application-note/AN12196.pdf) §6.1（第 40 页）。
      
      ## SDM 的配置与密钥
      
      SDM 只能在 NDEF 文件 02 上启用，出厂状态为关闭。`ChangeFileSettings` 的 FileOption bit 6 控制 SDM 开关；SDMOptions 决定是否镜像 UID、读计数器、加密文件数据、计数器上限及 ASCII 输出等；SDMAccessRights 决定具体使用哪把 AppKey：
      
      - `SDMMetaReadKey`：用于加密镜像的 PICCData（可包含 UID 和计数器）；
      - `SDMFileReadKey`：用于派生 SDM 会话 ENC/MAC 密钥，生成 SDMMAC，并可加密文件数据。
      
      依据：数据手册 §8.2.3.1（第 10 页），§9.3.3~9.3.9（第 36~43 页），§10.7.1、表 69（第 65~67 页）；AN12196 §3.3~3.4（第 8~18 页）。
      
      ## 默认密钥与个性化
      
      五把客户 AppKey 的出厂值均为 16 字节 `00h`。NXP 明确建议在个性化时更改全部五把密钥，包括暂时未使用的密钥，而不是只改 Key 0。
      
      “第一步永远先改 Key 0”也不是 NXP 的规则。由于后续 `ChangeKey` 依赖 Key 0 认证，实际流程应由发卡事务设计保证可恢复性；NXP 示例先更改另一把应用密钥，再更改 Key 0。关键要求是离开受控个性化环境前，所有默认密钥均已替换、权限已收紧并完成验证。
      
      依据：数据手册 §8.2.4.2（第 14 页）；AN12196 §5.16、§5.16.1~5.16.2（第 38~39 页）。
      
      ## “永久锁死整卡”说法不准确
      
      已核对的 NXP 资料中没有通用的 `Set Lock Byte` / `Freeze` 命令，可在一次操作后永久冻结 NTAG 424 DNA 的所有配置。可确认的不可逆或不可恢复行为是局部的：
      
      - 把某文件的 Change 访问条件设为 `F` 后，后续无法再获得修改该文件设置的权限，相当于永久冻结该文件设置，而不是锁死整卡；
      - 启用 LRP 是永久操作；
      - 当前 AN12196 说明启用 Random ID 不可逆；
      - AppMasterKey 达到配置的失败认证上限而被阻断后，无法恢复。
      
      因此产品方案若要使用“永久锁定”一词，必须准确指出被锁定的是哪项文件设置或配置位，并针对具体芯片版本验证，不能笼统宣称存在全局 Lock Byte。
      
      依据：数据手册表 6（第 11 页）、表 71（第 68 页）、§9（第 20 页）、SetConfiguration 表 50（第 56 页）；AN12196 §6.1~6.2（第 40 页）。
      
      ## APP 防复制方案
      
      ### 推荐：SDM + 在线后端验证
      
      一次未认证的 NDEF 读取可让芯片生成带 UID/计数器的动态数据及 CMAC。APP 将完整 URL/字段提交后端，后端使用每卡密钥或由 HSM 中主密钥派生的每卡密钥进行验证。
      
      后端至少要保存每张卡已接受的最大计数器（或已见集合），通过原子 compare-and-set 避免并发竞态。策略通常接受“有效且大于已接受值”的计数器，不宜强制必须恰好 `+1`，因为其他手机或攻击性扫描也会推进计数器。启用 SDM 时计数器会复位，重新配置/换卡时必须同步处理服务端状态。
      
      NXP 明确指出：任何人都能采集一个有效 SDM 响应并重放；服务端跟踪每卡 `SDMReadCtr`，拒绝重复或乱序值，是最低要求。因此：
      
      - 复制静态 NDEF/UID 的卡无法生成后续有效 CMAC，容易检测；
      - 重放已经被服务端接受的响应可由计数器检测；
      - 攻击者预先采集多个未来计数器值，可能抢先使用尚未提交的有效响应；
      - 首次提交者是谁无法仅靠 CMAC 判断，实时 relay 也不由 SDM 自动解决；
      - 计数器是 24 位，还要设计耗尽、异常跳变、重置和拒绝服务策略。
      
      依据：数据手册 §9.3（第 34~35 页）、§9.3.1~9.3.2（第 35~36 页）；AN12196 §8.1（第 49 页）。
      
      ### 更高保证：APP 发起动态双向认证
      
      风险不可接受时，NXP 建议使用挑战-响应双向认证及安全消息，而不是只使用标准 NDEF 的 SDM。Android 可通过 `IsoDep.transceive()` 与标签交换原生 APDU，并让后端/HSM 参与 `AuthenticateEV2`/LRP 会话和后续安全消息计算。这样每次验证都包含验证方的新鲜随机数，不依赖可长期保存的静态 URL。
      
      完全离线也可以做双向认证，但验证端必须持有 AES/LRP 能力和对应卡密钥。把全卡共用的原始密钥写进 APK 风险很高；Android Keystore 的硬件保护能力随设备而异，也不能替代统一受控的 HSM/SAM。若确实要求离线，应优先使用每卡多样化密钥，并评估专用 Secure Element/SAM、设备绑定、密钥轮换及 APP 被攻破后的影响范围。
      
      依据：数据手册 §9.3（第 34 页）；AN12196 §5.16.1（第 38 页）、§8.2（第 50 页）。
      
      ## Originality Signature 能做什么
      
      `Read_Sig` 返回 NXP 在制造时对 UID 生成的 56 字节 ECDSA secp224r1 签名，可用 NXP 公钥离线验证。它适合作为“芯片是否由 NXP 制造”的辅助信号和发卡录入检查，但不应作为唯一防复制依据。
      
      NXP 明确说明，该签名用于抵抗把内容批量复制到非 NXP 芯片，并不旨在完全阻止对某一颗芯片的硬件复制或模拟。签名是静态的，也不能证明标签仍附着在原商品上；模拟者如果同时呈现原 UID 与签名，单独验证签名无法发现。
      
      依据：数据手册 §10.10~10.10.1（第 83~84 页）；AN12196 §7.2（第 47~48 页）。
      
      ## 建议的落地基线
      
      1. 在受控环境中为每张卡派生不同的 AppKey，替换全部全零默认密钥；主密钥只进入 HSM/SAM。
      2. 保护 NDEF 写权限和 Change 权限；按实际需求分配 AppKey，而不是依赖“Key 1 固定做 SDM”的假设。
      3. 普通用户触碰采用 SDM：加密 UID + ReadCtr + SDMMAC，后端完成认证和原子防重放。
      4. 首次发卡时读取并验证 Originality Signature，将其作为辅助供应链信号。
      5. 高价值操作改为专用 APP 的在线动态双向认证；结合账号、设备、时间窗和风险控制，不把 NFC 密码学当作“标签仍在原物品上”的唯一证据。
      
      ## 官方资料
      
      - NXP, [NTAG 424 DNA - Secure NFC T4T compliant IC, NT4H2421Gx, Rev. 3.0](https://www.nxp.com/docs/en/data-sheet/NT4H2421Gx.pdf), 2019-01-31.
      - NXP, [AN12196 - NTAG 424 DNA and NTAG 424 DNA TagTamper features and hints, Rev. 2.0](https://www.nxp.com/docs/en/application-note/AN12196.pdf), 2025-03-04.

## Assistant

可以。NTAG 424 DNA 能让 APP 有效识别普通复制卡和重放数据，但准确说是“检测复制卡的使用行为”，不能保证发现所有复制行为，也不能防住实时 NFC 中继。

先纠正原说明中的几个关键点：

- 正确名称是数字 `Key 0`，不是字母 `Key O`；官方名称为 `AppMasterKey`。
- Key 0 负责 `ChangeKey` 和 `SetConfiguration`，但不是可以无条件读写所有文件的“万能超级管理员”。文件设置由当前的 `Change` 权限控制，出厂时该权限恰好是 Key 0。
- Key 1 并非芯片固定的 SDM 密钥，Key 2～4 也没有固定的读写职责。`SDMMetaReadKey`、`SDMFileReadKey`、Read、Write、Change 都可以配置为引用 Key 0～4 中的任意一把。
- 五把 AppKey 的出厂值确实都是 16 字节全零；NXP 建议个性化时全部更换，而不仅是 Key 0。
- 官方没有一个名为 `Set Lock Byte` 的“全局锁死整卡”命令。可以把某个文件的 `Change` 权限设成 `F`，永久冻结该文件设置；Random ID、LRP 也有各自的不可逆配置，但不能混称为全局锁定位。

**推荐的 APP 防复制方案**

```text
NTAG 424 DNA
  └─ 每次读取产生 UID + ReadCounter + SDMMAC
                         │
                         ▼
Android APP 读取完整动态数据，不持有生产密钥
                         │
                         ▼
服务端 / HSM
  ├─ 解密 PICCData
  ├─ 取得真实 UID 和计数器
  ├─ 计算并验证 SDMMAC
  └─ 原子检查该 UID 的历史计数器
```

服务端验证顺序建议为：

1. 校验数据格式和 SDMMAC。
2. 解密或解析真实 UID、`SDMReadCtr`。
3. 查询该 UID 对应的卡片记录。
4. 原子判断计数器是否已使用或发生回退。
5. 验证通过后再更新最大已接受计数器。
6. 结合账号、设备、时间、地点和异常跳变做风险判断。

计数器通常应接受“有效且大于历史值”，不宜强制必须恰好 `+1`，因为正常情况下其他手机扫描也会推进计数器。并发提交必须使用数据库事务或 compare-and-set，否则同一个响应可能同时通过。

| 方案 | 能力 | 主要限制 |
|---|---|---|
| 只比较 UID | 很弱 | UID 可以被模拟或回放 |
| ECC Originality Signature | 验证芯片是否由 NXP 制造 | 签名是静态的，不能完全防止单卡模拟 |
| SDM + 服务端 CMAC/计数器 | 推荐，可识别静态复制和已使用响应 | 未提交的预采集响应、首次使用和实时中继仍有风险 |
| APP 双向认证 + Secure Messaging | 更高保证，使用新鲜随机挑战 | 实现复杂，密钥必须放在 HSM、SAM 或安全硬件中 |

需要特别注意：SDM 允许任何人读取动态消息，所以攻击者也可以预先采集若干合法响应。NXP 明确要求验证端至少跟踪每张卡的 `SDMReadCtr`，拒绝重复或乱序计数器。如果攻击者抢先提交一个尚未使用的合法响应，仅凭 SDM 无法判断读取者是谁；实时 relay 也不会因为 CMAC 正确就被发现。

如果这是高价值业务，例如支付、领券核销、设备授权或高价商品鉴真，建议使用专用 APP 通过 `IsoDep` 执行 `AuthenticateEV2`/LRP 双向认证和安全消息。生产 AES 主密钥不要写入 APK；普通 Android Keystore 也不等同于统一受控的 HSM/SAM。APP 最好只负责 NFC 通信和数据转交。

完整核对结果、官方章节和链接已经整理到 [ntag424_dna_anti_clone_research.md](/Users/yulun/TestForGradle/docs/NTAG424/ntag424_dna_anti_clone_research.md)。资料基于 NXP `NT4H2421Gx` 数据手册和 `AN12196`；未修改应用代码，文档检查已通过。

              android.util.Log.i(

              )

                  v.setPadding(systemBars.left, systemBars.top, systemBars.right, systemBars.bottom)
                  insets
              }
              nfcTestBinding.toNfcSetting.setOnClickListener {
                  BuyerNFCUtil.Util.toOpenNfc(this)
              }
              nfcTestBinding.fm1208Url.setText(Fm1208NdefClient.DEFAULT_BUSINESS_URL)
              nfcTestBinding.fm1208Package.setText(Fm1208NdefClient.DEFAULT_APPLICATION_PACKAGE)
              nfcTestBinding.readFm1208.setOnClickListener {
                  operation = Operation.READ
                  logOperationArmed(operation)
                  nfcTestBinding.nfcRecord.text = "已选择自动读取（NDEF / FMCOS），请将卡片贴近手机"
              }
              nfcTestBinding.writeNdef.setOnClickListener {
                  operation = Operation.WRITE_NDEF
                  logOperationArmed(operation)
                  nfcTestBinding.nfcRecord.text = "已选择写入 NDEF，请将 NDEF 卡片贴近手机"
              }
              nfcTestBinding.writeFmcos.setOnClickListener {
                  operation = Operation.WRITE_FMCOS
                  logOperationArmed(operation)
                  nfcTestBinding.nfcRecord.text = "已选择更新 FMCOS，请将已初始化的测试卡贴近手机"
              }
              nfcTestBinding.initializeFmcosTest.setOnClickListener {

                      )
