                          logOperationArmed(operation)
                          nfcTestBinding.nfcRecord.text =
                              "已授权初始化 UID 77:E9:CC:7D；请将指定测试卡贴近手机"
                      }
                      .show()
              }
              handleColdLaunch(intent)
          }
      
          override fun onNewIntent(intent: Intent) {
              super.onNewIntent(intent)
              android.util.Log.i(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX onNewIntent action=${intent.action}, flags=${intent.flags}")
              setIntent(intent)
              if (handleColdLaunch(intent)) return
              intent.getParcelableExtra<Tag>(NfcAdapter.EXTRA_TAG)?.let(::handleCard)
          }
      
          override fun onStart() {
              super.onStart()
              mNfcAdapter = NfcAdapter.getDefaultAdapter(this)
              val flags = PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.S) {
                  PendingIntent.FLAG_MUTABLE
              } else {
                  0
              }
              mPendingIntent = PendingIntent.getActivity(
                  this, 0, Intent(this, javaClass),
                  flags
              )
          }
      
          override fun onResume() {
              super.onResume()
              val filters = arrayOf(IntentFilter(NfcAdapter.ACTION_TECH_DISCOVERED))
              val techLists = arrayOf(
                  arrayOf(Ndef::class.java.name),
                  arrayOf(NdefFormatable::class.java.name),
                  arrayOf(IsoDep::class.java.name, NfcA::class.java.name)
              )
              mNfcAdapter?.enableForegroundDispatch(this, mPendingIntent, filters, techLists)
              nfcTestBinding.nfcEnable.text = "当前NFC状态：${if (BuyerNFCUtil.Util.isNfcEnabled(this)) "已开启" else "未开启"}"
              nfcTestBinding.nfcSupport.text = "当前设备是否支持NFC：${if (BuyerNFCUtil.Util.isNfcSupported(this)) "支持" else "不支持"}"
          }
      
          override fun onPause() {
              super.onPause()
              mNfcAdapter?.disableForegroundDispatch(this)
          }
      
          override fun onDestroy() {
              cardExecutor.shutdownNow()
              super.onDestroy()
          }
      
          private fun handleCard(tag: Tag) {
              val scanId = scanSequence.incrementAndGet()
              val detectedAt = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
              val selectedOperation = operation
              val url = nfcTestBinding.fm1208Url.text.toString().trim()
              val packageName = nfcTestBinding.fm1208Package.text.toString().trim()
              android.util.Log.i(
                  LOG_TAG,
                  "$LOG_PREFIX scan=$scanId handleCard operation=$selectedOperation, " +
                      "uid=${tag.id.toHex()}, tech=${tag.techList.joinToString()}"
              )
              nfcTestBinding.nfcInfo.text = "FM1208 通信中...\nUID: ${tag.id.toHex()}"
              cardExecutor.execute {
                  android.util.Log.i(
                      LOG_TAG,
                      "$LOG_PREFIX scan=$scanId task started operation=$selectedOperation, " +
                          "queueDelayMs=${SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - detectedAt}"
                  )
                  val result = runCatching {
                      when (selectedOperation) {
                          Operation.READ -> when (val content = Fm1208CardClient.read(tag)) {
                              is Fm1208CardClient.Content.NdefContent ->
                                  "NDEF 读取成功 (${content.recordCount} records)\n" +
                                      "URI: ${content.uri ?: "无"}\n包名: ${content.applicationPackage ?: "无"}"
                              is Fm1208CardClient.Content.FmcosContent -> {
                                  val profile = content.profile
                                  val applications = profile.applications.joinToString("\n") { entry ->
                                      "#${entry.recordNumber} AID=${entry.aid ?: "无"} label=${entry.label ?: "无"}"
                                  }.ifEmpty { "无已登记应用" }
                                  "FMCOS 读取成功\nMF: ${profile.masterFileName ?: "未知"}\n" +
                                      "DIR SFI: ${profile.directorySfi ?: "未知"}\n应用:\n$applications\n" +
                                      "业务 URI: ${content.uri ?: "无"}\n" +
                                      "业务包名: ${content.applicationPackage ?: "无"}\n" +
                                      "业务 records: ${content.recordCount}"
                              }
                          }
                          Operation.WRITE_NDEF -> {
                              Fm1208CardClient.writeNdef(tag, url, packageName)
                              "NDEF 写入成功\nURI: $url\n包名: $packageName"
                          }
                          Operation.WRITE_FMCOS -> {
                              Fm1208CardClient.writeFmcos(tag, url, packageName)
                              "FMCOS 写入成功\nURI: $url\n包名: $packageName"
                          }
                          Operation.INITIALIZE_FMCOS_TEST -> {
                              val initialized = Fm1208CardClient.initializeFmcosTestCard(
                                  tag,
                                  url,
                                  packageName
                              )
                              "FMCOS 测试卡初始化并校验成功\n" +
                                  "完成步骤: ${initialized.completedSteps}\n" +
                                  "业务数据: ${initialized.verifiedMessageBytes} bytes\n" +
                                  "URI: $url\n包名: $packageName"
                          }
                      }
                  }.getOrElse { error ->
                      android.util.Log.e(
                          LOG_TAG,
                          "$LOG_PREFIX scan=$scanId operation=$selectedOperation failed, " +
                              "error=${error.javaClass.simpleName}, message=${error.message}",
                          error
                      )
                      "操作失败: ${error.message ?: error.javaClass.simpleName}"
                  }
                  android.util.Log.i(
                      LOG_TAG,
                      "$LOG_PREFIX scan=$scanId task finished operation=$selectedOperation, " +
                          "elapsedMs=${SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - detectedAt}"
                  )
                  runOnUiThread {
                      nfcTestBinding.nfcRecord.text = result
                      operation = Operation.READ
                  }
              }
          }
      
          private fun ByteArray.toHex(): String = joinToString(":") { "%02X".format(it) }
      
          private fun redirectLegacyColdLaunch(sourceIntent: Intent): Boolean {
              if (sourceIntent.action != NfcAdapter.ACTION_TECH_DISCOVERED) return false
              val tag = sourceIntent.getParcelableExtra<Tag>(NfcAdapter.EXTRA_TAG)
              android.util.Log.w(
                  LOG_TAG,
                  "$LOG_PREFIX legacy OEM NFC target received in onCreate, uid=${tag?.id?.toHex() ?: "unknown"}; " +
                      "forwarding to cold-launch activity without opening TagTechnology"
              )
              startActivity(Intent(this, Fm1208NfcLaunchActivity::class.java).apply {
                  action = NfcAdapter.ACTION_TECH_DISCOVERED
                  addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_SINGLE_TOP)
                  tag?.let { putExtra(NfcAdapter.EXTRA_TAG, it) }
              })
              finish()
              return true
          }
      
          private fun handleColdLaunch(intent: Intent): Boolean {
              if (intent.action != ACTION_FMCOS_COLD_LAUNCH) return false
              val uid = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_COLD_LAUNCH_UID) ?: "未知"
              android.util.Log.i(
                  LOG_TAG,
                  "$LOG_PREFIX cold launch handed off uid=$uid; waiting for foreground rediscovery"
              )
              nfcTestBinding.nfcInfo.text = "已通过 NFC 唤起 App\nUID: $uid"
              nfcTestBinding.nfcRecord.text =
                  "为避免使用系统选择页面后失效的 Tag，请先移开卡片，再重新贴卡并保持到读取完成"
              operation = Operation.READ
              return true
          }
      
          private fun logOperationArmed(selectedOperation: Operation) {
              android.util.Log.i(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX operation armed=$selectedOperation; waiting for a new tag intent")
          }
      
          private enum class Operation { READ, WRITE_NDEF, WRITE_FMCOS, INITIALIZE_FMCOS_TEST }
      
          companion object {
              private const val LOG_TAG = "Fm1208NfcActivity"
              private const val LOG_PREFIX = "[FM1208-APDU]"
              private const val ACTION_FMCOS_COLD_LAUNCH =
                  "com.vdian.android.lib.testforgradle.action.FMCOS_COLD_LAUNCH"
              private const val EXTRA_COLD_LAUNCH_UID = "fm1208_cold_launch_uid"
      
              fun createColdLaunchIntent(context: Context, uid: String?): Intent =
                  Intent(context, NFCIdentificationActivity::class.java).apply {
                      action = ACTION_FMCOS_COLD_LAUNCH
                      addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_SINGLE_TOP)
                      putExtra(EXTRA_COLD_LAUNCH_UID, uid)
                  }
          }
      }

      package com.vdian.android.lib.testforgradle.nfc
      
      import java.io.IOException
      
      internal data class Type4Capability(
          val ndefFileId: Int,
          val maxNdefFileSize: Int,
          val maxReadSize: Int,
          val maxWriteSize: Int,
          val readAccess: Int,
          val writeAccess: Int
      )
      
      internal object Fm1208Type4Protocol {
          val SELECT_NDEF_APPLICATION = byteArrayOf(
              0x00, 0xA4.toByte(), 0x04, 0x00, 0x07,
              0xD2.toByte(), 0x76, 0x00, 0x00, 0x85.toByte(), 0x01, 0x01, 0x00
          )
          val SELECT_CAPABILITY_CONTAINER = selectFile(0xE103)
          val SELECT_FMCOS_MASTER_FILE = byteArrayOf(
              0x00, 0xA4.toByte(), 0x00, 0x00, 0x02, 0x3F, 0x00
          )
      
          fun selectFile(fileId: Int): ByteArray = byteArrayOf(
              0x00, 0xA4.toByte(), 0x00, 0x0C, 0x02,
              (fileId ushr 8).toByte(), fileId.toByte()
          )
      
          fun readBinary(offset: Int, length: Int): ByteArray {
              require(offset in 0..0xFFFF) { "Offset out of range: $offset" }
              require(length in 1..256) { "Read length must be 1..256" }
              return byteArrayOf(
                  0x00, 0xB0.toByte(), (offset ushr 8).toByte(), offset.toByte(),
                  if (length == 256) 0x00 else length.toByte()
              )
          }
      
          fun updateBinary(offset: Int, data: ByteArray): ByteArray {
              require(offset in 0..0xFFFF) { "Offset out of range: $offset" }
              require(data.isNotEmpty() && data.size <= 255) { "Write length must be 1..255" }
              return byteArrayOf(
                  0x00, 0xD6.toByte(), (offset ushr 8).toByte(), offset.toByte(), data.size.toByte()
              ) + data
          }
      
          fun responseData(response: ByteArray, operation: String): ByteArray {
              if (response.size < 2) throw IOException("$operation returned an incomplete APDU response")
              val status = ((response[response.size - 2].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or
                  (response.last().toInt() and 0xFF)
              if (status != 0x9000) {
                  throw IOException("$operation failed, status=${status.toString(16).uppercase().padStart(4, '0')}")
              }
              return response.copyOf(response.size - 2)
          }
      
          fun parseCapabilityContainer(bytes: ByteArray): Type4Capability {
              require(bytes.size >= 7) { "Capability Container is shorter than its header" }
              val declaredLength = unsignedShort(bytes, 0)
              require(declaredLength in 7..bytes.size) { "Invalid Capability Container length: $declaredLength" }
              val maxRead = unsignedShort(bytes, 3)
              val maxWrite = unsignedShort(bytes, 5)
              require(maxRead > 0 && maxWrite > 0) { "Invalid Type 4 transfer limits" }
      
              var offset = 7
              while (offset < declaredLength) {
                  val type = bytes[offset].toInt() and 0xFF
                  if (type == 0x00) {
                      offset++
                      continue
                  }
                  if (type == 0xFE) break
                  require(offset + 1 < declaredLength) { "Incomplete Capability Container TLV" }
                  val length = bytes[offset + 1].toInt() and 0xFF
                  val valueOffset = offset + 2
                  require(valueOffset + length <= declaredLength) { "Capability Container TLV exceeds file length" }
                  if (type == 0x04 && length == 6) {
                      return Type4Capability(
                          ndefFileId = unsignedShort(bytes, valueOffset),
                          maxNdefFileSize = unsignedShort(bytes, valueOffset + 2),
                          maxReadSize = maxRead,
                          maxWriteSize = maxWrite,
                          readAccess = bytes[valueOffset + 4].toInt() and 0xFF,
                          writeAccess = bytes[valueOffset + 5].toInt() and 0xFF
                      )
                  }
                  offset = valueOffset + length
              }
              throw IllegalArgumentException("NDEF File Control TLV was not found")
          }
      
          private fun unsignedShort(bytes: ByteArray, offset: Int): Int =
              ((bytes[offset].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or (bytes[offset + 1].toInt() and 0xFF)
      }
      package com.vdian.android.lib.testforgradle.nfc
      
      import android.net.Uri
      import android.nfc.NdefMessage
      import android.nfc.NdefRecord
      import android.nfc.Tag
      import android.nfc.tech.IsoDep
      import android.util.Log
      import java.io.Closeable
      import java.io.IOException
      
      /** Reads and writes an FM1208 card personalized as an NFC Forum Type 4 NDEF tag. */
      class Fm1208NdefClient private constructor(private val isoDep: IsoDep) : Closeable {
      
          data class Content(
              val uri: Uri?,
              val applicationPackage: String?,
              val recordCount: Int
          )
      
          fun read(): Content {
              Log.i(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX read started")
              val capability = selectNdefFile()
              if (capability.readAccess != OPEN_ACCESS) {
                  throw IOException("NDEF file requires unsupported read authentication")
              }
              val nlen = readBytes(0, 2, capability.maxReadSize)
              val messageLength = unsignedShort(nlen)
              val capacity = capability.maxNdefFileSize - 2
              if (messageLength == 0) return Content(null, null, 0)
              if (messageLength > capacity) {
                  throw IOException("NDEF length $messageLength exceeds card capacity $capacity")
              }
              val message = NdefMessage(readBytes(2, messageLength, capability.maxReadSize))
              var uri: Uri? = null
              var applicationPackage: String? = null
              message.records.forEach { record ->
                  if (uri == null && record.tnf == NdefRecord.TNF_WELL_KNOWN &&
                      record.type.contentEquals(NdefRecord.RTD_URI)) {
                      uri = record.toUri()
                  }
                  if (record.tnf == NdefRecord.TNF_EXTERNAL_TYPE &&
                      record.type.contentEquals(ANDROID_PACKAGE_TYPE)) {
                      applicationPackage = String(record.payload, Charsets.UTF_8)
                  }
              }
              return Content(uri, applicationPackage, message.records.size).also {
                  Log.i(
                      LOG_TAG,
                      "$LOG_PREFIX read completed records=${it.recordCount}, uriHost=${it.uri?.host}, package=${it.applicationPackage}"
                  )
              }
          }
      
          fun writeBusinessData(
              url: String = DEFAULT_BUSINESS_URL,
              applicationPackage: String = DEFAULT_APPLICATION_PACKAGE
          ) {
              val uri = Uri.parse(url)
              require(uri.scheme == "https" && !uri.host.isNullOrBlank()) { "A valid HTTPS URL is required" }
              require(applicationPackage.isNotBlank()) { "Application package must not be blank" }
              val message = NdefMessage(
                  arrayOf(
                      NdefRecord.createUri(uri),
                      NdefRecord.createApplicationRecord(applicationPackage)
                  )
              ).toByteArray()
              Log.i(
                  LOG_TAG,
                  "$LOG_PREFIX write started uriHost=${uri.host}, package=$applicationPackage, ndefBytes=${message.size}"
              )
      
              val capability = selectNdefFile()
              if (capability.writeAccess != OPEN_ACCESS) {
                  throw IOException("NDEF file is read-only or requires unsupported write authentication")
              }
              val capacity = capability.maxNdefFileSize - 2
              if (message.size > capacity) {
                  throw IOException("NDEF message needs ${message.size} bytes, card capacity is $capacity")
              }
      
              // Clear NLEN first so an interrupted update is never exposed as a valid partial message.
              updateBytes(0, byteArrayOf(0x00, 0x00), capability.maxWriteSize)
              updateBytes(2, message, capability.maxWriteSize)
              updateBytes(0, byteArrayOf((message.size ushr 8).toByte(), message.size.toByte()), capability.maxWriteSize)
              Log.i(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX write completed ndefBytes=${message.size}")
          }
      
          private fun selectNdefFile(): Type4Capability {
              Log.i(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX step=1 select NDEF application aid=D2760000850101")
              try {
                  exchange(Fm1208Type4Protocol.SELECT_NDEF_APPLICATION, "select NDEF application")
              } catch (error: IOException) {
                  if (error.message?.contains("status=6A82") == true) {
                      val mfProbe = probeFmcosMasterFile()
                      throw IOException(
                          "Standard NDEF application is absent; FMCOS MF probe: $mfProbe. " +
                              "The card requires Type 4 NDEF personalization.",
                          error
                      )
                  }
                  throw error
              }
              Log.i(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX step=2 select Capability Container file=E103")
              exchange(Fm1208Type4Protocol.SELECT_CAPABILITY_CONTAINER, "select Capability Container")
              val header = readBytes(0, 2, DEFAULT_TRANSFER_SIZE)
              val ccLength = unsignedShort(header)
              Log.i(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX step=3 Capability Container declaredLength=$ccLength")
              if (ccLength < MINIMUM_CC_LENGTH) throw IOException("Invalid Capability Container length: $ccLength")
              val capability = Fm1208Type4Protocol.parseCapabilityContainer(
                  readBytes(0, ccLength, DEFAULT_TRANSFER_SIZE)
              )
              Log.i(
                  LOG_TAG,
                  "$LOG_PREFIX step=4 parsed CC ndefFile=${capability.ndefFileId.toString(16).uppercase()}, " +
                      "capacity=${capability.maxNdefFileSize}, mLe=${capability.maxReadSize}, " +
                      "mLc=${capability.maxWriteSize}, readAccess=${capability.readAccess.toString(16)}, " +
                      "writeAccess=${capability.writeAccess.toString(16)}"
              )
              exchange(Fm1208Type4Protocol.selectFile(capability.ndefFileId), "select NDEF file")
              Log.i(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX step=5 selected NDEF file")
              return capability
          }
      
          private fun probeFmcosMasterFile(): String {
              val command = Fm1208Type4Protocol.SELECT_FMCOS_MASTER_FILE
              Log.i(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX probe select FMCOS MF file=3F00 apdu=${command.toCommandLog()}")
              return try {
                  val response = isoDep.transceive(command)
                  Log.i(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX probe FMCOS MF response=${response.toResponseLog()}")
                  val status = response.statusWord()
                  when (status) {
                      0x9000 -> "present, FCI=${response.copyOf(response.size - 2).toResponseLog()}"
                      0x6A81 -> "unavailable or card locked, status=6A81"
                      else -> "status=${status.toString(16).uppercase().padStart(4, '0')}"
                  }
              } catch (probeError: Exception) {
                  Log.e(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX probe FMCOS MF failed", probeError)
                  "probe failed: ${probeError.message ?: probeError.javaClass.simpleName}"
              }
          }
      
          private fun readBytes(startOffset: Int, length: Int, transferLimit: Int): ByteArray {
              if (length == 0) return byteArrayOf()
              val result = ByteArray(length)
              var copied = 0
              while (copied < length) {
                  val chunkSize = minOf(length - copied, transferLimit, MAX_READ_SIZE)
                  val chunk = exchange(
                      Fm1208Type4Protocol.readBinary(startOffset + copied, chunkSize),
                      "read binary at ${startOffset + copied}"
                  )
                  if (chunk.isEmpty() || chunk.size > chunkSize) throw IOException("Card returned an invalid read length")
                  chunk.copyInto(result, copied)
                  copied += chunk.size
              }
              return result
          }
      
          private fun updateBytes(startOffset: Int, data: ByteArray, transferLimit: Int) {
              var written = 0
              while (written < data.size) {
                  val chunkSize = minOf(data.size - written, transferLimit, MAX_WRITE_SIZE)
                  val chunk = data.copyOfRange(written, written + chunkSize)
                  exchange(
                      Fm1208Type4Protocol.updateBinary(startOffset + written, chunk),
                      "update binary at ${startOffset + written}"
                  )
                  written += chunkSize
              }
          }
      
          private fun exchange(command: ByteArray, operation: String): ByteArray {
              Log.i(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX -> $operation apdu=${command.toCommandLog()}")
              return try {
                  val response = isoDep.transceive(command)
                  Log.i(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX <- $operation response=${response.toResponseLog()}")
                  Fm1208Type4Protocol.responseData(response, operation)
              } catch (error: Exception) {
                  Log.e(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX !! $operation failed apdu=${command.toCommandLog()}", error)
                  throw error
              }
          }
      
          override fun close() {
              isoDep.close()
          }
      
          companion object {
              const val DEFAULT_BUSINESS_URL =
                  "https://yl.test.com/nfc"
              const val DEFAULT_APPLICATION_PACKAGE = "com.vdian.android.lib.testforgradle"
      
              private const val LOG_TAG = "Fm1208NdefClient"
              private const val LOG_PREFIX = "[FM1208-APDU]"
              private val ANDROID_PACKAGE_TYPE = "android.com:pkg".toByteArray(Charsets.US_ASCII)
              private const val OPEN_ACCESS = 0x00
              private const val MINIMUM_CC_LENGTH = 15
              private const val DEFAULT_TRANSFER_SIZE = 0xFF
              private const val MAX_READ_SIZE = 0x100
              private const val MAX_WRITE_SIZE = 0xFF
      
              fun connect(tag: Tag): Fm1208NdefClient {
                  Log.i(
                      LOG_TAG,
                      "$LOG_PREFIX connect uid=${tag.id.toHex()}, tech=${tag.techList.joinToString()}, " +
                          "historicalBytes=${IsoDep.get(tag)?.historicalBytes.toHex()}, " +
                          "hiLayerResponse=${IsoDep.get(tag)?.hiLayerResponse.toHex()}"
                  )
                  val isoDep = IsoDep.get(tag)
                      ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("Card does not expose ISO-DEP (ISO/IEC 14443-4)")
                  isoDep.timeout = 5000
                  isoDep.connect()
                  Log.i(
                      LOG_TAG,
                      "$LOG_PREFIX connected timeout=${isoDep.timeout}, maxTransceiveLength=${isoDep.maxTransceiveLength}, " +
                          "extendedLength=${isoDep.isExtendedLengthApduSupported}"
                  )
                  return Fm1208NdefClient(isoDep)
              }
      
              private fun unsignedShort(bytes: ByteArray): Int =
                  ((bytes[0].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or (bytes[1].toInt() and 0xFF)
      
              private fun ByteArray?.toHex(): String =
                  this?.joinToString("") { "%02X".format(it) } ?: "null"
      
              private fun ByteArray.toCommandLog(): String {
                  val isUpdateBinary = size >= 2 && this[1] == 0xD6.toByte()
                  return if (isUpdateBinary && size > 5) {
                      "${copyOfRange(0, 5).toHex()} [${size - 5} data bytes omitted]"
                  } else {
                      toHex()
                  }
              }
      
              private fun ByteArray.toResponseLog(): String = if (size <= MAX_LOGGED_RESPONSE_BYTES) {
                  toHex()
              } else {
                  "${copyOfRange(0, MAX_LOGGED_RESPONSE_BYTES).toHex()}... [$size bytes total]"
              }
      
              private fun ByteArray.statusWord(): Int {
                  if (size < 2) return -1
                  return ((this[size - 2].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or (last().toInt() and 0xFF)
              }
      
              private const val MAX_LOGGED_RESPONSE_BYTES = 64
          }
      }

      class Fm1208Type4ProtocolTest {
      
          @Test
          fun parseCapabilityContainer_findsNdefFileAndTransferLimits() {
              val capability = Fm1208Type4Protocol.parseCapabilityContainer(
                  byteArrayOf(
                      0x00, 0x0F, 0x20, 0x00, 0x3B, 0x00, 0x34,
                      0x04, 0x06, 0xE1.toByte(), 0x04, 0x01, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00
                  )
              )
      
              assertEquals(0xE104, capability.ndefFileId)
              assertEquals(256, capability.maxNdefFileSize)
              assertEquals(59, capability.maxReadSize)
              assertEquals(52, capability.maxWriteSize)
              assertEquals(0, capability.readAccess)
              assertEquals(0, capability.writeAccess)
          }
      
          @Test
          fun commands_useShortIso7816ApduEncoding() {
              assertArrayEquals(
                  byteArrayOf(0x00, 0xA4.toByte(), 0x00, 0x00, 0x02, 0x3F, 0x00),
                  Fm1208Type4Protocol.SELECT_FMCOS_MASTER_FILE
              )
              assertArrayEquals(
                  byteArrayOf(0x00, 0xB0.toByte(), 0x01, 0x02, 0x20),
                  Fm1208Type4Protocol.readBinary(0x0102, 32)
              )
              assertArrayEquals(
                  byteArrayOf(0x00, 0xD6.toByte(), 0x01, 0x02, 0x02, 0x12, 0x34),
                  Fm1208Type4Protocol.updateBinary(0x0102, byteArrayOf(0x12, 0x34))
              )
          }
      
          @Test
          fun defaultBusinessData_targetsDemoApp() {
              assertEquals("https://yl.test.com/nfc", Fm1208NdefClient.DEFAULT_BUSINESS_URL)
              assertEquals(
                  "com.vdian.android.lib.testforgradle",
                  Fm1208NdefClient.DEFAULT_APPLICATION_PACKAGE
              )
          }
      
          @Test
          fun fmcosTlv_findsNestedMasterFileMetadata() {
              val fci = hex("6F15840E315041592E5359532E4444463031A503880101")
      
              assertEquals("1PAY.SYS.DDF01", FmcosTlv.find(fci, 0x84)?.toString(Charsets.US_ASCII))
              assertArrayEquals(byteArrayOf(0x01), FmcosTlv.find(fci, 0x88))
          }
      
          @Test
          fun fmcosTlv_findsApplicationInDirectoryRecord() {
              val record = hex("61114F09A00000000386980701500450424F43")
      
              assertArrayEquals(hex("A00000000386980701"), FmcosTlv.find(record, 0x4F))
              assertEquals("PBOC", FmcosTlv.find(record, 0x50)?.toString(Charsets.US_ASCII))
          }
      
          @Test
          fun fmcosStatus_treatsMissingDirectoryAndMissingRecordAsEmpty() {
              assertEquals(true, FmcosStatus.isDirectoryEnd(0x6A82))
              assertEquals(true, FmcosStatus.isDirectoryEnd(0x6A83))
              assertEquals(false, FmcosStatus.isDirectoryEnd(0x6982))
          }
      
          @Test

              assertArrayEquals(hex("800E000000"), Fm1208TestCardProtocol.ERASE_MASTER_FILE)
              assertArrayEquals(
                  hex("80E00000073F00B001F0FFFF"),

              )
              assertArrayEquals(

                  Fm1208TestCardProtocol.WRITE_DEFAULT_KEY
              )
              assertArrayEquals(
                  hex("80E03F010D380FFFF0FA95FFFF4144463031"),
                  Fm1208TestCardProtocol.CREATE_APPLICATION
              )
              assertArrayEquals(
                  hex("80E0000307280400FAFAFFFF"),
                  Fm1208TestCardProtocol.CREATE_BUSINESS_FILE
              )
          }
      
          @Test

              val command = Fm1208TestCardProtocol.externalAuthenticate(
                  challenge = hex("01234567"),
                  key = hex("133457799BBCDFF1")
              )
      
              assertArrayEquals(hex("008200000854290DBB651898AC"), command)
          }
      
          @Test
          fun externalAuthenticate_supportsExperimentalAllFfTestKey() {
              assertArrayEquals(
                  hex("0082000008D5F2E7D767E0A1EF"),
                  Fm1208TestCardProtocol.externalAuthenticate(hex("01234567"))
              )
          }
      
          @Test
          fun businessMessageEncoding_usesTwoByteLengthAndRoundTrips() {
              val message = ByteArray(500) { (it and 0xFF).toByte() }
      
              val stored = Fm1208TestCardProtocol.encodeBusinessMessage(message)
      
              assertEquals(0x01, stored[0].toInt() and 0xFF)
              assertEquals(0xF4, stored[1].toInt() and 0xFF)
              assertArrayEquals(message, Fm1208TestCardProtocol.decodeBusinessMessage(stored))
          }

          fun responseData_rejectsNonSuccessStatus() {
              Fm1208Type4Protocol.responseData(byteArrayOf(0x6A, 0x82.toByte()), "select file")
          }
      
          private fun hex(value: String): ByteArray = value.chunked(2)
              .map { it.toInt(16).toByte() }
              .toByteArray()

    package com.vdian.android.lib.testforgradle.nfc
    
    import android.net.Uri
    import android.nfc.NdefMessage
    import android.nfc.NdefRecord
    import android.nfc.Tag
    import android.nfc.tech.IsoDep
    import android.util.Log
    import java.io.Closeable
    import java.io.IOException
    import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
    
    /** Read-only NTAG 424 DNA diagnostics. Reading an SDM NDEF advances its read counter. */
    class Ntag424DnaDemoClient private constructor(private val isoDep: IsoDep) : Closeable {
    
        data class Report(
            val version: Ntag424Version,
            val ndefSettings: Ntag424FileSettings?,
            val ndefUri: Uri?,
            val ndefRecordCount: Int?,
            val originalitySignature: ByteArray?,
            val warnings: List<String>
        ) {
            fun toDisplayText(): String = buildString {
                appendLine(if (version.looksLikeNtag424Dna) "识别结果: NTAG 424 DNA" else "识别结果: 未确认是 NTAG 424 DNA")
                appendLine("硬件: vendor=%02X type=%02X storage=%02X version=%d".format(
                    version.hardwareVendorId,
                    version.hardwareType,
                    version.hardwareStorageSize,
                    version.hardwareMajorVersion
                ))
                appendLine("软件版本: ${version.softwareMajorVersion}.${version.softwareMinorVersion}")
                appendLine("芯片 UID: ${version.uid?.toHex(":") ?: "响应未提供"}")
                if (version.productionWeek != null && version.productionYear != null) {
                    appendLine("生产批次: week=${version.productionWeek}, year=${version.productionYear}")
                }
                ndefSettings?.let { settings ->
                    appendLine("NDEF 文件: ${settings.fileSize} bytes, SDM=${if (settings.sdmEnabled) "已开启" else "未开启"}")
                    appendLine(
                        "权限: R=${settings.readKey.asAccess()} W=${settings.writeKey.asAccess()} " +
                            "RW=${settings.readWriteKey.asAccess()} Change=${settings.changeKey.asAccess()}"
                    )
                    if (settings.sdmEnabled) {
                        appendLine(
                            "SDM: MetaRead=${settings.sdmMetaReadKey?.asAccess()}, " +
                                "FileRead=${settings.sdmFileReadKey?.asAccess()}, " +
                                "CtrRet=${settings.sdmCounterRetrieveKey?.asAccess()}"
                        )
                    }
                }
                appendLine("NDEF records: ${ndefRecordCount ?: "读取失败"}")
                appendLine("NDEF URI: ${ndefUri ?: "无"}")
                ndefUri?.let { uri ->
                    val dynamicFields = uri.queryParameterNames.associateWith { uri.getQueryParameter(it) }
                        .filterKeys { it.lowercase() in SDM_PARAMETER_NAMES }
                    if (dynamicFields.isNotEmpty()) appendLine("疑似 SDM 字段: $dynamicFields")
                }
                appendLine("Originality Signature: ${originalitySignature?.toHex() ?: "未取得"}")
                appendLine("注意: Demo 只展示签名；生产环境还必须使用 NXP 公钥验证签名，并在后端验证 SDMMAC/计数器。")
                warnings.forEach { appendLine("提示: $it") }
            }.trim()
        }
    
        fun inspect(): Report {
            isoExchange(Ntag424DnaProtocol.SELECT_NDEF_APPLICATION, "select NDEF application")
            val version = Ntag424DnaProtocol.parseVersion(
                nativeExchange(Ntag424DnaProtocol.GET_VERSION, "get version")
            )
            val warnings = mutableListOf<String>()
            val settings = capture("读取 NDEF 文件设置", warnings) {
                Ntag424DnaProtocol.parseFileSettings(
                    nativeExchange(Ntag424DnaProtocol.getFileSettings(NDEF_FILE_NUMBER), "get NDEF file settings")
                )
            }
            val signature = capture("读取 Originality Signature", warnings) {
                nativeExchange(Ntag424DnaProtocol.READ_ORIGINALITY_SIGNATURE, "read originality signature")
                    .also { require(it.size == ORIGINALITY_SIGNATURE_LENGTH) { "签名长度应为 56，实际为 ${it.size}" } }
            }
            val ndef = capture("读取 NDEF", warnings) { readNdef() }
            return Report(
                version = version,
                ndefSettings = settings,
                ndefUri = ndef?.first,
                ndefRecordCount = ndef?.second,
                originalitySignature = signature,
                warnings = warnings
            )
        }
    
        private fun readNdef(): Pair<Uri?, Int> {
            isoExchange(Ntag424DnaProtocol.selectFile(CC_FILE_ID), "select CC file")
            val ccHeader = isoExchange(Ntag424DnaProtocol.readBinary(0, 2), "read CC length")
            require(ccHeader.size == 2) { "Invalid CC length response" }
            val ccLength = (ccHeader[0].toInt() and 0xFF shl 8) or (ccHeader[1].toInt() and 0xFF)
            val cc = isoExchange(Ntag424DnaProtocol.readBinary(0, ccLength), "read CC")
            val (ndefFileId, maxFileSize) = Ntag424DnaProtocol.parseCapabilityContainer(cc)
            isoExchange(Ntag424DnaProtocol.selectFile(ndefFileId), "select NDEF file")
            val nlenBytes = isoExchange(Ntag424DnaProtocol.readBinary(0, 2), "read NLEN")
            require(nlenBytes.size == 2) { "Invalid NLEN response" }
            val nlen = (nlenBytes[0].toInt() and 0xFF shl 8) or (nlenBytes[1].toInt() and 0xFF)
            require(nlen <= maxFileSize - 2) { "NDEF length exceeds file capacity" }
            if (nlen == 0) return null to 0
            val bytes = ByteArrayOutputStream(nlen)
            var offset = 0
            while (offset < nlen) {
                val chunkSize = minOf(nlen - offset, MAX_READ_LENGTH)
                bytes.write(isoExchange(Ntag424DnaProtocol.readBinary(offset + 2, chunkSize), "read NDEF at $offset"))
                offset += chunkSize
            }
            val message = NdefMessage(bytes.toByteArray())
            val uri = message.records.firstOrNull {
                it.tnf == NdefRecord.TNF_WELL_KNOWN && it.type.contentEquals(NdefRecord.RTD_URI)
            }?.toUri()
            return uri to message.records.size
        }
    
        private fun nativeExchange(command: ByteArray, operation: String): ByteArray {
            val output = ByteArrayOutputStream()
            var nextCommand = command
            var frames = 0
            while (true) {
                val response = transceive(nextCommand, operation)
                if (response.size < 2 || response[response.size - 2] != 0x91.toByte()) {
                    throw IOException("$operation returned an invalid native response")
                }
                output.write(response, 0, response.size - 2)
                when (val status = response.last().toInt() and 0xFF) {
                    0x00 -> return output.toByteArray()
                    0xAF -> {
                        if (++frames > MAX_ADDITIONAL_FRAMES) throw IOException("$operation returned too many frames")
                        nextCommand = Ntag424DnaProtocol.ADDITIONAL_FRAME
                    }
                    else -> throw IOException("$operation failed, status=91${status.toString(16).uppercase().padStart(2, '0')}")
                }
            }
        }
    
        private fun isoExchange(command: ByteArray, operation: String): ByteArray {
            val response = transceive(command, operation)
            if (response.size < 2) throw IOException("$operation returned an incomplete response")
            val status = ((response[response.size - 2].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or
                (response.last().toInt() and 0xFF)
            if (status != 0x9000 && status != 0x9100) {
                throw IOException("$operation failed, status=${status.toString(16).uppercase().padStart(4, '0')}")
            }
            return response.copyOf(response.size - 2)
        }
    
        private fun transceive(command: ByteArray, operation: String): ByteArray {
            Log.i(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX -> $operation ${command.toHex()}")
            return isoDep.transceive(command).also {
                Log.i(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX <- $operation ${it.toHex()} ")
            }
        }
    
        private inline fun <T> capture(label: String, warnings: MutableList<String>, action: () -> T): T? =
            try {
                action()
            } catch (error: Exception) {
                Log.w(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX $label failed", error)
                warnings += "$label失败: ${error.message ?: error.javaClass.simpleName}"
                null
            }
    
        override fun close() {
            isoDep.close()
        }
    
        companion object {
            private const val LOG_TAG = "Ntag424DnaDemo"
            private const val LOG_PREFIX = "[NTAG424-DEMO]"
            private const val CC_FILE_ID = 0xE103
            private const val NDEF_FILE_NUMBER = 0x02
            private const val ORIGINALITY_SIGNATURE_LENGTH = 56
            private const val MAX_READ_LENGTH = 0xF0
            private const val MAX_ADDITIONAL_FRAMES = 8
            private val SDM_PARAMETER_NAMES = setOf("e", "c", "uid", "ctr", "picc_data", "cmac")
    
            fun connect(tag: Tag): Ntag424DnaDemoClient {
                val isoDep = IsoDep.get(tag)
                    ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("标签不支持 ISO-DEP，无法作为 NTAG 424 DNA 检测")
                isoDep.timeout = 5000
                isoDep.connect()
                return Ntag424DnaDemoClient(isoDep)
            }
    
            private fun Int.asAccess(): String = when (this) {
                0x0E -> "Free"
                0x0F -> "Never"
                else -> "Key $this"
            }
    
            private fun ByteArray.toHex(separator: String = ""): String =
                joinToString(separator) { "%02X".format(it) }
        }
    }

    package com.vdian.android.lib.testforgradle.nfc
    
    import java.io.IOException
    
    internal data class Ntag424Version(
        val hardwareVendorId: Int,
        val hardwareType: Int,
        val hardwareMajorVersion: Int,
        val hardwareStorageSize: Int,
        val softwareMajorVersion: Int,
        val softwareMinorVersion: Int,
        val uid: ByteArray?,
        val productionWeek: Int?,
        val productionYear: Int?
    ) {
        val looksLikeNtag424Dna: Boolean
            get() = hardwareVendorId == 0x04 && hardwareType == 0x04 && hardwareStorageSize == 0x11
    }
    
    internal data class Ntag424FileSettings(
        val fileType: Int,
        val communicationMode: Int,
        val readKey: Int,
        val writeKey: Int,
        val readWriteKey: Int,
        val changeKey: Int,
        val fileSize: Int,
        val sdmEnabled: Boolean,
        val sdmOptions: Int?,
        val sdmMetaReadKey: Int?,
        val sdmFileReadKey: Int?,
        val sdmCounterRetrieveKey: Int?
    )
    
    internal object Ntag424DnaProtocol {
        val SELECT_NDEF_APPLICATION = byteArrayOf(
            0x00, 0xA4.toByte(), 0x04, 0x00, 0x07,
            0xD2.toByte(), 0x76, 0x00, 0x00, 0x85.toByte(), 0x01, 0x01, 0x00
        )
        val GET_VERSION = nativeCommand(0x60)
        val READ_ORIGINALITY_SIGNATURE = nativeCommand(0x3C, byteArrayOf(0x00))
        val ADDITIONAL_FRAME = nativeCommand(0xAF)
    
        fun getFileSettings(fileNumber: Int): ByteArray {
            require(fileNumber in 0..0x1F) { "File number must be 0..31" }
            return nativeCommand(0xF5, byteArrayOf(fileNumber.toByte()))
        }
    
        fun selectFile(fileId: Int): ByteArray = byteArrayOf(
            0x00, 0xA4.toByte(), 0x00, 0x0C, 0x02,
            (fileId ushr 8).toByte(), fileId.toByte()
        )
    
        fun readBinary(offset: Int, length: Int): ByteArray {
            require(offset in 0..0xFFFF) { "Offset out of range" }
            require(length in 1..256) { "Read length must be 1..256" }
            return byteArrayOf(
                0x00, 0xB0.toByte(), (offset ushr 8).toByte(), offset.toByte(),
                if (length == 256) 0 else length.toByte()
            )
        }
    
        fun parseVersion(data: ByteArray): Ntag424Version {
            require(data.size >= 14) { "GetVersion response is too short: ${data.size}" }
            val uid = if (data.size >= 21) data.copyOfRange(14, 21) else null
            return Ntag424Version(
                hardwareVendorId = data.u8(0),
                hardwareType = data.u8(1),
                hardwareMajorVersion = data.u8(3),
                hardwareStorageSize = data.u8(5),
                softwareMajorVersion = data.u8(10),
                softwareMinorVersion = data.u8(11),
                uid = uid,
                productionWeek = data.getOrNull(26)?.toInt()?.and(0xFF),
                productionYear = data.getOrNull(27)?.toInt()?.and(0xFF)
            )
        }
    
        fun parseFileSettings(data: ByteArray): Ntag424FileSettings {
            require(data.size >= 7) { "GetFileSettings response is too short: ${data.size}" }
            val fileOption = data.u8(1)
            val accessRights = (data.u8(2) shl 8) or data.u8(3)
            val sdmEnabled = fileOption and 0x40 != 0
            if (sdmEnabled) require(data.size >= 10) { "SDM file settings are incomplete" }
            val sdmRights = if (sdmEnabled) (data.u8(8) shl 8) or data.u8(9) else 0
            return Ntag424FileSettings(
                fileType = data.u8(0),
                communicationMode = fileOption and 0x03,
                readKey = accessRights ushr 12 and 0x0F,
                writeKey = accessRights ushr 8 and 0x0F,
                readWriteKey = accessRights ushr 4 and 0x0F,
                changeKey = accessRights and 0x0F,
                fileSize = data.u24LittleEndian(4),
                sdmEnabled = sdmEnabled,
                sdmOptions = if (sdmEnabled) data.u8(7) else null,
                sdmMetaReadKey = if (sdmEnabled) sdmRights ushr 12 and 0x0F else null,
                sdmFileReadKey = if (sdmEnabled) sdmRights ushr 8 and 0x0F else null,
                sdmCounterRetrieveKey = if (sdmEnabled) sdmRights and 0x0F else null
            )
        }
    
        fun parseCapabilityContainer(data: ByteArray): Pair<Int, Int> {
            require(data.size >= 7) { "Capability Container is too short" }
            val declaredLength = data.u16BigEndian(0)
            require(declaredLength in 7..data.size) { "Invalid Capability Container length" }
            var offset = 7
            while (offset + 1 < declaredLength) {
                val type = data.u8(offset)
                if (type == 0x00) {
                    offset++
                    continue
                }
                if (type == 0xFE) break
                val length = data.u8(offset + 1)
                require(offset + 2 + length <= declaredLength) { "Invalid Capability Container TLV" }
                if (type == 0x04 && length == 6) {
                    return data.u16BigEndian(offset + 2) to data.u16BigEndian(offset + 4)
                }
                offset += 2 + length
            }
            throw IOException("NDEF File Control TLV was not found")
        }
    
        private fun nativeCommand(command: Int, data: ByteArray = byteArrayOf()): ByteArray =
            if (data.isEmpty()) {
                byteArrayOf(0x90.toByte(), command.toByte(), 0x00, 0x00, 0x00)
            } else {
                byteArrayOf(0x90.toByte(), command.toByte(), 0x00, 0x00, data.size.toByte()) +
                    data + byteArrayOf(0x00)
            }
    
        private fun ByteArray.u8(offset: Int): Int = this[offset].toInt() and 0xFF
    
        private fun ByteArray.u16BigEndian(offset: Int): Int = (u8(offset) shl 8) or u8(offset + 1)
    
        private fun ByteArray.u24LittleEndian(offset: Int): Int =
            u8(offset) or (u8(offset + 1) shl 8) or (u8(offset + 2) shl 16)
    }

    package com.vdian.android.lib.testforgradle.nfc
    
    import org.junit.Assert.assertArrayEquals
    import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
    import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
    import org.junit.Test
    
    class Ntag424DnaProtocolTest {
    
        @Test
        fun commands_useNtag424WrappedNativeApdus() {
            assertArrayEquals(hex("9060000000"), Ntag424DnaProtocol.GET_VERSION)
            assertArrayEquals(hex("90F50000010200"), Ntag424DnaProtocol.getFileSettings(2))
            assertArrayEquals(hex("903C0000010000"), Ntag424DnaProtocol.READ_ORIGINALITY_SIGNATURE)
            assertArrayEquals(hex("90AF000000"), Ntag424DnaProtocol.ADDITIONAL_FRAME)
        }
    
        @Test
        fun parseVersion_recognizesNtag424DnaResponse() {
            val response = hex(
                "04040201001105" +
                    "04040201001105" +
                    "04112233445566A1A2A3A4A52219"
            )
    
            val version = Ntag424DnaProtocol.parseVersion(response)
    
            assertTrue(version.looksLikeNtag424Dna)
            assertEquals(1, version.hardwareMajorVersion)
            assertEquals(1, version.softwareMajorVersion)
            assertArrayEquals(hex("04112233445566"), version.uid)
            assertEquals(0x22, version.productionWeek)
            assertEquals(0x19, version.productionYear)
        }
    
        @Test
        fun parseFileSettings_extractsSdmAndAccessRights() {
            val settings = Ntag424DnaProtocol.parseFileSettings(
                hex("0040E0EE000100C1F1210000002B00003E0000")
            )
    
            assertEquals(256, settings.fileSize)
            assertTrue(settings.sdmEnabled)
            assertEquals(0x0E, settings.readKey)
            assertEquals(0x00, settings.writeKey)
            assertEquals(0x0E, settings.readWriteKey)
            assertEquals(0x0E, settings.changeKey)
            assertEquals(0x0F, settings.sdmMetaReadKey)
            assertEquals(0x01, settings.sdmFileReadKey)
            assertEquals(0x01, settings.sdmCounterRetrieveKey)
        }
    
        @Test
        fun parseCapabilityContainer_findsNdefFile() {
            val (fileId, fileSize) = Ntag424DnaProtocol.parseCapabilityContainer(
                hex("000F20003B00340406E10401000000")
            )
    
            assertEquals(0xE104, fileId)
            assertEquals(256, fileSize)
        }
    
        private fun hex(value: String): ByteArray = value.chunked(2)
            .map { it.toInt(16).toByte() }
            .toByteArray()
    }

                    10.5.2 GetVersion
                           The GetVersion command returns manufacturing related data of NTAG 424 DNA
                           (NT4H2421Gx). No parameters are required for this command.
                           Remark: This command is only available after ISO/IEC 14443-4 activation.
                           The version data is return over three frames. Part1 returns the hardware-related
                           information, Part2 returns the software-related information and Part3 and last frame
                           returns the production-related information. This command is freely accessible without
                           secure messaging as soon as the PD is selected and there is no active authentication.

      package com.vdian.android.lib.testforgradle.nfc
      
      import android.net.Uri
      import android.nfc.NdefMessage
      import android.nfc.NdefRecord
      import android.nfc.Tag
      import android.nfc.tech.IsoDep
      import android.util.Log
      import java.io.Closeable
      import java.io.IOException
      import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
      
      /** Read-only NTAG 424 DNA diagnostics. Reading an SDM NDEF advances its read counter. */
      internal class Ntag424DnaDemoClient private constructor(private val isoDep: IsoDep) : Closeable {
      
          data class Report(
              val version: Ntag424Version,
              val ndefSettings: Ntag424FileSettings?,
              val ndefUri: Uri?,
              val ndefRecordCount: Int?,
              val originalitySignature: ByteArray?,
              val warnings: List<String>
          ) {
              fun toDisplayText(): String = buildString {
                  appendLine(if (version.looksLikeNtag424Dna) "识别结果: NTAG 424 DNA" else "识别结果: 未确认是 NTAG 424 DNA")
                  appendLine("硬件: vendor=%02X type=%02X storage=%02X version=%02X".format(
                      version.hardwareVendorId,
                      version.hardwareType,
                      version.hardwareStorageSize,
                      version.hardwareMajorVersion
                  ))
                  appendLine("软件版本: ${version.softwareMajorVersion}.${version.softwareMinorVersion}")
                  appendLine("芯片 UID: ${version.uid?.toHex(":") ?: "响应未提供"}")
                  if (version.productionWeek != null && version.productionYear != null) {
                      appendLine("生产批次: week=${version.productionWeek}, year=%02X".format(version.productionYear))
                  }
                  ndefSettings?.let { settings ->
                      appendLine("NDEF 文件: ${settings.fileSize} bytes, SDM=${if (settings.sdmEnabled) "已开启" else "未开启"}")
                      appendLine(
                          "权限: R=${settings.readKey.asAccess()} W=${settings.writeKey.asAccess()} " +
                              "RW=${settings.readWriteKey.asAccess()} Change=${settings.changeKey.asAccess()}"
                      )
                      if (settings.sdmEnabled) {
                          appendLine(
                              "SDM: MetaRead=${settings.sdmMetaReadKey?.asAccess()}, " +
                                  "FileRead=${settings.sdmFileReadKey?.asAccess()}, " +
                                  "CtrRet=${settings.sdmCounterRetrieveKey?.asAccess()}"
                          )
                      }
                  }
                  appendLine("NDEF records: ${ndefRecordCount ?: "读取失败"}")
                  appendLine("NDEF URI: ${ndefUri ?: "无"}")
                  ndefUri?.let { uri ->
                      val dynamicFields = uri.queryParameterNames.associateWith { uri.getQueryParameter(it) }
                          .filterKeys { it.lowercase() in SDM_PARAMETER_NAMES }
                      if (dynamicFields.isNotEmpty()) appendLine("疑似 SDM 字段: $dynamicFields")
                  }
                  appendLine("Originality Signature: ${originalitySignature?.toHex() ?: "未取得"}")
                  appendLine("注意: Demo 只展示签名；生产环境还必须使用 NXP 公钥验证签名，并在后端验证 SDMMAC/计数器。")
                  warnings.forEach { appendLine("提示: $it") }
              }.trim()
          }
      
          fun inspect(): Report {
              isoExchange(Ntag424DnaProtocol.SELECT_NDEF_APPLICATION, "select NDEF application")
              val version = Ntag424DnaProtocol.parseVersion(
                  nativeExchange(Ntag424DnaProtocol.GET_VERSION, "get version")
              )
              val warnings = mutableListOf<String>()
              val settings = capture("读取 NDEF 文件设置", warnings) {
                  Ntag424DnaProtocol.parseFileSettings(
                      nativeExchange(Ntag424DnaProtocol.getFileSettings(NDEF_FILE_NUMBER), "get NDEF file settings")
                  )
              }
              val signature = capture("读取 Originality Signature", warnings) {
                  nativeExchange(Ntag424DnaProtocol.READ_ORIGINALITY_SIGNATURE, "read originality signature")
                      .also { require(it.size == ORIGINALITY_SIGNATURE_LENGTH) { "签名长度应为 56，实际为 ${it.size}" } }
              }
              val ndef = capture("读取 NDEF", warnings) { readNdef() }
              return Report(
                  version = version,
                  ndefSettings = settings,
                  ndefUri = ndef?.first,
                  ndefRecordCount = ndef?.second,
                  originalitySignature = signature,
                  warnings = warnings
              )
          }
      
          private fun readNdef(): Pair<Uri?, Int> {
              isoExchange(Ntag424DnaProtocol.selectFile(CC_FILE_ID), "select CC file")
              val ccHeader = isoExchange(Ntag424DnaProtocol.readBinary(0, 2), "read CC length")
              require(ccHeader.size == 2) { "Invalid CC length response" }
              val ccLength = ((ccHeader[0].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or
                  (ccHeader[1].toInt() and 0xFF)
              val cc = isoExchange(Ntag424DnaProtocol.readBinary(0, ccLength), "read CC")
              val (ndefFileId, maxFileSize) = Ntag424DnaProtocol.parseCapabilityContainer(cc)
              isoExchange(Ntag424DnaProtocol.selectFile(ndefFileId), "select NDEF file")
              val nlenBytes = isoExchange(Ntag424DnaProtocol.readBinary(0, 2), "read NLEN")
              require(nlenBytes.size == 2) { "Invalid NLEN response" }
              val nlen = ((nlenBytes[0].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or
                  (nlenBytes[1].toInt() and 0xFF)
              require(nlen <= maxFileSize - 2) { "NDEF length exceeds file capacity" }
              if (nlen == 0) return null to 0
              val bytes = ByteArrayOutputStream(nlen)
              var offset = 0
              while (offset < nlen) {
                  val chunkSize = minOf(nlen - offset, MAX_READ_LENGTH)
                  val chunk = isoExchange(
                      Ntag424DnaProtocol.readBinary(offset + 2, chunkSize),
                      "read NDEF at $offset"
                  )
                  require(chunk.size == chunkSize) { "NDEF read returned ${chunk.size}, expected $chunkSize" }
                  bytes.write(chunk)
                  offset += chunkSize
              }
              val message = NdefMessage(bytes.toByteArray())
              val uri = message.records.firstOrNull {
                  it.tnf == NdefRecord.TNF_WELL_KNOWN && it.type.contentEquals(NdefRecord.RTD_URI)
              }?.toUri()
              return uri to message.records.size
          }
      
          private fun nativeExchange(command: ByteArray, operation: String): ByteArray {
              val output = ByteArrayOutputStream()
              var nextCommand = command
              var frames = 0
              while (true) {
                  val response = transceive(nextCommand, operation)
                  if (response.size < 2 || response[response.size - 2] != 0x91.toByte()) {
                      throw IOException("$operation returned an invalid native response")
                  }
                  output.write(response, 0, response.size - 2)
                  when (val status = response.last().toInt() and 0xFF) {
                      0x00 -> return output.toByteArray()
                      0xAF -> {
                          if (++frames > MAX_ADDITIONAL_FRAMES) throw IOException("$operation returned too many frames")
                          nextCommand = Ntag424DnaProtocol.ADDITIONAL_FRAME
                      }
                      else -> throw IOException("$operation failed, status=91${status.toString(16).uppercase().padStart(2, '0')}")
                  }
              }
          }
      
          private fun isoExchange(command: ByteArray, operation: String): ByteArray {
              val response = transceive(command, operation)
              if (response.size < 2) throw IOException("$operation returned an incomplete response")
              val status = ((response[response.size - 2].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or
                  (response.last().toInt() and 0xFF)
              if (status != 0x9000 && status != 0x9100) {
                  throw IOException("$operation failed, status=${status.toString(16).uppercase().padStart(4, '0')}")
              }
              return response.copyOf(response.size - 2)
          }
      
          private fun transceive(command: ByteArray, operation: String): ByteArray {
              Log.i(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX -> $operation ${command.toHex()}")
              return isoDep.transceive(command).also {
                  Log.i(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX <- $operation ${it.toHex()} ")
              }
          }
      
          private inline fun <T> capture(label: String, warnings: MutableList<String>, action: () -> T): T? =
              try {
                  action()
              } catch (error: Exception) {
                  Log.w(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX $label failed", error)
                  warnings += "${label}失败: ${error.message ?: error.javaClass.simpleName}"
                  null
              }
      
          override fun close() {
              isoDep.close()
          }
      
          companion object {
              private const val LOG_TAG = "Ntag424DnaDemo"
              private const val LOG_PREFIX = "[NTAG424-DEMO]"
              private const val CC_FILE_ID = 0xE103
              private const val NDEF_FILE_NUMBER = 0x02
              private const val ORIGINALITY_SIGNATURE_LENGTH = 56
              private const val MAX_READ_LENGTH = 0xF0
              private const val MAX_ADDITIONAL_FRAMES = 8
              private val SDM_PARAMETER_NAMES = setOf("e", "c", "uid", "ctr", "picc_data", "cmac")
      
              fun connect(tag: Tag): Ntag424DnaDemoClient {
                  val isoDep = IsoDep.get(tag)
                      ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("标签不支持 ISO-DEP，无法作为 NTAG 424 DNA 检测")
                  isoDep.timeout = 5000
                  isoDep.connect()
                  return Ntag424DnaDemoClient(isoDep)
              }
      
              private fun Int.asAccess(): String = when (this) {
                  0x0E -> "Free"
                  0x0F -> "Never"
                  else -> "Key $this"
              }
      
              private fun ByteArray.toHex(separator: String = ""): String =
                  joinToString(separator) { "%02X".format(it) }
          }
      }
      package com.vdian.android.lib.testforgradle.nfc
      
      import java.io.IOException
      
      internal data class Ntag424Version(
          val hardwareVendorId: Int,
          val hardwareType: Int,
          val hardwareMajorVersion: Int,
          val hardwareStorageSize: Int,
          val softwareMajorVersion: Int,
          val softwareMinorVersion: Int,
          val uid: ByteArray?,
          val productionWeek: Int?,
          val productionYear: Int?
      ) {
          val looksLikeNtag424Dna: Boolean
              get() = hardwareVendorId == 0x04 && hardwareType == 0x04 &&
                  hardwareMajorVersion == 0x30 && hardwareStorageSize == 0x11
      }
      
      internal data class Ntag424FileSettings(
          val fileType: Int,
          val communicationMode: Int,
          val readKey: Int,
          val writeKey: Int,
          val readWriteKey: Int,
          val changeKey: Int,
          val fileSize: Int,
          val sdmEnabled: Boolean,
          val sdmOptions: Int?,
          val sdmMetaReadKey: Int?,
          val sdmFileReadKey: Int?,
          val sdmCounterRetrieveKey: Int?
      )
      
      internal object Ntag424DnaProtocol {
          val SELECT_NDEF_APPLICATION = byteArrayOf(
              0x00, 0xA4.toByte(), 0x04, 0x00, 0x07,
              0xD2.toByte(), 0x76, 0x00, 0x00, 0x85.toByte(), 0x01, 0x01, 0x00
          )
          val GET_VERSION = nativeCommand(0x60)
          val READ_ORIGINALITY_SIGNATURE = nativeCommand(0x3C, byteArrayOf(0x00))
          val ADDITIONAL_FRAME = nativeCommand(0xAF)
      
          fun getFileSettings(fileNumber: Int): ByteArray {
              require(fileNumber in 0..0x1F) { "File number must be 0..31" }
              return nativeCommand(0xF5, byteArrayOf(fileNumber.toByte()))
          }
      
          fun selectFile(fileId: Int): ByteArray = byteArrayOf(
              0x00, 0xA4.toByte(), 0x00, 0x0C, 0x02,
              (fileId ushr 8).toByte(), fileId.toByte()
          )
      
          fun readBinary(offset: Int, length: Int): ByteArray {
              require(offset in 0..0xFFFF) { "Offset out of range" }
              require(length in 1..256) { "Read length must be 1..256" }
              return byteArrayOf(
                  0x00, 0xB0.toByte(), (offset ushr 8).toByte(), offset.toByte(),
                  if (length == 256) 0 else length.toByte()
              )
          }
      
          fun parseVersion(data: ByteArray): Ntag424Version {
              require(data.size >= 14) { "GetVersion response is too short: ${data.size}" }
              val uid = if (data.size >= 21) data.copyOfRange(14, 21) else null
              return Ntag424Version(
                  hardwareVendorId = data.u8(0),
                  hardwareType = data.u8(1),
                  hardwareMajorVersion = data.u8(3),
                  hardwareStorageSize = data.u8(5),
                  softwareMajorVersion = data.u8(10),
                  softwareMinorVersion = data.u8(11),
                  uid = uid,
                  productionWeek = data.getOrNull(26)?.toInt()?.and(0x7F),
                  productionYear = data.getOrNull(27)?.toInt()?.and(0xFF)
              )
          }
      
          fun parseFileSettings(data: ByteArray): Ntag424FileSettings {
              require(data.size >= 7) { "GetFileSettings response is too short: ${data.size}" }
              val fileOption = data.u8(1)
              val accessRights = (data.u8(2) shl 8) or data.u8(3)
              val sdmEnabled = fileOption and 0x40 != 0
              if (sdmEnabled) require(data.size >= 10) { "SDM file settings are incomplete" }
              val sdmRights = if (sdmEnabled) (data.u8(8) shl 8) or data.u8(9) else 0
              return Ntag424FileSettings(
                  fileType = data.u8(0),
                  communicationMode = fileOption and 0x03,
                  readKey = accessRights ushr 12 and 0x0F,
                  writeKey = accessRights ushr 8 and 0x0F,
                  readWriteKey = accessRights ushr 4 and 0x0F,
                  changeKey = accessRights and 0x0F,
                  fileSize = data.u24LittleEndian(4),
                  sdmEnabled = sdmEnabled,
                  sdmOptions = if (sdmEnabled) data.u8(7) else null,
                  sdmMetaReadKey = if (sdmEnabled) sdmRights ushr 12 and 0x0F else null,
                  sdmFileReadKey = if (sdmEnabled) sdmRights ushr 8 and 0x0F else null,
                  sdmCounterRetrieveKey = if (sdmEnabled) sdmRights and 0x0F else null
              )
          }
      
          fun parseCapabilityContainer(data: ByteArray): Pair<Int, Int> {
              require(data.size >= 7) { "Capability Container is too short" }
              val declaredLength = data.u16BigEndian(0)
              require(declaredLength in 7..data.size) { "Invalid Capability Container length" }
              var offset = 7
              while (offset + 1 < declaredLength) {
                  val type = data.u8(offset)
                  if (type == 0x00) {
                      offset++
                      continue
                  }
                  if (type == 0xFE) break
                  val length = data.u8(offset + 1)
                  require(offset + 2 + length <= declaredLength) { "Invalid Capability Container TLV" }
                  if (type == 0x04 && length == 6) {
                      return data.u16BigEndian(offset + 2) to data.u16BigEndian(offset + 4)
                  }
                  offset += 2 + length
              }
              throw IOException("NDEF File Control TLV was not found")
          }
      
          private fun nativeCommand(command: Int, data: ByteArray = byteArrayOf()): ByteArray =
              if (data.isEmpty()) {
                  byteArrayOf(0x90.toByte(), command.toByte(), 0x00, 0x00, 0x00)
              } else {
                  byteArrayOf(0x90.toByte(), command.toByte(), 0x00, 0x00, data.size.toByte()) +
                      data + byteArrayOf(0x00)
              }
      
          private fun ByteArray.u8(offset: Int): Int = this[offset].toInt() and 0xFF
      
          private fun ByteArray.u16BigEndian(offset: Int): Int = (u8(offset) shl 8) or u8(offset + 1)
      
          private fun ByteArray.u24LittleEndian(offset: Int): Int =
              u8(offset) or (u8(offset + 1) shl 8) or (u8(offset + 2) shl 16)
      }

          90	    private fun readNdef(): Pair<Uri?, Int> {
          91	        isoExchange(Ntag424DnaProtocol.selectFile(CC_FILE_ID), "select CC file")
          92	        val ccHeader = isoExchange(Ntag424DnaProtocol.readBinary(0, 2), "read CC length")
          93	        require(ccHeader.size == 2) { "Invalid CC length response" }
          94	        val ccLength = ((ccHeader[0].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or
          95	            (ccHeader[1].toInt() and 0xFF)
          96	        val cc = isoExchange(Ntag424DnaProtocol.readBinary(0, ccLength), "read CC")
          97	        val (ndefFileId, maxFileSize) = Ntag424DnaProtocol.parseCapabilityContainer(cc)
          98	        isoExchange(Ntag424DnaProtocol.selectFile(ndefFileId), "select NDEF file")
          99	        val nlenBytes = isoExchange(Ntag424DnaProtocol.readBinary(0, 2), "read NLEN")
         100	        require(nlenBytes.size == 2) { "Invalid NLEN response" }
         101	        val nlen = ((nlenBytes[0].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or
         102	            (nlenBytes[1].toInt() and 0xFF)
         103	        require(nlen <= maxFileSize - 2) { "NDEF length exceeds file capacity" }
         104	        if (nlen == 0) return null to 0
         105	        val bytes = ByteArrayOutputStream(nlen)
         106	        var offset = 0
         107	        while (offset < nlen) {
         108	            val chunkSize = minOf(nlen - offset, MAX_READ_LENGTH)
         109	            val chunk = isoExchange(
         110	                Ntag424DnaProtocol.readBinary(offset + 2, chunkSize),
         111	                "read NDEF at $offset"
         112	            )
         113	            require(chunk.size == chunkSize) { "NDEF read returned ${chunk.size}, expected $chunkSize" }
         114	            bytes.write(chunk)
         115	            offset += chunkSize
         116	        }
         117	        val message = NdefMessage(bytes.toByteArray())
         118	        val uri = message.records.firstOrNull {
         119	            it.tnf == NdefRecord.TNF_WELL_KNOWN && it.type.contentEquals(NdefRecord.RTD_URI)
         120	        }?.toUri()
         121	        return uri to message.records.size
         122	    }

         124	    private fun nativeExchange(command: ByteArray, operation: String): ByteArray {
         125	        val output = ByteArrayOutputStream()
         126	        var nextCommand = command
         127	        var frames = 0
         128	        while (true) {
         129	            val response = transceive(nextCommand, operation)
         130	            if (response.size < 2 || response[response.size - 2] != 0x91.toByte()) {
         131	                throw IOException("$operation returned an invalid native response")
         132	            }
         133	            output.write(response, 0, response.size - 2)
         134	            when (val status = response.last().toInt() and 0xFF) {
         135	                0x00 -> return output.toByteArray()
         136	                0xAF -> {
         137	                    if (++frames > MAX_ADDITIONAL_FRAMES) throw IOException("$operation returned too many frames")
         138	                    nextCommand = Ntag424DnaProtocol.ADDITIONAL_FRAME
         139	                }
         140	                else -> throw IOException("$operation failed, status=91${status.toString(16).uppercase().padStart(2, '0')}")
         141	            }
         142	        }
         143	    }
         144
         145	    private fun isoExchange(command: ByteArray, operation: String): ByteArray {
         146	        val response = transceive(command, operation)
         147	        if (response.size < 2) throw IOException("$operation returned an incomplete response")
         148	        val status = ((response[response.size - 2].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or
         149	            (response.last().toInt() and 0xFF)
         150	        if (status != 0x9000 && status != 0x9100) {
         151	            throw IOException("$operation failed, status=${status.toString(16).uppercase().padStart(4, '0')}")
         152	        }
         153	        return response.copyOf(response.size - 2)
         154	    }
         155
         156	    private fun transceive(command: ByteArray, operation: String): ByteArray {
         157	        Log.i(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX -> $operation ${command.toHex()}")
         158	        return isoDep.transceive(command).also {
         159	            Log.i(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX <- $operation ${it.toHex()} ")
         160	        }
         161	    }
         162
         163	    private inline fun <T> capture(label: String, warnings: MutableList<String>, action: () -> T): T? =
         164	        try {
         165	            action()
         166	        } catch (error: Exception) {
         167	            Log.w(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX $label failed", error)
         168	            warnings += "${label}失败: ${error.message ?: error.javaClass.simpleName}"
         169	            null
         170	        }
         171
         172	    override fun close() {
         173	        isoDep.close()
         174	    }

         176	    companion object {
         177	        private const val LOG_TAG = "Ntag424DnaDemo"
         178	        private const val LOG_PREFIX = "[NTAG424-DEMO]"
         179	        private const val CC_FILE_ID = 0xE103
         180	        private const val NDEF_FILE_NUMBER = 0x02
         181	        private const val ORIGINALITY_SIGNATURE_LENGTH = 56
         182	        private const val MAX_READ_LENGTH = 0xF0
         183	        private const val MAX_ADDITIONAL_FRAMES = 8
         184	        private val SDM_PARAMETER_NAMES = setOf("e", "c", "uid", "ctr", "picc_data", "cmac")
         185
         186	        fun connect(tag: Tag): Ntag424DnaDemoClient {
         187	            val isoDep = IsoDep.get(tag)
         188	                ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("标签不支持 ISO-DEP，无法作为 NTAG 424 DNA 检测")
         189	            isoDep.timeout = 5000
         190	            isoDep.connect()
         191	            return Ntag424DnaDemoClient(isoDep)
         192	        }
         193
         194	        private fun Int.asAccess(): String = when (this) {
         195	            0x0E -> "Free"
         196	            0x0F -> "Never"
         197	            else -> "Key $this"
         198	        }
         199
         200	        private fun ByteArray.toHex(separator: String = ""): String =
         201	            joinToString(separator) { "%02X".format(it) }
         202	    }

已在现有 NFC 测试页中加入 NTAG 424 DNA Demo，采用安全只读模式，不包含默认 AES 密钥，也不会发送改密、改配置或锁卡命令。

主要实现：

- [Ntag424DnaDemoClient.kt](/Users/yulun/TestForGradle/app/src/main/java/com/vdian/android/lib/testforgradle/nfc/Ntag424DnaDemoClient.kt:13)：通过 `IsoDep` 完成标签检测，读取并展示：
  - `GetVersion` 芯片型号、软硬件版本、UID、生产批次
  - NDEF 文件权限与 SDM 开关
  - `SDMMetaReadKey`、`SDMFileReadKey`、计数器读取权限
  - NDEF 动态 URL 和疑似 SDM 参数
  - 56 字节 Originality Signature
- [Ntag424DnaProtocol.kt](/Users/yulun/TestForGradle/app/src/main/java/com/vdian/android/lib/testforgradle/nfc/Ntag424DnaProtocol.kt:36)：实现 NTAG 424 DNA APDU、Additional Frame、多帧 `GetVersion`、文件设置和 Capability Container 解析。
- [NFCIdentificationActivity.kt](/Users/yulun/TestForGradle/app/src/main/java/com/vdian/android/lib/testforgradle/nfc/NFCIdentificationActivity.kt:60)：增加 `INSPECT_NTAG_424` 操作并在后台线程执行卡片通信。
- [activity_nfctest.xml](/Users/yulun/TestForGradle/app/src/main/res/layout/activity_nfctest.xml:72)：新增“NTAG 424 DNA 安全只读检测”按钮和安全提示。
- [Ntag424DnaProtocolTest.kt](/Users/yulun/TestForGradle/app/src/test/java/com/vdian/android/lib/testforgradle/nfc/Ntag424DnaProtocolTest.kt:8)：覆盖 APDU 编码、芯片版本识别、SDM 权限解析和 CC 文件解析。

使用方式：

1. 打开现有 NFC 测试页面。
2. 点击“NTAG 424 DNA 安全只读检测”。
3. 将 NTAG 424 DNA 卡片贴近手机，并保持到结果显示完成。
4. APDU 日志可以通过标签 `[NTAG424-DEMO]` 过滤。

需要注意：Demo 当前只读取并展示 Originality Signature 和 SDM 数据，并未宣称密码学验证成功。生产环境仍应使用 NXP 公钥验证签名，并由服务端/HSM 验证 SDMMAC、解密 UID/计数器并执行原子防重放检查。对于已经启用 SDM 的卡片，读取 NDEF 会正常推进 `SDMReadCtr`。

验证已通过：

- `./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest`
- `./gradlew :app:assembleDebug`
- NTAG 424 专项 4 个单元测试
- `git diff --check`

    package com.vdian.android.lib.testforgradle.nfc
    
    import android.nfc.NfcAdapter
    import android.nfc.Tag
    import android.os.Bundle
    import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
    import androidx.core.view.ViewCompat
    import androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsCompat
    import com.vdian.android.lib.testforgradle.R
    import com.vdian.android.lib.testforgradle.databinding.ActivityNtag424DnaTestBinding
    import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
    
    class Ntag424DnaTestActivity : AppCompatActivity(), NfcAdapter.ReaderCallback {
        private lateinit var binding: ActivityNtag424DnaTestBinding
        private var nfcAdapter: NfcAdapter? = null
        private val processingTag = AtomicBoolean(false)
    
        override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
            super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
            binding = ActivityNtag424DnaTestBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
            setContentView(binding.root)
            ViewCompat.setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener(findViewById(R.id.main)) { view, insets ->
                val systemBars = insets.getInsets(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.systemBars())
                view.setPadding(systemBars.left, systemBars.top, systemBars.right, systemBars.bottom)
                insets
            }
            nfcAdapter = NfcAdapter.getDefaultAdapter(this)
            binding.openNfcSettings.setOnClickListener { BuyerNFCUtil.Util.toOpenNfc(this) }
            binding.clearNtag424Result.setOnClickListener {
                binding.ntag424Result.text = getString(R.string.ntag424_waiting_for_tag)
            }
        }
    
        override fun onResume() {
            super.onResume()
            val adapter = nfcAdapter
            when {
                adapter == null -> {
                    binding.ntag424Status.text = "当前设备不支持 NFC"
                }
                !adapter.isEnabled -> {
                    binding.ntag424Status.text = "NFC 未开启，请先打开系统 NFC 设置"
                }
                else -> {
                    binding.ntag424Status.text = "NFC 已开启，等待 NTAG 424 DNA 卡片"
                    adapter.enableReaderMode(
                        this,
                        this,
                        NfcAdapter.FLAG_READER_NFC_A or NfcAdapter.FLAG_READER_SKIP_NDEF_CHECK,
                        null
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    
        override fun onPause() {
            nfcAdapter?.disableReaderMode(this)
            super.onPause()
        }
    
        override fun onTagDiscovered(tag: Tag) {
            if (!processingTag.compareAndSet(false, true)) return
            runOnUiThread {
                binding.ntag424Status.text = "正在读取卡片，请保持贴卡..."
                binding.ntag424Result.text = "RF UID: ${tag.id.toHex(":")}"
            }
            val result = runCatching {
                Ntag424DnaDemoClient.connect(tag).use { client -> client.inspect().toDisplayText() }
            }.getOrElse { error ->
                "检测失败: ${error.message ?: error.javaClass.simpleName}\n" +
                    "请确认卡片是支持 ISO-DEP 的 NTAG 424 DNA，并保持贴卡到读取完成。"
            }
            runOnUiThread {
                binding.ntag424Status.text = "检测完成；移开卡片后可再次检测"
                binding.ntag424Result.text = result
                processingTag.set(false)
            }
        }
    
        private fun ByteArray.toHex(separator: String): String =
            joinToString(separator) { "%02X".format(it) }
    }

已在 NTAG 424 DNA 测试流程的关键节点增加统一日志，前缀为 `[NTAG424-DEMO]`。

日志覆盖：

- `MainActivity` 点击独立测试入口
- 独立页面创建、Reader Mode 启用/关闭
- NFC 不支持或未开启
- 卡片发现、RF UID、Technology 列表
- ISO-DEP 连接开始、成功和关闭
- NDEF Application 选择
- `GetVersion` 解析和芯片识别结果
- NDEF 文件权限与 SDM 状态
- Originality Signature 读取结果
- NDEF URI、record 数量和警告数量
- 每条 APDU 请求与响应
- 整体检测成功、耗时或异常堆栈
- 重复卡片回调被忽略

相关代码：
