          14	/** Personalizes one explicitly allow-listed test card with a zero transport Key 0. */
          15	internal class Ntag424DnaPersonalizationClient private constructor(
          16	    private val isoDep: IsoDep,
          17	    private val random: SecureRandom = SecureRandom()
          18	) : Closeable {
          19	    data class Result(val ndefBytes: Int, val piccDataOffset: Int, val macOffset: Int)
          20
          21	    private data class Session(
          22	        val transactionId: ByteArray,
          23	        val encKey: ByteArray,
          24	        val macKey: ByteArray,
          25	        var commandCounter: Int = 0
          26	    )
          27
          28	    fun enableSdmWithZeroKey0(): Result {
          29	        check(isoDep.tag.id.contentEquals(ALLOWED_UID)) { "仅允许配置测试卡 ${ALLOWED_UID.toHex(":")}" }
          30	        Log.w(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX personalization started with zero transport Key 0")
          31	        exchangeIso(Ntag424DnaProtocol.SELECT_NDEF_APPLICATION, "select NDEF application")
          32	        val version = readVersion()
          33	        check(version.looksLikeNtag424Dna) { "标签不是已识别的 NTAG 424 DNA" }
          34	        val currentSettings = readFileSettings()
          35	        check(!currentSettings.sdmEnabled) { "SDM 已开启，拒绝重复个性化" }
          36	        check(currentSettings.changeKey == 0) { "File 02 Change 权限不是 Key 0" }
          37
          38	        val session = authenticateZeroKey0()
          39	        val template = buildTemplate()
          40	        writeNdefFull(session, template.fileBytes)
          41	        changeFileSettingsFull(session, template.piccDataOffset, template.macOffset)
          42	        Log.w(
          43	            LOG_TAG,
          44	            "$LOG_PREFIX personalization completed, ndefBytes=${template.fileBytes.size}, " +
          45	                "piccDataOffset=${template.piccDataOffset}, macOffset=${template.macOffset}"
          46	        )
          47	        return Result(template.fileBytes.size, template.piccDataOffset, template.macOffset)
          48	    }
          49
          50	    private fun authenticateZeroKey0(): Session {
          51	        Log.i(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX AuthenticateEV2First started, keyNo=0")
          52	        val first = transceive(hex("9071000002000000"), "authenticate EV2 first part")
          53	        requireStatus(first, 0x91AF, "authenticate EV2 first part")
          54	        val encryptedRndB = first.copyOf(first.size - 2)
          55	        check(encryptedRndB.size == 16) { "Invalid encrypted RndB length" }
          56	        val rndB = Ntag424DnaEv2Crypto.decryptCbc(ZERO_KEY, ZERO_IV, encryptedRndB)
          57	        val rndA = ByteArray(16).also(random::nextBytes)
          58	        val challenge = rndA + Ntag424DnaEv2Crypto.rotateLeft(rndB)
          59	        val encryptedChallenge = Ntag424DnaEv2Crypto.encryptCbc(ZERO_KEY, ZERO_IV, challenge)
          60	        val secondCommand = byteArrayOf(0x90.toByte(), 0xAF.toByte(), 0x00, 0x00, 0x20) +
          61	            encryptedChallenge + byteArrayOf(0x00)
          62	        val second = transceive(secondCommand, "authenticate EV2 second part")
          63	        requireStatus(second, 0x9100, "authenticate EV2 second part")
          64	        val decrypted = Ntag424DnaEv2Crypto.decryptCbc(ZERO_KEY, ZERO_IV, second.copyOf(second.size - 2))
          65	        check(decrypted.size == 32) { "Invalid EV2 authentication response length" }
          66	        val returnedRndA = Ntag424DnaEv2Crypto.rotateRight(decrypted.copyOfRange(4, 20))
          67	        check(MessageDigest.isEqual(rndA, returnedRndA)) { "Card failed EV2 RndA verification" }
          68	        val transactionId = decrypted.copyOfRange(0, 4)
          69	        val encKey = Ntag424DnaEv2Crypto.deriveSessionKey(ZERO_KEY, ENC_LABEL, rndA, rndB)
          70	        val macKey = Ntag424DnaEv2Crypto.deriveSessionKey(ZERO_KEY, MAC_LABEL, rndA, rndB)
          71	        Log.i(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX AuthenticateEV2First succeeded, TI=${transactionId.toHex()}")
          72	        return Session(transactionId, encKey, macKey)
          73	    }
          74
          75	    private fun writeNdefFull(session: Session, fileBytes: ByteArray) {
          76	        val header = byteArrayOf(NDEF_FILE_NUMBER.toByte()) + littleEndian24(0) + littleEndian24(fileBytes.size)
          77	        secureFullCommand(session, WRITE_DATA_COMMAND, header, fileBytes, "write SDM NDEF template")
          78	    }
          79
          80	    private fun changeFileSettingsFull(session: Session, piccDataOffset: Int, macOffset: Int) {
          81	        val data = byteArrayOf(
          82	            0x40,             // SDM enabled, plain communication mode.
          83	            0x00, 0xE0.toByte(), // RW=Key 0, Change=Key 0, Read=free, Write=Key 0.
          84	            0xC1.toByte(),    // Encrypted UID + ReadCounter, ASCII encoding.
          85	            0xF1.toByte(), 0x21 // MetaRead=Key 2, FileRead=Key 1, CtrRet=Key 1.
          86	        ) + littleEndian24(piccDataOffset) + littleEndian24(macOffset) + littleEndian24(macOffset)
          87	        secureFullCommand(
          88	            session,
          89	            CHANGE_FILE_SETTINGS_COMMAND,
          90	            byteArrayOf(NDEF_FILE_NUMBER.toByte()),
          91	            data,
          92	            "enable SDM on NDEF file"
          93	        )
          94	    }
          95
          96	    private fun secureFullCommand(
          97	        session: Session,
          98	        command: Int,
          99	        header: ByteArray,
         100	        data: ByteArray,
         101	        operation: String
         102	    ) {
         103	        val counter = littleEndian16(session.commandCounter)
         104	        val ivInput = byteArrayOf(0xA5.toByte(), 0x5A) + session.transactionId + counter + ByteArray(8)
         105	        val iv = Ntag424DnaEv2Crypto.encryptBlock(session.encKey, ivInput)
         106	        val encryptedData = Ntag424DnaEv2Crypto.encryptCbc(
         107	            session.encKey,
         108	            iv,
         109	            Ntag424DnaEv2Crypto.pad80(data)
         110	        )
         111	        val commandMac = Ntag424DnaEv2Crypto.truncateMac(
         112	            Ntag424DnaEv2Crypto.cmac(
         113	                session.macKey,
         114	                byteArrayOf(command.toByte()) + counter + session.transactionId + header + encryptedData
         115	            )
         116	        )
         117	        val body = header + encryptedData + commandMac
         118	        check(body.size <= 255) { "$operation APDU is too large" }
         119	        val apdu = byteArrayOf(
         120	            0x90.toByte(), command.toByte(), 0x00, 0x00, body.size.toByte()
         121	        ) + body + byteArrayOf(0x00)
         122	        val response = transceive(apdu, operation)
         123	        requireStatus(response, 0x9100, operation)
         124	        check(response.size >= 10) { "$operation response MAC is missing" }
         125	        val responseData = response.copyOfRange(0, response.size - 10)
         126	        val responseMac = response.copyOfRange(response.size - 10, response.size - 2)
         127	        session.commandCounter++
         128	        val expectedMac = Ntag424DnaEv2Crypto.truncateMac(
         129	            Ntag424DnaEv2Crypto.cmac(
         130	                session.macKey,
         131	                byteArrayOf(0x00) + littleEndian16(session.commandCounter) +
         132	                    session.transactionId + responseData
         133	            )
         134	        )
         135	        check(MessageDigest.isEqual(responseMac, expectedMac)) { "$operation response MAC verification failed" }
         136	        Log.i(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX $operation succeeded, cmdCtr=${session.commandCounter}")
         137	    }
         138
         139	    private fun readVersion(): Ntag424Version {
         140	        val data = ArrayList<Byte>()
         141	        var command = Ntag424DnaProtocol.GET_VERSION
         142	        repeat(3) { frame ->
         143	            val response = transceive(command, "get version part ${frame + 1}")
         144	            val expected = if (frame < 2) 0x91AF else 0x9100
         145	            requireStatus(response, expected, "get version part ${frame + 1}")
         146	            data += response.copyOf(response.size - 2).toList()
         147	            command = Ntag424DnaProtocol.ADDITIONAL_FRAME
         148	        }
         149	        return Ntag424DnaProtocol.parseVersion(data.toByteArray())
         150	    }
         151
         152	    private fun readFileSettings(): Ntag424FileSettings {
         153	        val response = transceive(Ntag424DnaProtocol.getFileSettings(NDEF_FILE_NUMBER), "get NDEF file settings")
         154	        requireStatus(response, 0x9100, "get NDEF file settings")
         155	        return Ntag424DnaProtocol.parseFileSettings(response.copyOf(response.size - 2))
         156	    }
         157
         158	    private data class Template(val fileBytes: ByteArray, val piccDataOffset: Int, val macOffset: Int)
         159
         160	    private fun buildTemplate(): Template {
         161	        val piccPlaceholder = "0".repeat(32)
         162	        val macPlaceholder = "0".repeat(16)
         163	        val url = "https://wdb-applink.weidian.com/ntag424?e=$piccPlaceholder&c=$macPlaceholder"
         164	        val message = NdefMessage(arrayOf(NdefRecord.createUri(Uri.parse(url)))).toByteArray()
         165	        val fileBytes = byteArrayOf((message.size ushr 8).toByte(), message.size.toByte()) + message
         166	        val piccMarker = "?e=".toByteArray(Charsets.US_ASCII)
         167	        val macMarker = "&c=".toByteArray(Charsets.US_ASCII)
         168	        val piccDataOffset = fileBytes.indexOf(piccMarker) + piccMarker.size
         169	        val macOffset = fileBytes.indexOf(macMarker) + macMarker.size
         170	        check(piccDataOffset >= piccMarker.size && macOffset >= macMarker.size) { "SDM URL offsets not found" }
         171	        check(fileBytes.size <= NDEF_FILE_SIZE) { "SDM NDEF template exceeds file size" }
         172	        return Template(fileBytes, piccDataOffset, macOffset)
         173	    }
         174
         175	    private fun exchangeIso(command: ByteArray, operation: String) {
         176	        requireStatus(transceive(command, operation), 0x9000, operation)
         177	    }
         178
         179	    private fun transceive(command: ByteArray, operation: String): ByteArray {
         180	        Log.i(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX -> $operation ${command.toSafeLog()}")
         181	        return isoDep.transceive(command).also { Log.i(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX <- $operation ${it.toHex()}") }
         182	    }
         183
         184	    private fun requireStatus(response: ByteArray, expected: Int, operation: String) {
         185	        if (response.size < 2) throw IOException("$operation returned an incomplete response")
         186	        val actual = ((response[response.size - 2].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or
         187	            (response.last().toInt() and 0xFF)
         188	        if (actual != expected) {
         189	            throw IOException("$operation failed, status=${actual.toString(16).uppercase().padStart(4, '0')}")
         190	        }
         191	    }
         192
         193	    override fun close() {
         194	        isoDep.close()
         195	        Log.i(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX personalization ISO-DEP connection closed")
         196	    }
         197
         198	    companion object {
         199	        private const val LOG_TAG = "Ntag424Personalize"
         200	        private const val LOG_PREFIX = "[NTAG424-SDM-CONFIG]"
         201	        private const val NDEF_FILE_NUMBER = 2
         202	        private const val NDEF_FILE_SIZE = 256
         203	        private const val WRITE_DATA_COMMAND = 0x8D
         204	        private const val CHANGE_FILE_SETTINGS_COMMAND = 0x5F
         205	        private val ZERO_KEY = ByteArray(16)
         206	        private val ZERO_IV = ByteArray(16)
         207	        private val ENC_LABEL = byteArrayOf(0xA5.toByte(), 0x5A)
         208	        private val MAC_LABEL = byteArrayOf(0x5A, 0xA5.toByte())
         209	        private val ALLOWED_UID = hex("04187262E51690")
         210
         211	        fun connect(tag: Tag): Ntag424DnaPersonalizationClient {
         212	            val isoDep = IsoDep.get(tag) ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("标签不支持 ISO-DEP")
         213	            isoDep.timeout = 5000
         214	            isoDep.connect()
         215	            return Ntag424DnaPersonalizationClient(isoDep)
         216	        }
         217
         218	        private fun littleEndian16(value: Int): ByteArray =
         219	            byteArrayOf(value.toByte(), (value ushr 8).toByte())
         220
         221	        private fun littleEndian24(value: Int): ByteArray =
         222	            byteArrayOf(value.toByte(), (value ushr 8).toByte(), (value ushr 16).toByte())
         223
         224	        private fun ByteArray.indexOf(needle: ByteArray): Int =
         225	            indices.firstOrNull { start ->
         226	                start + needle.size <= size && needle.indices.all { this[start + it] == needle[it] }
         227	            } ?: -1
         228
         229	        private fun ByteArray.toSafeLog(): String =
         230	            if (size > 24) "${copyOfRange(0, 5).toHex()} [${size - 6} protected bytes] 00" else toHex()
         231
         232	        private fun ByteArray.toHex(separator: String = ""): String =
         233	            joinToString(separator) { "%02X".format(it) }
         234
         235	        private fun hex(value: String): ByteArray = value.chunked(2).map { it.toInt(16).toByte() }.toByteArray()
         236	    }
         237	}

          42	        super.onResume()
          43	        val adapter = nfcAdapter

          47	                binding.ntag424Status.text = "当前设备不支持 NFC"

          55	                adapter.enableReaderMode(

          58	                    NfcAdapter.FLAG_READER_NFC_A or NfcAdapter.FLAG_READER_SKIP_NDEF_CHECK,
          59	                    null

          72	    override fun onTagDiscovered(tag: Tag) {
          73	        if (!processingTag.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
          74	            Log.w(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX ignored tag while another inspection is running")
          75	            return
          76	        }
          77	        val startedAt = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
          78	        val configureSdm = pendingSdmConfiguration.getAndSet(false)
          79	        Log.i(
          80	            LOG_TAG,
          81	            "$LOG_PREFIX tag discovered, operation=${if (configureSdm) "ENABLE_SDM" else "INSPECT"}, " +
          82	                "rfUid=${tag.id.toHex(":")}, tech=${tag.techList.joinToString()}"
          83	        )
          84	        runOnUiThread {
          85	            binding.ntag424Status.text = if (configureSdm) {
          86	                "正在使用全零 Key 0 配置 SDM，请勿移开卡片..."
          87	            } else {
          88	                "正在读取卡片，请保持贴卡..."
          89	            }
          90	            binding.ntag424Result.text = "RF UID: ${tag.id.toHex(":")}"
          91	        }
          92	        val inspection = runCatching {
          93	            if (configureSdm) {
          94	                Ntag424DnaPersonalizationClient.connect(tag).use { client ->
          95	                    val result = client.enableSdmWithZeroKey0()
          96	                    "SDM 配置成功\n" +
          97	                        "NDEF bytes: ${result.ndefBytes}\n" +
          98	                        "PICCDataOffset: ${result.piccDataOffset}\n" +
          99	                        "SDMMACOffset: ${result.macOffset}\n\n" +
         100	                        "请移开卡片后重新贴卡，执行只读检测确认 SDM 状态。"
         101	                }
         102	            } else {
         103	                Ntag424DnaDemoClient.connect(tag).use { client -> client.inspect().toDisplayText() }
         104	            }
         105	        }
         106	        val result = inspection.getOrElse { error ->
         107	            Log.e(
         108	                LOG_TAG,
         109	                "$LOG_PREFIX inspection failed, elapsedMs=${SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - startedAt}",
         110	                error
         111	            )
         112	            "检测失败: ${error.message ?: error.javaClass.simpleName}\n" +
         113	                "请确认卡片是支持 ISO-DEP 的 NTAG 424 DNA，并保持贴卡到读取完成。"
         114	        }
         115	        if (inspection.isSuccess) {
         116	            Log.i(
         117	                LOG_TAG,
         118	                "$LOG_PREFIX inspection completed, elapsedMs=${SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - startedAt}"
         119	            )
         120	        }
         121	        runOnUiThread {
         122	            binding.ntag424Status.text = "检测完成；移开卡片后可再次检测"
         123	            binding.ntag424Result.text = result
         124	            processingTag.set(false)
         125	        }
         126	    }

         128	    private fun ByteArray.toHex(separator: String): String =
         129	        joinToString(separator) { "%02X".format(it) }

         134	            .setMessage(

         136	                    "执行 EV2 认证，覆盖当前 NDEF，并开启 SDM。该配置使用全零测试密钥，绝不能用于生产。"
         137	            )
         138	            .setNegativeButton("取消", null)
         139	            .setPositiveButton("确认，等待贴卡") { _, _ ->
         140	                pendingSdmConfiguration.set(true)
         141	                binding.ntag424Status.text = "已授权一次 SDM 配置，请贴指定测试卡"
         142	                binding.ntag424Result.text =
         143	                    "等待 UID 04:18:72:62:E5:16:90\n认证失败或 UID 不匹配时不会发送写入命令。"
         144	                Log.w(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX zero-Key SDM configuration armed for one tag")
         145	            }

         138	- FileType：StandardData File（00）
         139	- FileOption：Plain communication，SDM disabled（00）
         140	- FileSize：256 bytes（00 01 00，小端）
         141	- AccessRights 在线路上按低字节在前编码：E0 EE -> 逻辑值 EE E0
         142	  - Read：Free（E）
         143	  - Write：Free（E）
         144	  - ReadWrite：Free（E）
         145	  - Change：Key 0（0）
         146
         147	结论：当前 NDEF 文件可以匿名读取和写入，但修改文件设置（包括开启 SDM）必须先使用 Key 0 完成认证。
         148
         149	三、当前 NDEF 内容
         150
         151	- NLEN：00 CE（206 bytes）
         152	- NDEF records：2
         153	- URI host：wdb-applink.weidian.com
         154	- Android Application Record：com.koudai.weidian.buyer
         155	- 当前 URL 是静态 NDEF 内容，没有 SDM PICCData、ReadCounter 或 SDMMAC 占位字段。
         156
         157	四、Originality Signature
         158
         159	- Read_Sig 命令：90 3C 00 00 01 00 00
         160	- 实卡返回 56-byte signature，响应状态为 91 90：
         161	  7A268D0725176746995DCBDB301F71B5FEE884FDC145ED5A5C6555CFF832EA97
         162	  415A71D6D8C99347A2B0635EE01585D80882FC0118169760
         163	- NXP AN12196 的 Read_Sig 示例同样使用 91 90 作为响应结尾。APP 已兼容该实卡行为。
         164	- 当前 Demo 仅读取签名，尚未使用 NXP 公钥执行 ECDSA secp224r1 验签。
         165
         166	五、APP 开启 SDM 的可行性判断
         167
         168	技术上可以通过 Android APP 开启；当前 Demo 已增加仅面向本测试卡的受控写卡入口。开启条件如下：
         169
         170	1. 必须掌握当前卡片正确的 AppMasterKey（Key 0）。TagInfo 显示“Default AppMasterKey”不能单独证明 Key 0 一定仍是 16-byte 全零值；应以供应商或个性化记录为准，禁止盲目重试未知密钥。
         171	2. APP 需要实现 AuthenticateEV2First（或卡片当前模式对应的认证）以及 Full Secure Messaging，包括会话 ENC/MAC 密钥、TI 和命令计数器处理。
         172	3. 先把 NDEF 改成 SDM URL 模板，为 PICCData、SDMMAC 等动态字段预留固定长度占位符，并按最终 NDEF 字节计算 PICCDataOffset、SDMMACInputOffset 和 SDMMACOffset。
         173	4. 通过受 Full Secure Messaging 保护的 ChangeFileSettings 为 File 02 设置 FileOption、AccessRights、SDMOptions、SDMAccessRights 和各字段 offset。不能使用一条未认证的明文 ChangeFileSettings 开启。
         174	5. 必须预先确定 SDMMetaReadKey、SDMFileReadKey 和 SDMCtrRet 对应的 AppKey，并替换所有仍为出厂全零值的应用密钥。生产密钥不能硬编码进 APK。
         175	6. 开启后应立即重新读取 GetFileSettings 和 NDEF，并由后端/HSM 验证 SDMMAC、解密 UID/ReadCounter、原子记录计数器以防重放。
         176
         177	建议：这张测试卡可用于受控环境中的 SDM 个性化 Demo；正式产品应由发卡工具、SAM 或后端/HSM 管理 Key 0 和每卡多样化密钥，APP 只负责读卡和转交动态数据。
         178
         179
         180	============================================================
         181	2026-08-19 APP 全零 Key 0 开启 SDM 测试方案
         182	============================================================
         183
         184	一、操作范围与保护条件
         185
         186	- 测试页面增加“使用全零 Key 0 开启测试卡 SDM”按钮；普通贴卡仍只执行检测。
         187	- 写入流程硬限制 RF UID 为 04:18:72:62:E5:16:90，其他卡片不会进入认证或写入流程。
         188	- 用户确认后只授权下一次贴卡；APP 使用 16-byte 全零 Key 0 执行 AuthenticateEV2First。
         189	- 只有卡片通过 NTAG 424 DNA 版本检查、File 02 尚未开启 SDM、Change 权限为 Key 0，并且 EV2 双向随机数校验成功后，才会发送写入命令。
         190	- WriteData 与 ChangeFileSettings 均使用 EV2 Full Secure Messaging，并校验卡片响应 MAC。
         191	- 此入口不会修改 Key 0~Key 4。全零传输密钥仅用于本测试卡，不能作为生产方案。
         192
         193	二、将写入的 NDEF 与 File 02 设置
         194
         195	- NDEF URL 模板：https://wdb-applink.weidian.com/ntag424?e=<32 个十六进制字符>&c=<16 个十六进制字符>
         196	- APP 根据最终 NDEF 文件字节动态计算 ENCPICCDataOffset、SDMMACOffset 和 SDMMACInputOffset，不使用固定偏移。
         197	- FileOption：40（SDM enabled，Plain communication）。
         198	- AccessRights：00 E0（ReadWrite=Key 0、Change=Key 0、Read=Free、Write=Key 0）。
         199	- SDMOptions：C1（Encrypted PICCData，包含 UID 和 SDMReadCtr，ASCII 输出）。
         200	- SDMAccessRights：F1 21（SDMMetaRead=Key 2、SDMFileRead=Key 1、SDMCtrRet=Key 1）。
         201	- 当前步骤只假定 Key 0 为全零；动态字段后续能否由服务端正确解密/验签，取决于服务端是否掌握卡内实际 Key 1 和 Key 2。若卡片仍为全默认密钥，则二者也是全零。
         202
         203	三、实卡验证状态
         204
         205	- 代码和 NXP AN12196 的全零密钥官方向量已通过 JVM 单元测试，包括认证、会话密钥派生、命令 IV、ChangeFileSettings 密文和截断 MAC。
         206	- 尚未在物理卡上执行写入。操作成功后应移开并重新贴卡，确认 GetFileSettings 显示 SDM enabled，并检查 NDEF 中 e/c 字段是否由芯片动态替换。
         207	- 实卡操作日志过滤标记：[NTAG424-SDM-CONFIG]。若失败，应保留完整命令节点和状态码日志，但不要记录或上传真实生产密钥。

      ---
      name: diagnosing-bugs
      description: Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions. Use when the user says "diagnose"/"debug this", or reports something broken/throwing/failing/slow.
      ---
      
      # Diagnosing Bugs
      
      A discipline for hard bugs. Skip phases only when explicitly justified.
      
      When exploring the codebase, read `CONTEXT.md` (if it exists) to get a clear mental model of the relevant modules, and check ADRs in the area you're touching.
      
      ## Phase 1 — Build a feedback loop
      
      **This is the skill.** Everything else is mechanical. If you have a **tight** pass/fail signal for the bug — one that goes red on _this_ bug — you will find the cause; bisection, hypothesis-testing, and instrumentation all just consume it. If you don't have one, no amount of staring at code will save you.
      
      Spend disproportionate effort here. **Be aggressive. Be creative. Refuse to give up.**
      
      ### Ways to construct one — try them in roughly this order
      
      1. **Failing test** at whatever seam reaches the bug — unit, integration, e2e.
      2. **Curl / HTTP script** against a running dev server.
      3. **CLI invocation** with a fixture input, diffing stdout against a known-good snapshot.
      4. **Headless browser script** (Playwright / Puppeteer) — drives the UI, asserts on DOM/console/network.
      5. **Replay a captured trace.** Save a real network request / payload / event log to disk; replay it through the code path in isolation.
      6. **Throwaway harness.** Spin up a minimal subset of the system (one service, mocked deps) that exercises the bug code path with a single function call.
      7. **Property / fuzz loop.** If the bug is "sometimes wrong output", run 1000 random inputs and look for the failure mode.
      8. **Bisection harness.** If the bug appeared between two known states (commit, dataset, version), automate "boot at state X, check, repeat" so you can `git bisect run` it.
      9. **Differential loop.** Run the same input through old-version vs new-version (or two configs) and diff outputs.
      10. **HITL bash script.** Last resort. If a human must click, drive _them_ with `scripts/hitl-loop.template.sh` so the loop is still structured. Captured output feeds back to you.
      
      Build the right feedback loop, and the bug is 90% fixed.
      
      ### Tighten the loop
      
      Treat the loop as a product. Once you have _a_ loop, **tighten** it:
      
      - Can I make it faster? (Cache setup, skip unrelated init, narrow the test scope.)
      - Can I make the signal sharper? (Assert on the specific symptom, not "didn't crash".)
      - Can I make it more deterministic? (Pin time, seed RNG, isolate filesystem, freeze network.)
      
      A 30-second flaky loop is barely better than no loop; a 2-second deterministic one is tight — a debugging superpower.
      
      ### Non-deterministic bugs
      
      The goal is not a clean repro but a **higher reproduction rate**. Loop the trigger 100×, parallelise, add stress, narrow timing windows, inject sleeps. A 50%-flake bug is debuggable; 1% is not — keep raising the rate until it's debuggable.
      
      ### When you genuinely cannot build a loop
      
      Stop and say so explicitly. List what you tried. Ask the user for: (a) access to whatever environment reproduces it, (b) a captured artifact (HAR file, log dump, core dump, screen recording with timestamps), or (c) permission to add temporary production instrumentation. Do **not** proceed to hypothesise without a loop.
      
      ### Completion criterion — a tight loop that goes red
      
      Phase 1 is done when the loop is **tight** and **red-capable**: you can name **one command** — a script path, a test invocation, a curl — that you have **already run at least once** (paste the invocation and its output), and that is:
      
      - [ ] **Red-capable** — it drives the actual bug code path and asserts the **user's exact symptom**, so it can go red on this bug and green once fixed. Not "runs without erroring" — it must be able to _catch this specific bug_.
      - [ ] **Deterministic** — same verdict every run (flaky bugs: a pinned, high reproduction rate, per above).
      - [ ] **Fast** — seconds, not minutes.
      - [ ] **Agent-runnable** — you can run it unattended; a human in the loop only via `scripts/hitl-loop.template.sh`.
      
      If you catch yourself reading code to build a theory before this command exists, **stop — jumping straight to a hypothesis is the exact failure this skill prevents.** No red-capable command, no Phase 2.
      
      ## Phase 2 — Reproduce + minimise
      
      Run the loop. Watch it go red — the bug appears.
      
      Confirm:
      
      - [ ] The loop produces the failure mode the **user** described — not a different failure that happens to be nearby. Wrong bug = wrong fix.
      - [ ] The failure is reproducible across multiple runs (or, for non-deterministic bugs, reproducible at a high enough rate to debug against).
      - [ ] You have captured the exact symptom (error message, wrong output, slow timing) so later phases can verify the fix actually addresses it.
      
      ### Minimise
      
      Once it's red, shrink the repro to the **smallest scenario that still goes red**. Cut inputs, callers, config, data, and steps **one at a time**, re-running the loop after each cut — keep only what's load-bearing for the failure.
      
      Why bother: a minimal repro shrinks the hypothesis space in Phase 3 (fewer moving parts left to suspect) and becomes the clean regression test in Phase 5.
      
      Done when **every remaining element is load-bearing** — removing any one of them makes the loop go green.
      
      Do not proceed until you have reproduced **and** minimised.
      
      ## Phase 3 — Hypothesise
      
      Generate **3–5 ranked hypotheses** before testing any of them. Single-hypothesis generation anchors on the first plausible idea.
      
      Each hypothesis must be **falsifiable**: state the prediction it makes.
      
      > Format: "If <X> is the cause, then <changing Y> will make the bug disappear / <changing Z> will make it worse."
      
      If you cannot state the prediction, the hypothesis is a vibe — discard or sharpen it.
      
      **Show the ranked list to the user before testing.** They often have domain knowledge that re-ranks instantly ("we just deployed a change to #3"), or know hypotheses they've already ruled out. Cheap checkpoint, big time saver. Don't block on it — proceed with your ranking if the user is AFK.
      
      ## Phase 4 — Instrument
      
      Each probe must map to a specific prediction from Phase 3. **Change one variable at a time.**
      
      Tool preference:
      
      1. **Debugger / REPL inspection** if the env supports it. One breakpoint beats ten logs.
      2. **Targeted logs** at the boundaries that distinguish hypotheses.
      3. Never "log everything and grep".
      
      **Tag every debug log** with a unique prefix, e.g. `[DEBUG-a4f2]`. Cleanup at the end becomes a single grep. Untagged logs survive; tagged logs die.
      
      **Perf branch.** For performance regressions, logs are usually wrong. Instead: establish a baseline measurement (timing harness, `performance.now()`, profiler, query plan), then bisect. Measure first, fix second.
      
      ## Phase 5 — Fix + regression test
      
      Write the regression test **before the fix** — but only if there is a **correct seam** for it.
      
      A correct seam is one where the test exercises the **real bug pattern** as it occurs at the call site. If the only available seam is too shallow (single-caller test when the bug needs multiple callers, unit test that can't replicate the chain that triggered the bug), a regression test there gives false confidence.
      
      **If no correct seam exists, that itself is the finding.** Note it. The codebase architecture is preventing the bug from being locked down. Flag this for the next phase.
      
      If a correct seam exists:
      
      1. Turn the minimised repro into a failing test at that seam.
      2. Watch it fail.
      3. Apply the fix.
      4. Watch it pass.
      5. Re-run the Phase 1 feedback loop against the original (un-minimised) scenario.
      
      ## Phase 6 — Cleanup + post-mortem
      
      Required before declaring done:
      
      - [ ] Original repro no longer reproduces (re-run the Phase 1 loop)
      - [ ] Regression test passes (or absence of seam is documented)
      - [ ] All `[DEBUG-...]` instrumentation removed (`grep` the prefix)
      - [ ] Throwaway prototypes deleted (or moved to a clearly-marked debug location)
      - [ ] The hypothesis that turned out correct is stated in the commit / PR message — so the next debugger learns
      
      **Then ask: what would have prevented this bug?** If the answer involves architectural change (no good test seam, tangled callers, hidden coupling) hand off to the `/improve-codebase-architecture` skill with the specifics. Make the recommendation **after** the fix is in, not before — you have more information now than when you started.

已建立复现信号：设备缓冲区显示被拒绝的命令是 `90 8D ... Lc=6F`，整条 APDU 117 bytes，低于卡片 128-byte 帧能力；因此“APDU 太长”不是首选解释。

按可能性排序的可证伪假设：

1. 当前 File 02 是 `CommMode.Plain`，代码却发送 Full 模式 `WriteData`；卡片把密文和 8-byte MAC 当普通数据，发现它与命令头声明长度不一致，因此返回 `917E`。改成认证后的 Plain 写入应消除 `917E`。
2. 卡片要求原生 `WriteData` 分帧；若成立，把同一 NDEF 分成短块会成功。
3. EV2 会话密钥或 MAC 错误；若成立，卡片更应返回完整性错误 `911E`，且官方向量/双向随机数验证不足以覆盖实卡会话。
4. 文件写权限不符；若成立，应返回权限错误，但实测设置明确是 Write=Free。

我继续用 NXP 的“Plain 文件写入 + 随后的安全 ChangeFileSettings”流程验证假设 1，并先补一个能捕捉通信模式选错的回归测试。

      5.7 Prepare NDEF message
      
      5.7.1 NDEF
      NDEF is NFC Forum defined data exchange format. The NDEF specification defines a message encapsulation
      format to exchange information between an NFC forum device and another NFC forum device or an NFC forum
      Tag. NDEF is a lightweight, binary message format that can be used to encapsulate one or more application-
      defined payloads of arbitrary type and size into a single construct called NDEF message.
      An application-defined payload is encapsulated inside one single NDEF record, or chunked into two or more
      NDEF records.
      One or more application-defined payloads contains the data: vCard, URL etc.
      
      5.7.2 NDEF Length
      Size: 2-Byte
      [Len] = “Header for URI record” length + NDEF message length.
      In this example: 0x005E = 94d Bytes (Header for URI record” length – 5d Bytes + NDEF message length – 89d
      Bytes)

      5 Personalization example
      Following steps are optional and used as an example only. Final steps shall be defined and configured by
      customer needs.
      Example configuration:
      • NDEF content with placeholders: https://choose.url.com/ntag424?e=0000000000
        0000000000000000000000&c=0000000000000000
      • mirroring of PICCdata encrypted (ENCPICCData)
        – Encryption key (KSDMMetaRead): 0x02
        – ENCPICCDataOffset: 0x20
      • CMAC computation:
        – CMAC-ing key (KSDMFileRead) which is used to generate session key KSesSDMFileReadMAC: 0x01
        – SDMMACOffset: 0x43
      • empty payload for CMAC input (SDMMACInputOffset == SDMMACOffset)
      • GetCounterValue command protected by key 0x01
      • No NFCCounter limit
      • no mirroring and no encryption of SDMFileData - SDMENCFileData
      
      Steps:
       1. ISO14443-4 PICC Activation [Section 5.1]
       2. Originality signature verification [Section 5.2]
       3. ISO SELECT NDEF application using DF Name [Section 5.3]
       4. Get File Settings [Section 5.4]
       5. GetVersion [Section 5.5]
       6. AuthenticateFirst with ApplicationKey 0x00 [Section 5.6]
       7. Prepare NDEF data [Section 5.7]
       8. Write data to 0xE104 (NDEF File) [Section 5.8]
       9. Change File Settings of 0xE104 [Section 5.9]
      10. AuthenticateEV2First with ApplicationKey 0x03 [Section 5.10]
      11. ISO SELECT Proprietary File 0xE105 [Section 5.11]
      12. Write data to 0xE105 (Proprietary File) [Section 5.12]
      13. ISO SELECT Capability Container file 0xE103 [Section 5.13]
      14. AuthenticateAESNonFirst with ApplicationKey 0x00 [Section 5.14]
      15. Write data to 0xE103 (CC file) - READ-ONLY [Section 5.15]
      16. Change Key - ApplicationKey 0x02 (Using AES-128 Key diversification) [Section 5.16.1]
      17. Change Key - ApplicationKey 0x00 (Master Key) [Section 5.16.2]

      4 Standard Secure Messaging (SSM)
      Standard Secure messaging is the most up-to-date secure messaging mode, with following properties:
      • A plain/maced/encrypted channel of communication established between PCD and PICC
      
        Table 6. Communication modes in SSM
         Communication Mode      Bit Representation                   Explanation
         CommMode.Plain          X0                                   Plain communication: No encryption is used at all.
         CommMode.MAC            01                                   MACed communication: The data is transferred in plain, but a 4
                                                                      bytes or 8 bytes MAC is added to the message.
         CommMode.Full           11                                   Encrypted communication: Full protection for integrity,
                                                                      authenticity, and confidentiality.
      • Confidentiality and integrity are protected by using two session keys (generated on both sides - PCD and
        PICC)
      • Standard Secure messaging is established by successful Cmd.AuthenticateEV2First and
        Cmd.AuthenticateEV2NonFirst - allows cryptographically binding of all messages within one transaction by
        using a transaction identifier (TI) and a command counter (CmdCtr)
      • For an Authorized changes (settings, data)
      
      
      
      
       Figure 6. NTAG 424 DNA Secure messaging options

      5.8.2 Write NDEF File - using Cmd.WriteData, CommMode.FULL
      Usually there is no need to write NDEF data over encrypted channel, as NDEF File contains end consumer

                              In order to avoid interleaving of transactions from multiple PCDs toward one PICC, the
                              Transaction Identifier (TI) is included in each MAC that is calculated over commands
                              or responses. The TI is generated by the PICC and communicated to the PCD with a
                              successful execution of an AuthenticateEV2First command, see Section 10.4.1. The size
                              is 4 bytes and these 4 bytes can hold any value. The TI is treated as a byte array, so
                              there is no notion of MSB and LSB.
      
                      9.1.2 Command Counter
                              A command counter is included in the MAC calculation for commands and responses in
                              order to prevent e.g. replay attacks. It is also used to construct the Initialization Vector
                              (IV) for encryption and decryption.
                              Each command, besides few exceptions, see below, is counted by the command counter
                              CmdCtr which is a 16-bit unsigned integer. Both sides count commands, so the actual
                              value of the CmdCtr is never transmitted. The CmdCtr is reset to 0000h at PCD and
                              PICC after a successful AuthenticateEV2First authentication and it is maintained as
                              long as the PICC remains authenticated. In cryptographic calculations, the CmdCtr is
                              represented LSB first. Subsequent authentications using AuthenticateEV2NonFirst do not
                              affect the CmdCtr. Subsequent authentications using the AuthenticateEV2First will reset
                              the CmdCtr to 0000h. The CmdCtr is increased between the command and response, for
                              all communication modes.
                              When a MAC on a command is calculated at PCD side that includes the CmdCtr, it uses
                              the current CmdCtr. The CmdCtr is afterwards incremented by 1. At PICC side, a MAC
                              appended at received commands is checked using the current value of CmdCtr. If the
                              MAC matches, CmdCtr is incremented by 1 after successful reception of the command,
                              and before sending a response.
                              For CommMode.Full, the same holds for both the MAC and encryption IV calculation, i.e.
                              the non-increased value is used for the command calculations while the increased value
                              is used for the response calculations.
                              If the CmdCtr holds the value FFFFh and a command maintaining the active
                              authentication arrives at the PICC, this leads to an error response and the command is
                              handled like the MAC was wrong.
                              Command chaining, see Section 8.5, does not affect the counter. The chained command
                              is considered as a single command, just as for the other aspects of secure messaging,
                              and thus the related counter is increased only once.
      
                      9.1.3 MAC Calculation
                              MACs are calculated using the underlying block cipher according to the CMAC standard
                              described in [6]. Padding is applied according to the standard.

                    10.8.2 WriteData
                           The WriteData command allows writing data to StandardData Files. NT4H2421Gx
                           supports tearing protection for data that is sent within one communication frame to the
                           file. Consequently, when using ISO/IEC 14443-4 chaining to write to a StandardData file,
                           each frame itself is tearing protected but an interrupted chaining can lead to inconsistent
                           files. Using single-frame WriteData commands instead of using the chaining can enable
                           better control of the overall write process.
                           Depending on the communication mode settings of the Data file, data needs to be sent
                           with either CommMode.Plain, CommMode.MAC or CommMode.Full. All cryptographic
                           operations are done in CBC mode. In case of CommMode.MAC or CommMode.Full,
                           the validity of data is verified by the PICC by checking the MAC. If the verification fails,
                           the PICC stops further user memory programming and returns an Integrity Error to the
                           PCD. As a consequence of the Integrity Error, any transaction, which might have begun,
                           is automatically aborted. This can lead to the same situation as described above for an
                           interrupted WriteData using chained communication.

## Assistant

根因已经由 NXP 数据手册确认：`WriteData` 必须严格采用目标文件当前的通信模式，而且即使 Plain 命令发生在 EV2 已认证状态，卡片也会把 `CmdCtr` 从 0 增加到 1。修复现在按实卡的 `CommMode.Plain` 发送明文 `WriteData`，成功后以 `CmdCtr=1` 发送 Full `ChangeFileSettings`；认证仍然先于任何写入。

不是，这份日志明确显示 SDM 尚未开启，只是 NDEF 模板已经写入成功。

关键证据：

```text
GetFileSettings:
0000E0EE0001009100
   ^^
FileOption = 00
```

日志解析结果也明确是：

```text
sdmEnabled=false
```

同时：

```text
NLEN = 005A
NDEF = .../ntag424?e=000000...&c=000000...
```

说明当前卡片处于中间状态：

1. 全零 Key 0 认证成功。
2. Plain `WriteData` 成功，原 NDEF 已被 SDM URL 模板覆盖。
3. `ChangeFileSettings` 没有成功，所以芯片没有动态替换 `e` 和 `c`，读取结果仍然全是零。

真正成功后，`GetFileSettings` 应类似：

```text
00 40 00 E0 00 01 00 C1 F1 21 ...
   ^^
FileOption = 40，SDM enabled
```

关于开启后的写入方式：按照我们计划写入的 `AccessRights=00 E0`：

- 普通读取仍然免费。
- 写入需要先用 Key 0 认证。
- 数据传输模式仍是 Plain，不需要加密 NDEF 内容。
- Android 标准 `Ndef.writeNdefMessage()` 不会执行 NTAG 424 的 EV2 Key 0 认证，因此通常会写入失败。
- APP 使用 `IsoDep` 先完成 Key 0 认证，再发送 Plain `WriteData`，仍然可以写入。
- 未认证直接写入，预计返回 `91AE Authentication Error`。

当前状态可以安全重试：再次点击红色按钮并贴卡。它会重新写入相同模板，然后再次执行 `ChangeFileSettings`。请同时过滤两个标签：

```text
Ntag424Personalize
Ntag424DnaTest
```

重点提供这一段：

```text
plain NDEF write succeeded, cmdCtr=1
-> enable SDM on NDEF file ...
<- enable SDM on NDEF file ...
```

设备当前 Logcat 缓冲区只保留了这次 `INSPECT`，没有保留前一次 `ChangeFileSettings` 的失败状态码，因此暂时无法判断第二阶段为何没有成功。

      package com.vdian.android.lib.testforgradle.nfc
      
      import android.app.PendingIntent
      import android.content.Context
      import android.content.Intent
      import android.content.IntentFilter
      import android.nfc.NfcAdapter
      import android.nfc.Tag
      import android.nfc.tech.IsoDep
      import android.nfc.tech.NfcA
      import android.nfc.tech.Ndef
      import android.nfc.tech.NdefFormatable
      import android.os.Build
      import android.os.Bundle
      import android.os.SystemClock
      import androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog
      import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
      import androidx.core.view.ViewCompat
      import androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsCompat
      import com.vdian.android.lib.testforgradle.R
      import com.vdian.android.lib.testforgradle.databinding.ActivityNfctestBinding
      import java.util.concurrent.Executors
      import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger
      
      
      class NFCIdentificationActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
          private lateinit var nfcTestBinding: ActivityNfctestBinding
      
          private var mNfcAdapter: NfcAdapter? = null
          private lateinit var mPendingIntent: PendingIntent
          private val cardExecutor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor()
          private val scanSequence = AtomicInteger()
          private var operation = Operation.READ
      
          override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
              super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
              if (redirectLegacyColdLaunch(intent)) return
              nfcTestBinding = ActivityNfctestBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
              setContentView(nfcTestBinding.root)
              android.util.Log.i(
                  LOG_TAG,
                  "$LOG_PREFIX onCreate action=${intent.action}, hasTag=${intent.hasExtra(NfcAdapter.EXTRA_TAG)}, " +
                      "restored=${savedInstanceState != null}, defaultOperation=$operation"
              )
              ViewCompat.setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener(findViewById(R.id.main)) { v, insets ->
                  val systemBars = insets.getInsets(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.systemBars())
                  v.setPadding(systemBars.left, systemBars.top, systemBars.right, systemBars.bottom)
                  insets
              }
              nfcTestBinding.toNfcSetting.setOnClickListener {
                  BuyerNFCUtil.Util.toOpenNfc(this)
              }
              nfcTestBinding.fm1208Url.setText(Fm1208NdefClient.DEFAULT_BUSINESS_URL)
              nfcTestBinding.fm1208Package.setText(Fm1208NdefClient.DEFAULT_APPLICATION_PACKAGE)
              nfcTestBinding.readFm1208.setOnClickListener {
                  operation = Operation.READ
                  logOperationArmed(operation)
                  nfcTestBinding.nfcRecord.text = "已选择自动读取（NDEF / FMCOS），请将卡片贴近手机"
              }
              nfcTestBinding.writeNdef.setOnClickListener {
                  operation = Operation.WRITE_NDEF
                  logOperationArmed(operation)
                  nfcTestBinding.nfcRecord.text = "已选择写入 NDEF，请将 NDEF 卡片贴近手机"
              }
              nfcTestBinding.writeFmcos.setOnClickListener {
                  operation = Operation.WRITE_FMCOS
                  logOperationArmed(operation)
                  nfcTestBinding.nfcRecord.text = "已选择更新 FMCOS，请将已初始化的测试卡贴近手机"
              }
              nfcTestBinding.initializeFmcosTest.setOnClickListener {
                  AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                      .setTitle("确认格式化 FMCOS 测试卡")
                      .setMessage(
                          "仅允许 UID 77:E9:CC:7D。继续后，下一次碰卡将使用实验性全 FF 测试密钥" +
                              "认证、擦除 MF 下文件，并创建 ADF01 / EF0003。失败会立即停止。"
                      )
                      .setNegativeButton("取消", null)
                      .setPositiveButton("确认，等待碰卡") { _, _ ->
                          operation = Operation.INITIALIZE_FMCOS_TEST
                          logOperationArmed(operation)
                          nfcTestBinding.nfcRecord.text =
                              "已授权初始化 UID 77:E9:CC:7D；请将指定测试卡贴近手机"
                      }
                      .show()
              }
              handleColdLaunch(intent)
          }
      
          override fun onNewIntent(intent: Intent) {
              super.onNewIntent(intent)
              android.util.Log.i(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX onNewIntent action=${intent.action}, flags=${intent.flags}")
              setIntent(intent)
              if (handleColdLaunch(intent)) return
              intent.getParcelableExtra<Tag>(NfcAdapter.EXTRA_TAG)?.let(::handleCard)
          }
      
          override fun onStart() {
              super.onStart()
              mNfcAdapter = NfcAdapter.getDefaultAdapter(this)
              val flags = PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.S) {
                  PendingIntent.FLAG_MUTABLE
              } else {
                  0
              }
              mPendingIntent = PendingIntent.getActivity(
                  this, 0, Intent(this, javaClass),
                  flags
              )
          }
      
          override fun onResume() {
              super.onResume()
              val filters = arrayOf(IntentFilter(NfcAdapter.ACTION_TECH_DISCOVERED))
              val techLists = arrayOf(
                  arrayOf(Ndef::class.java.name),
                  arrayOf(NdefFormatable::class.java.name),
                  arrayOf(IsoDep::class.java.name, NfcA::class.java.name)
              )
              mNfcAdapter?.enableForegroundDispatch(this, mPendingIntent, filters, techLists)
              nfcTestBinding.nfcEnable.text = "当前NFC状态：${if (BuyerNFCUtil.Util.isNfcEnabled(this)) "已开启" else "未开启"}"
              nfcTestBinding.nfcSupport.text = "当前设备是否支持NFC：${if (BuyerNFCUtil.Util.isNfcSupported(this)) "支持" else "不支持"}"
          }
      
          override fun onPause() {
              super.onPause()
              mNfcAdapter?.disableForegroundDispatch(this)
          }
      
          override fun onDestroy() {
              cardExecutor.shutdownNow()
              super.onDestroy()
          }
      
          private fun handleCard(tag: Tag) {
              val scanId = scanSequence.incrementAndGet()
              val detectedAt = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
              val selectedOperation = operation
              val url = nfcTestBinding.fm1208Url.text.toString().trim()
              val packageName = nfcTestBinding.fm1208Package.text.toString().trim()
              android.util.Log.i(
                  LOG_TAG,
                  "$LOG_PREFIX scan=$scanId handleCard operation=$selectedOperation, " +
                      "uid=${tag.id.toHex()}, tech=${tag.techList.joinToString()}"
              )
              nfcTestBinding.nfcInfo.text = "FM1208 通信中...\nUID: ${tag.id.toHex()}"
              cardExecutor.execute {
                  android.util.Log.i(
                      LOG_TAG,
                      "$LOG_PREFIX scan=$scanId task started operation=$selectedOperation, " +
                          "queueDelayMs=${SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - detectedAt}"
                  )
                  val result = runCatching {
                      when (selectedOperation) {
                          Operation.READ -> when (val content = Fm1208CardClient.read(tag)) {
                              is Fm1208CardClient.Content.NdefContent ->
                                  "NDEF 读取成功 (${content.recordCount} records)\n" +
                                      "URI: ${content.uri ?: "无"}\n包名: ${content.applicationPackage ?: "无"}"
                              is Fm1208CardClient.Content.FmcosContent -> {
                                  val profile = content.profile
                                  val applications = profile.applications.joinToString("\n") { entry ->
                                      "#${entry.recordNumber} AID=${entry.aid ?: "无"} label=${entry.label ?: "无"}"
                                  }.ifEmpty { "无已登记应用" }
                                  "FMCOS 读取成功\nMF: ${profile.masterFileName ?: "未知"}\n" +
                                      "DIR SFI: ${profile.directorySfi ?: "未知"}\n应用:\n$applications\n" +
                                      "业务 URI: ${content.uri ?: "无"}\n" +
                                      "业务包名: ${content.applicationPackage ?: "无"}\n" +
                                      "业务 records: ${content.recordCount}"
                              }
                          }
                          Operation.WRITE_NDEF -> {
                              Fm1208CardClient.writeNdef(tag, url, packageName)
                              "NDEF 写入成功\nURI: $url\n包名: $packageName"
                          }
                          Operation.WRITE_FMCOS -> {
                              Fm1208CardClient.writeFmcos(tag, url, packageName)
                              "FMCOS 写入成功\nURI: $url\n包名: $packageName"
                          }
                          Operation.INITIALIZE_FMCOS_TEST -> {
                              val initialized = Fm1208CardClient.initializeFmcosTestCard(
                                  tag,
                                  url,
                                  packageName
                              )
                              "FMCOS 测试卡初始化并校验成功\n" +
                                  "完成步骤: ${initialized.completedSteps}\n" +
                                  "业务数据: ${initialized.verifiedMessageBytes} bytes\n" +
                                  "URI: $url\n包名: $packageName"
                          }
                      }
                  }.getOrElse { error ->
                      android.util.Log.e(
                          LOG_TAG,
                          "$LOG_PREFIX scan=$scanId operation=$selectedOperation failed, " +
                              "error=${error.javaClass.simpleName}, message=${error.message}",
                          error
                      )
                      "操作失败: ${error.message ?: error.javaClass.simpleName}"
                  }
                  android.util.Log.i(
                      LOG_TAG,
                      "$LOG_PREFIX scan=$scanId task finished operation=$selectedOperation, " +
                          "elapsedMs=${SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - detectedAt}"
                  )
                  runOnUiThread {
                      nfcTestBinding.nfcRecord.text = result
                      operation = Operation.READ
                  }
              }
          }
      
          private fun ByteArray.toHex(): String = joinToString(":") { "%02X".format(it) }
      
          private fun redirectLegacyColdLaunch(sourceIntent: Intent): Boolean {
              if (sourceIntent.action != NfcAdapter.ACTION_TECH_DISCOVERED) return false
              val tag = sourceIntent.getParcelableExtra<Tag>(NfcAdapter.EXTRA_TAG)
              android.util.Log.w(
                  LOG_TAG,
                  "$LOG_PREFIX legacy OEM NFC target received in onCreate, uid=${tag?.id?.toHex() ?: "unknown"}; " +
                      "forwarding to cold-launch activity without opening TagTechnology"
              )
              startActivity(Intent(this, Fm1208NfcLaunchActivity::class.java).apply {
                  action = NfcAdapter.ACTION_TECH_DISCOVERED
                  addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_SINGLE_TOP)
                  tag?.let { putExtra(NfcAdapter.EXTRA_TAG, it) }
              })
              finish()
              return true
          }
      
          private fun handleColdLaunch(intent: Intent): Boolean {
              if (intent.action != ACTION_FMCOS_COLD_LAUNCH) return false
              val uid = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_COLD_LAUNCH_UID) ?: "未知"
              android.util.Log.i(
                  LOG_TAG,
                  "$LOG_PREFIX cold launch handed off uid=$uid; waiting for foreground rediscovery"
              )
              nfcTestBinding.nfcInfo.text = "已通过 NFC 唤起 App\nUID: $uid"
              nfcTestBinding.nfcRecord.text =
                  "为避免使用系统选择页面后失效的 Tag，请先移开卡片，再重新贴卡并保持到读取完成"
              operation = Operation.READ
              return true
          }
      
          private fun logOperationArmed(selectedOperation: Operation) {
              android.util.Log.i(LOG_TAG, "$LOG_PREFIX operation armed=$selectedOperation; waiting for a new tag intent")
          }
      
          private enum class Operation { READ, WRITE_NDEF, WRITE_FMCOS, INITIALIZE_FMCOS_TEST }
      
          companion object {
              private const val LOG_TAG = "Fm1208NfcActivity"
              private const val LOG_PREFIX = "[FM1208-APDU]"
              private const val ACTION_FMCOS_COLD_LAUNCH =
                  "com.vdian.android.lib.testforgradle.action.FMCOS_COLD_LAUNCH"
              private const val EXTRA_COLD_LAUNCH_UID = "fm1208_cold_launch_uid"
      
              fun createColdLaunchIntent(context: Context, uid: String?): Intent =
                  Intent(context, NFCIdentificationActivity::class.java).apply {
                      action = ACTION_FMCOS_COLD_LAUNCH
                      addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_SINGLE_TOP)
                      putExtra(EXTRA_COLD_LAUNCH_UID, uid)
                  }
          }
      }

[FM1208-APDU] scan=1 read result type=FMCOS, mf=..., dirSfi=..., applications=1, uri=..., package=..., records=2

原有异常堆栈、操作耗时、UID 和技术类型日志保持不变。

- `:app:compileDebugKotlin` 构建成功。
- `git diff --check` 通过。
